title: I עָמַם
content:
† I. עָמַם vb. (√ of foll. cf. Ar. عَمَّ be comprehensive, include; عَمٌّ company; also paternal uncle; perhaps As. ummanu, people; Sab. עם either (a) people, or (b) paternal uncle CISiv. p. 20; pl. sf. אעממהו = (b) MordtmHimj. Inschr. 45. 70; also often in n.pr. CISiv. No. 5, 1, 99, 7 etc., PrätNeue Beitr. 25 HomChrest. 12, 133; A. und A. 6 WeGGN 1893, 480). p. 770

[Str5971,5993] I. עַם, עָם:1840 n.m.:Gn 11:6 (v. infr.) people (NH id., plebeian, common man; Targum עַמָּא people, pl. peoples, tribes, etc.; Syr. ܥܰܡܳܐ; Ar. عَمٌّ v. supr.; orig. mng. prob. those united, connected, related, cf. WeGGN 1893, 480);—abs. עַם Gn 11:6 +, עָם Ju 9:36 +, הָעָם Jos 8:11 +; cstr. עַם Nu 21:29 +; sf. עַמִּי Ex 3:7 +, עַמְּ 22:27 +, etc.; pl. עַמִּים Is 2:3 +, עֲמָמִים (cf. BAram.) Ne 9:22; cstr. עַמֵּי 1 K 8:43 +, עַמְמֵי Ne 9:24; pl. c. sf. v. II. עַם;—(Thes cites foll. as f. וְחָטָאת עַמְֶָּ Ex 5:16 [but corrupt and unintellig.; read perh. ´וְחַטָאתָ לְע, so LXX SyrVer Di]; Ju 18:7 [but ישֶׁבֶת must agree with lost word city, or the like, v. GFM]; Je 8:5 [but read שׁוֺבַב for שׁוֺבְבָה Gie]);—1. a people, nation (sts. ‖גּוֺי), n. coll. (sg. Ex 21:8, Jos 17:14, 17:15, 17:17, 2 S 17:29 + oft., or pl. Ex 20:15, 24:2, Je 5:31 + oft., or both in same clause Ex 1:20, 2 S 13:24): עַם אֶחָד = all mankind Gn 11:6 (J); peoples in gen. 27:29 (J ; ‖לְאֻמִּים), Ex 19:5 (E), Dt 2:25, 4:6 + oft. Dt, Ne 13:24 + oft.; קְהַל עַמִּים Gn 28:3 (P) an assembly (multitude) of peoples, 48:4 (P), Ez 23:24, 32:3 (+ רַבִּים); one's own people Je 46:l6, Psalm 45:11, Ru 1:10, 1:15, 1:16, 1:16 + (on עַמִּי נָדִיב Ct 6:12 v. esp. Bu); particular peoples, Egypt Gn 41:40 (E), Ex 1:22 (E), Ne 9:10 +; עַם־אֲרָם Am 1:5; עַם־כְּמוֺשׁ (i.e. Moab) Nu 21:29 (JE), Je 48:46; but esp. Isr. Ex 1:20 (E) + oft.; ´עַם־בְּנֵי יִש v:9 (J); called יהוה ´ע Nu 11:29 (E), 1 S 2:24 +, and (by ´י) עַמִּי Ex 3:7, 5:1 (J) + oft. (all periods); קְהַל עַם־הָאֱלֽהִים Ju 20:2, עַם־הַקָּהָל Lv 16:33 (P), קְהַל עָם Psalm 107:32; esp. הָעָם הַזֶּה (oft. in contempt or disgust) Nu 11:1, 11:12, 11:13 +; fig. of ants Pr 30:25, the shaphan v:26, locusts Jo 2:2, cf. לְעַם לְצִיִּים Psalm 74:14 (where rd. לְעַם צִיִּים Hup-Now).—On Ju 1:16 v. עֲמָלֵקִי. 2. = smaller units, e.g. a. inhab. of a city Gn 19:4 (J), 1 S 9:12, 9:13, Je 29:16, 29:25, 2 Ch 31:4 + (Je 8:5 del. ´יְרוּוּשׁ LXX Gie Co Rothst). b. inhab. of a locality Je 37:12 [appar. not = tribe, Dt 33:3 rd. עַמּוֺ LXX Di Dr, Ho 10:14, Ju 5:8, 5:14 rd. בְּעָרֶיְ We Now; v. sub ד]. c. retainers, followers Gn 14:16, 32:8, 33:15, 35:6, Ju 3:18, 8:5, 2 S 15:17, Je 41:13, 41:14 +. d. people bearing arms 1 S 11:11, 1 K 20:10 +; כָּבֵד ´ע Nu 20:20 (JE), i.e. a powerful force; עַם הַצָּבָא Nu 31:32 (P), הַמִּלְחָמָה ´ע Jos 8:1, 8:3, 8:11, 10:7, 11:7 (all JE); so prob. Ju 5:8 a (fighting) band; perh. also v:14 (rd. sg. ? v. GFM Bu). 3. = common people Je 21:7, 22:4, Lv 4:27 (opp. ruler v:22), Ne 5:1 (opp. יְהוּדִים), 7:5 (opp. rulers). 4. people in gen., persons Gn 50:20 (E), so appar. ´כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר וגו Ex 33:16 (J), Nu 11:34 (J), Jos 5:5, 5:5 (D), Ju 9:36 (as sg.), v:37 (as pl.), Je 36:9; persons labouring 1 K 9:23; superior persons Jb 12:2 (iron.); עַם עוֺלָם Ez 26:30 people of long ago (now in Shₑ’ôl). 5. phrases are: a. (עַמָּהּ, עַמִּי, עַמְּ) בְּנֵי עַמּוֺ members of one's people, compatriots, fellow-countrymen, etc. Nu 22:5 (E), Gn 23:11 (P) Lv 19:18 (H), Ju 14:16, 14:17, Ez 33:2, 33:12 +. b. בְּנֵי הָעָם = common people (v. 3) 2 K 23:6, Je 26:23 +; people in gen. שַׁעַר בְּנֵי הָעָם Je 17:19 i.e. public gate 2 Ch 35:5, 35:12. c. עַם הָאָרֶץ the people at large, as a body 2 K 11:14, 11:18, 11:19, 11:20, 15:5, 16:15, 21:24, 21:24 +, Je 37:2, 44:21, Lv 20:2 (H), Gn 23:7, 23:12, 23:13 (P); common people Je 34:19, cf. ´הא ´דַּלַּת ע 2 K 24:14; disting. from prince Ez 45:22, 46:3, 46:9, from priests Hg 2:4, Zc 7:5; = Canaanites Nu 14:9 (JE), cf. עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ 1 Ch 5:25; mixed post-exil. population Ezr 4:4. d. עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ usu. peoples of the earth Jos 4:24 (D), 2 Ch 32:19 +; of heathen peoples about and in Pal. after exile Ezr 10:2, 10:11; traders Ne 10:31; עַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֺת 9:30, 10:29, 2 Ch 32:13. e. מִשְׁפְּחוֺת עַמִּים Psalm 96:7 = 1 Ch 16:28 (cf. Psalm 22:28). f. בַּת־עַמִּי = people personif. Is 22:4, Je 4:11 + 7 t. Je + 6:14 (van d. H.; om. בַּת Baer Gi), La 2:11, 3:48, 4:3, 4:6, 4:10; בְּתוּלַת בַּת־עַמִּי Je 14:17. g. designations of Isr. are: עַם־קָרוֺשׁ Dt 7:6 + 3 t., קְדוֺשִׁים ´ע Dn 8:24, קֹדֶשׁ(ה) ´ע Is 62:12, 63:18, Dn 12:7; סְגֻלָּה ´ע Dt 7:6, 14:2, 26:18. h. of foreign (non-Isr.) peoples: ´ע נָכְרִי Ex 21:8 (E), אַחֵר ´ע Dt 28:32, and esp. from language, עִמְקֵי שָפָה ´ע Ez 3:5 cf. v:6, כִּלְשׁוֺן עַם וָעָם Ne 13:24 cf. Est 1:22, 1:22, 3:12, לֽעֵג ´ע Psalm 114:1. i. עַם עֶבְרָתִי Is 10:6, חֶרְמִי ´ע 34:11, ־מִבְחָרָיו´ע Dn 11:15, עַמֵּי תּוֺעֵבוֺת הָאֵלֶּה Ezr 9:14; לאֹ עַם בִּינוֺת Is 27:11.—For עַם־עוֺלָם Is 44:7 read (אֹתִיּוֺת) עַ מֵעוֺלָם(מִי הִשְׁמִי) Oort Du Kit CheHpt cf. PerlesAnal. 40, 64.

title: עִם
content:
[Str5973,5978] עִם prep. with (Aram. עִם, ܥܡ ܕܠ ܡܡ, Sab. עם DHMEpigr. Denkm. 12 HomChrest. 51; cf. Ar. مَعَ (but v. PrätBAS. i. 26)), sf. עִמִּי:46 and עִמָּדִי:45 (prob. akin to Ar. مَعْ side, عِنْدٌ beside: cf. √ ענד), without difference of meaning (עמי in Pent. Gn 31:31, 39:7, 39:12, 39:14, Ex 33:12, Lv 26:21, 26:23, 26:27, 26:40 [H] Nu 22:19; Jos-K. 13 t.; Psalm 42:9, 86:17, Jb 10:17, Ru 1:11, Est 7:8; in Dn 7 t., Ezr Ne Ch 11 t.: עמדי in Pent. Gn [JE] 14 t., Ex 17:2, Lv 25:23, Dt 5:28, 32:34, 32:39; Ju S 7 t.; Psalm 23:4, 50:11, 55:19, 101:6; Jb 14 t:, Ru 1:8); עִמְּ, † עִמְּכָה 1 S 1:26, עִמָּךְ; עִמּוֺ, עִמָּהּ; עִמָּ֫נוּ; עִמָּכֶם; עִמָּם:27 (Gn 18:16, etc.: Gn-K 20 t.; Ne 13:25; not Ezr Ch), and עִמָּהֶם:23 (chiefly late: Nu 22:12, Dt 29:16 (v:24 עמם), Jon 1:3, Jb 1:4, and 19 t. Ne Ezr Ch):—1. of fellowship and companionship (Lat. cum), as Gn 13:1 ולוט עמו and Lot with him, 18:16, 19:30, 24:54 הוא והאנשׁים אשׁר עמו, וכל ישראל עמו Jos 7:24 al.; + oft. Peculiar to Ch Ezr are clauses introd. by …ועמהם 1 Ch 12:34, 13:2, 15:8 +, Ezr 8:13, 8:14 (Aram. 5:2) +; so …ועמו 1 Ch 12:28, 2 Ch 17:14 – 18, 26:17, Ezr 8:3–12, 8:33. Coupling substantives, together with, chiefly in poetry: Dt 12:23 לא תאכל הנפשׁ עם הבשר, Jos 11:21, Ju 16:3, Ec 7:11; 2 S 1:24 שָׁנִי עִם עֲדָנִים, Dt 32:14 עִם חֵלֶב כרים, v:14, v:24, v:25, Am 4:10, Is 25:11, 34:7, Je 6:11, 51:40, Na 3:12, Psalm 66:15 אעשה בקר עם עתודים, 81:3, 83:8, 87:4, 89:14, 104:25 +, Ct 1:11, 4:13, 4:13 כפרים עם נרדים, v:14, v:14, 5:1, 5:1, 5:1. Unusually, Est 9:25 אמר עם הספר he ordered in conjunction with writing, in a written order. Poet. or late uses: Psalm 42:9 ובלילה שִׁירֹה עמי, Psalm 89:22 אשׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֺן עמו, v:25; in Jb of the companionship of sufferings or prosperity, 6:4 תִצֵּי שַׁדַּי עמדי, 17:2 אם לא הֲתֻלִים עמדי, 29:6 וְצוּר יָצוּק עִמדי פלגי שׁמן, v:20 כבודי חָדָשׁ עמדי, 2 Ch 14:5 ואין עמו מלחמה, 16:19 ישׁ עמך מלחמות, 28:10 עִמָּכֶם אֲשָׁמוֺת. Hence, in partic. a. of aid, Ex 23:5, Dt 22:4; 1 Ch 12:19; esp. of God, Gn 21:22 אלהים עמך, 26:3 ואהיה עמך, v:33, 31:3, 31:5, Ex 3:12, Jos 1:5, Is 8:10 כי עמנו אל Psalm 23:4, 46:8, 46:12, Jb 29:5 + oft. (cf. אֵת, Gn 39:2, 39:3, 39:21, 39:23, Is 43:5 +): so הִתְחַזַּק עם 1 Ch 11:10, 2 Ch 16:9, Dn 10:21, עָזַר עם 1 Ch 12:21, כי גם ידם עם דוד 1 S 22:17, 2 S 3:12, 1 Ch 4:10 (cf. Ex 23:1, and II. אֵת 1 a). With the help of (= Gk. σύν), 1 S 14:45 כי עם אלהים עשה היום הזה, Dn 11:39 (rare). b. Of actions done jointly with another, as ירשׁ עם inherit with, Gn 21:10, כרת ברית עם 26:28 + oft., עם (חִלֵּק)חָלַק to share with Jos 22:8, Is 53:12 +; cf. Dt 10:9 חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִם אֶחָיו, 18:1. c. If the common action be of the nature of a contest or combat, עִם is with in the sense of against: so often with נִלְחַם to fight, נִשְׁפַּט to dispute, נֶאֱבַק to wrestle, רִיב to strive (see these verbs), Gn 26:20, 30:8, 32:29; בּא בְּמִשְׁפָּט עם to enter into judgment with Is 3:14 +, Jb 14:3 (הֵבִיא), עִם ´רִיב לי Hos 4:1 +; hence, without a verb expressing the idea explicitly, Psalm 94:16 מי יקום לי עִם מְרֵעִים in the struggle with evil-doers ? vb 55:19 כי בְרַבִּים היו עמדי for as many are they in combat with me, Jb 9:14 אֶבְחֲרָה דְבָרַי עמו in the contest with him, 10:17 b, 16:21; perhaps צָדַק עִם 9:2, 25:4 (cf. 4 b end). d. Of dealing with a person, or of the relation in which one stands with, or towards, another: as עשה חסד עם to do kindness with Gn 24:12 + oft. (in 1 Pers. observe that in this phr. עמדי, not עמי, is regul. used, Gn 19:19, 20:13, 40:14, 1 S 20:14, 2 S 10:2 [‖ 1 Ch 19:2 עמי: here only], al.), עשה טוב עם Gn 26:29 +, v. also 20:9, 31:29, Dt 33:21, Ju 15:3, Jb 10:12, 13:20, 42:8, Psalm 86:17 (cf. אִתְּכֶם Dt 1:30, 10:21; and Aram. Dn 3:32), 119:124, 126:2 (1 S 12:24), Jb 33:29; הֵיטִיד עם Gn 32:10, 32:13 +, הֵרַע עִם 31:7; רָצָה עם be well pleased with Psalm 50:18, Jb 34:9; דִּבֶּר עם to speak with (subj. usu. God) Ex 19:9 + (v. דִּבֶּר 3 e), hence דָּבָר עִם Ju 18:7, 18:28, 2 S 3:17, 1 K 1:7, Jb 15:11 דָּבָר לָאַט עמך a word (spoken) gently with thee, cf. 11:5 ויפתח שפתיו עמך; יֵאָמֵן עם 2 Ch 1:9: and with adjj. תמים עם perfect with (i.e. toward) Dt 18:13, Psalm 18:24, שָׁלֵם עם 1 K 8:61 +; cf. וְלִבָּם לאֹ נָכוֺן עִמּוֺ Psalm 78:37, 2 S 21:4, 23:5, 1 K 3:6 (עמך), Mi 6:8 הַצְנֵעַ לֶכֶת עִם אֱלֱהָיו, Psalm 73:22 toward thee, 1 Ch 19:6, Hos 12:1 (?); also הָלַךְ קְרִי עִם Lv 26:21 ff. (7 t.), מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עם Dt 9:7, 9:24, 31:27, 2 Ch 16:10, 26:19, Psalm 85:5, Jb 10:17 a. e. Of a common lot, Gn 18:23 האף תספה צדיק עם רשׁע together with the wicked, v:25, Jb 3:14, 3:15, Is 38:11, Psalm 26:9 אל תאסף עם חטּאים נפשׁי, v:26:9b, v:28:3, 28:3, 69:29, Jb 30:1, 1 Ch 24:5; hence like, Psalm 73:5 ועם אדם לא יְנָֻ+נּעוּ with (i.e. like) men (in general), 106:6 חטאנו עם אבותינו, Ec 2:16 ואיך ימות הֶחָכָם עם הכסיל i.e. like the fool. f. Of equality or resemblance generally (poet.), Jb 9:26 חָֽלְפוּ עִם אֳנִיּוֺת אֵבֶה they pass by with, i.e. as swiftly as, skiffs of reed, 37:18 תרקיע עמו שׁחקים i.e. like him, 40:15 אשׁר עשיתי עמך; so נִמְשַׁל עִם Psalm 28:1, 143:7, נֶחְשַׁב עִם 88:5. † g. Of time, = as long as, Psalm 72:5 יִירָאוְּ עם שׁמשׁ as long as the sun endureth (cf. Aram. Dn 3:33, 4:31; also Ovid. Am. i. 15, 16 cum sole et luna semper Aratus erit); at the time of (?) 2 Ch 21:19 (but rd. perh. מֵחָלְיוֺ); and c. inf. (late), Ezr 1:11; עִם הֵעָלוֺת הַגּוֺלָה (cf. ἅμα τῷ sq. inf. Ju 3:21, 9:33; also עִם Ecclus 40:14). 2. Of a locality, close to, beside: † Gn 25:11 וישׁב יצחק עם נאר לחי ראי beside the well of, etc., 35:4 תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אשׁר עם שׁכם (so, after אשׁר, Jos 7:2, Ju 9:6, 18:22, 2 S 13:23), Jos 19:46 (?), Ju 18:3 הֵמָּה עִם בֵּית מִיכָה (so 19:11, 2 S 20:8), 1 S 10:2, 2 S 6:7 וַיָּ֫מָת ´שָׁם עִם אֲרוֺן הא, 19:38, 24:16, 1 K 1:9, 1 Ch 13:14 by the house of O., in its own house (v. Be), 21:15 (2 S 24:16), 26:16 (cf. אֵת 2.). By a person, Dt 5:28 וְאַתָּה עֲמֹד פֹּה עמדי by me, 1 S 1:26 הַנִּצֶּבֶת עִמְּכָה +; of one living near another, Ex 22:24, Lv 25:35, 25:36, 25:39, 25:47. 3. Of persons, עִם is spec. a. in the house or family or service of (apud, chez): Gn 23:4 גֵּר וְתוֺשָׁב עמך (fig. of ´י Lv 25:23, Psalm 39:13), 27:44, 29:14 וַיֵשֶׁב עִמּוֺ, v:25 עבדתי עמך I have served with thee (so v:30, cf. Dt 15:16), 31:38, Lv 25:6, 25:40, 25:40, 25:50, 25:53, Dt 22:2, 23:17, Ju 17:10, 2 S 19:34, 1 K 11:22; cf. 1 S 2:21 ´עם י i.e. at his sanctuary. b. In the possession of (Lat. penes): Gn 24:25 straw, etc., is עִמָּנוּ, 31:32, Dt 17:19 והיתה עמו with him, at his side, 29:16, Jb 28:14 וְיָם אָמַר אֵין עִמָּדִי; = stored up with, Dt 32:34 כָּמֻס עִמָּדִי Jb 27:13 (but rd. here prob. מֵאֵל; cf. 20:29); of ethical or mental attributes, 1 S 25:25 וּנְבָלָה עִמּוֺ, Jb 12:13 עִמּוֺ חָנְמָה וּגְבוּרָה, v:16, 25:2, Psalm 130:7, 2 Ch 19:3, 19:7. Cf. fig. Psalm 36:10 כי עמך מְקוֺר חַיִּים. c. In the custody or care of, 1 S 9:23 שִים אֹתָהּ עִמָּךְ; 22:23 כִּי מִשְׁמֶרֶת אַתָּה עִמָּדִי: cf. Jb 17:3 עָרְבֵנִי עִמָּךְ be surety for me with thyself. d. Beside = except, Dt 32:39 אֵין אלהים עִמָּדִי, Psalm 73:25 ועמך לא חפצתי בארץ and beside thee I delight not (in aught that is) upon earth (al. in comparison of thee, 1 f), 2 Ch 14:10 וְאֵין עִמְּ לַעֲזֹר there is none beside thee to help, 20:6; perh. Hos 9:8 (Hi Ke ; but very dub., v. Comm.). Cf. אֵת 1 b. e. With = friendly with, Gn 31:2 כי איננו עמי (syn. v:5 אֶל towards), 2 K 10:15 לְבָבִי עִם לְבָֽבְ, Pr 23:7 וְלִבּוֺ בַל עִמָּךְ. 4. Idiom. of a thought or purpose present with one:—† a. ´עִם לְבַב פ, esp. in Dt. and the later Deut. style, Dt 8:5 וְיָדַעְתָּ עִם לְבָבְ thou shalt know with thy heart, 15:9 פן יהיה דבר עם לבבך בליעל a wicked thought with thy heart, Jos 14:7 I brought back word כָאשׁר עם לבבי ´היה עם לְבַב פ, esp. of a purpose, 1 K 8:17 ויהי עם ´לבב דוד לִבְנוֺת וגו i.e. it was David's purpose to build, etc., v:18, v:18, 1 K 10:2 (= 2 Ch 6:7, 6:8, 6:8, 9:1), 1 Ch 22:7, 28:2 (both based on 1 K 8:17, etc.), 2 Ch 1:11, 24:4, 29:10; rather differently, to muse or talk with one's heart, Psalm 77:7, Ec 1:16. † b. עִם alone, = in one's consciousness, whether of knowledge or memory or purpose (cf. אֵת 3 b; عِنْدَ WAG ii. § 66): Nu 14:24 עֵקֶב הָֽיְתָה רוּחַ אַחֶרֶת עִמּוֺ i.e. operating in his mind, 1 K 11:11 יען אשׁר היתה זאת עמך, 1 Ch 28:12 the pattern of all אשׁר היה בָרוּחַ עמו that was in spirit (i.e. mentally) with him, Psalm 50:11 וְזִיז שָדַי עִמָּדִי is with me (i.e. is known to me; ‖ידעתי), prob. also 73:23, 139:18 (= in thy thought and care); Jb 9:35 לא כן אנכי עמדי not so am I with myself (my consciousness—or conscience—does not tell me that I need dread him), 10:13 ידעתי כי זאת עמך i.e. that this was thy purpose (‖אֵלֶּה צָפַנְתָּ בִּלְבָבְֶָ), 15:9 ולא עמנו הוא and is not with us (= in our knowledge; ‖וְלאֹ נֵדָע), 23:10 כי ידע דרך עמדי the way of which I am conscious (De; Ew Di the way attending me, my usual way), v:14 וְכָהֵנָּה רַבּוֺת עמו i.e. he has many such purposes, 27:11 אֲשֶׁד עִם שַׁדָּי לאֹ אֲכַחֵד i.e. his purposes or principles of action. Also sts. in the judgment or estimation of, 1 S 2:26 טוֺב עִם, 2 S 6:22 נִכְבַּד עִם, perh. צָדַק עִם Jb 9:2, 25:4 (Ges Bu; but Ew as 1 c, Hi De beside, in comparison of). † 5. Metaph. together with = in spite of, notwithstanding Ne 5:18 וְעִם זֶה (cf. مَعَ WAG ii. § 57; in Heb. בְּ is the more usual syn.).—In 1 S 16:12 אַדְמֹנִי עִם יְפֵה עֵינַיִם (cf. 17:42 עִם יְפֵה מַרְאֶה), if text correct, יפה must be a neuter subst., with beauty of eyes; but rd. prob. (Gr Bu) עֶלֶם a youth (17:56, 20:22) for עם (v. HPS; CheExpos. T. x. 521 אַדְמֹנִי עֶצֶם, cf. La 4:7). מֵעִם:72 from with or beside (= παρὰ with a gen.: cf. מֵאֵת): hence a. after verbs of departing, taking, removing, etc., Gn 13:14 אַחֲרֵי הִפָּרֶ־ד לוֺט מֵעִמּוֺ, 26:16 לֵךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ, 1 S 10:2, 10:9, 14:17 מי הלך מעמנו, 2 S 1:2, 1 S 16:14 סרה מעם שׁאול ´ורוח י, 18:12; 2 K 2:9 בטרם אֶלָּקַח מעמך; 2 S 15:28 עַד בּוֺא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם; of heart turning ´מעם י Dt 29:17, 1 K 11:9; after שׁאל to ask, Ex 22:13, Dt 10:12 ´מה י שֹׁאֵל מֵעִמָּךְ, 1 S 1:17, 20:28 (Niph.), Is 7:11 +; דרשׁ to require, Dt 18:19, 23:22, 1 K 14:5 (to inquire); יצא מֵעִם פרעה from (being) with Ph. Ex 8:8, 8:25, 8:26, 9:33 +: cf. 2 S 3:26, 1 S 18:13 ויסירהו שׁאול מעמו; and מַעִם פְּנֵי Gn 44:29, Jb 1:12. † Sq. a word denoting a place, Gn 48:12 וַיּוֺצֵא יוֺסֵָף אֹתָם מֵעִם בִּרְכָּיו, Ex 21:14 מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי (cf. 1 S 2:33), Ju 9:37 מֵעִם טַבּוּר הארץ, 1 S 20:34 מֵעִם הַשֻּׁלְחָן; Jb 28:4 מֵעִם גָּר away from, far from (si vera l.). † b. Gn 24:27 אשׁר לא עזב חסדו מעם אֲדֹנִי (cf. with הכרית 1 S 20:15, הסיר 2 S 7:15, 1 Ch 17:13 (‖ 2 S 7:15 מן), הפיר Psalm 89:34); Ru 4:10 לאֹ־יִכָּרֵת שֵׁם מֵעִם. † c. From the possession, or custody, of (cf. עִם 3 b, c): so with גזל Gn 31:31, ערב to take in pledge 44:32, גנב Ex 22:11, יצא (subj. a slave; cf. עם 3 a) Lv 25:41, Dt 15:16 (cf. with שִׁלַּח חָפְשִׁי Dt 15:12, 15:13, 15:18, Je 34:14, הִנָּצֵל Dt 23:16), לקח 2 S 3:15, קנה 24:21. † d. Expressing origination or authorship: 1 S 20:7 כִּי כָֽלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִמּוֺ, v:9; v:33 (cf. מֵאֵת Est 7:17); esp. of ´י (cf. מֵאֵת c), Gn 41:32 ´נָכוֺן הַדָּבָר מֵעִם הא is established from, on the part of, God, 1 K 2:33 ´מעם י …שׁלום, 12:15 (2 Ch 10:15) כִי הָֽיְתָה סִבָּה ´מעם י, Is 8:18 signs and portents ´מעם י, 28:29 יצאה ´גם זאת מעם י, 29:6, Psalm 121:2 ´עֶזְרִי מעם י Ru 2:12. And of a judgment proceeding from any one: 2 S 3:28 ´נקי מעם י = pronounced guiltness by ´י, Jb 34:33 הֲמֵעִמְּ at thy judgment shall he requite ? (cf. מִן 2 d end).

[Str6005,410,5973] † עִמָּנוּאֵל n.pr.m. Immanuēl (with us is God);—´י Is 7:14 van d. H. Baer; עִמָּנוּ אֵל Gi;—name of child, symbolizing presence of ´י to deliver his people (on interpret. v. Comm.)—עִמָּנוּ אֵל 8:8, 8:10 is declaration of trust and confidence, with us is God ! (cf. Psalm 46:8, 46:12); v. עִם.

[Str5971] † II. [עַם] n.[m.] kinsman (on father's side) (Ar. عَمٌّ paternal uncle, etc., v. I. עמם; cf. perh. TelAm. ammu, kinsmen (?); on Nab. עם ancestor cf. Lzb151, 499; v. also esp. NesEg 187, ZAW xvi (1896), 322f. Krenkelib. viii (1888), 280–84);—sf. עַמִּי in בֶּן־עַמִּי (q. v.), and n. pr. sqq.; elsewhere pl. sf. עַמֶּיְ Nu 27:13, 31:2 (Lv 19:16 read עַמְּ LXX Sam), + (poss.) עֲמַָמֶיְ Ju 5:14; עַמָּיו Gn 25:8 + 15 t., עַמֶּיהָ 17:14 + 3 t.; read עַמֶּי (for MT עַמִּי, I. עַם; cf. Krenkell. c. 281) Gn 49:29 and perh. Ju 14:3 (cf. Lv 21:14); acc. to Buhl Kit also 2 K 4:13; —father's kinsmen: וַיֵּאָסֵף אֶל־עַמָּיו Gn 25:8 (of joining kinsmen in Shₑ’ôl), so v:17, 35:29, 49:33, Nu 20:24, Dt 32:50, cf. Gn 49:29 (v. supr.), Nu 27:13, 31:2, Dt 32:50 (all P); וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ מֵעַמֶּיהָ Gn 17:4 (severed from living kinsmen), so Lv 7:20, 7:21, 7:23, 7:27, 19:8, 23:29, Nu 9:13, מִקֶּרֶב עַמֶּיהָ Ex 31:14, cf. 30:33, 30:38, Lv 17:9 (all PH); מֵעַמָּיו יִקַּח אִשָּׁה 21:14 (H), and perh. Ju 14:3 (sim. I. עַם: [ם—ָ, הּ—ָ] מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֺ Lv 17:4, 17:10, 18:29 +); other combin. Ju 5:14 (si vera l. read perh. בְּעַמְֶָּ, v. I. עַם 2 d ), Lv 21:1, 21:4, 21:15 (H), Ez 18:18 and (perh.) 2 K 4:13.—בֶּן־עַמִּי (v. p. 122 b) perh. = son of my kinsman; on n.pr. c. עַם v. GrayProp. N. 41 ff.

769:a. II. [עַם] kinsman, later development of I. עַם RSK 58; 2nd ed. 72.

[Str5980] † I. [עֻמָּה] n.f. juxtaposition, but only in st. c. with force a prep. close by, side by side with, parallel to, agreeing with, corresponding to;—st. c. עֻמַּת, exc. Ec 5:15 always c. לְ, sf. לְעֻמָּתוֺ, once pl. cstr. לְעֻמּוֺת Ez 45:7; —a. close by, side by side with: Ex 25:27 (37:14), 28:27 (39:20), Lv 3:9 לְעֻמַּת הֻעָצֶה יְסִירֶנָּה shall take it away close by the backbone; esp. of what is parallel, Ez 42:7 the wall alongside of the chambers; of the contiguous portions in Ezek.'s division of the land, alongside of each other, Ez 45:6, 45:7, 48:13, 48:18, 48:18, 48:21; of movement in parallel lines, 2 S 16:13 Shimei was going along לְעֻמָּתוֺ parallel with him, v:13, Ez 1:20 וְהָאוֺפַנִּים יִנָּֽשְאוּ לְעֻמָּתָם, v:21, 3:13, 10:19, 11:22; 3:8 נָתַתִּי פָנֶיְ חֲזָקִים לְעֻמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם by the side of their face (which, as antagonism is implied, = against, RV), v:8. b. agreeing with, corresponding to (a common result of juxtaposition), Ex 38:18 a screen five cubits high לעמת קלעי החצר agreeing with (RV answerable unto) the hangings of the court (in height), Ez 40:18; prob. also 1 Ch 26:16, Ne 12:24 מִשְׁמָר ´מִשְׁמָר ל ward corresponding to ward. c. correspondingly to, 1 Ch 24:31 they also cast lots לְעֻמַּת אֲחֵיהֶם correspondingly to their brethren, vb the head, correspondinly to his younger brother, 26:12 to these…belonged charges correspondingly to (in common with) their brethren. d. before a sentence (Ges§ 155 n), 1 Ch 25:8 (strangely) לְעֻמַּת כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדוֺל (v. Ke) correspondingly to (the principle) of as the small so the great; Ec 5:15 כָּל־עֻמַּת שֶׁכָּא quite exactly as he came, so shall he go (but LambertRÉJ xxxi. 47, RahlfsTh. Lt. -z. 1896, 587 כִּלְעֻמַּת). e. מִלְּעֻמַּת (v. מִן 1 c, 9 a) 1 K 7:20 close beside.

769:b. 1. [עֻמָּה] c: ins. ‘Ec 7:14 side by side with, as well as.’

[Str5981] † II. עֻמָּה n.pr.loc. Jos 19:30, v. עַכּוֺ.

[Str5983] עַמּוֺן:106 n.pr.gent. Ammon, LXX Αμμαν, Αμμων (As. Bît Ammanu COTGloss.); always (except 1 S 11:11 [where however LXX rds. ´בְּנֵי ע], Psalm 83:8, which have ´ע alone) בְּנֵי עַמּוֺן, connected by J with בֶּן־עַמִּי son of Lot Gn 19:38 (and meaning of name doubtless sought herein by J; cf. II. עַם); people apparently akin to Isr., but usu. hostile, dwelling E. of Jordan, NE. of Moab, between Arnon and Jabbok: Nu 21:24, 21:24 (JE), Dt 2:19, 2:19, 2:37, 3:11, 3:16, Jos 12:2, 13:10 (D), v:25 (P), Ju 3:13, 10:6 + 25 t. Ju 10–12, 1 S 11:11, 12:12, 14:47, 2 S 8:12, 10:1 + 14 t. 2 S 10 – 12, 17:27, 1 K 11:7, 11:33, 2 K 23:13, 24:2, 1 Ch 18:11 + 20 t. Ch, Am 1:13, Is 11:14, Je 9:25 + 9 t. Je, Zp 2:8, 2:9, Ez 21:25, 21:33 + 5 t. Ez 25, Dn 11:41.—Vid. CheAmmon in Ency. Bib.

[Str5984,5985] † עַמּוֺנִי, עַמֹּנִי adj. gent. Ammonite;—abs. ms. עַמּוֺנִי as subst. Dt 23:4 an Ammonite (generic), so עַמֹּנִי Ne 13:1; הָעַמּוֺנִי of individual 1 S 11:1, 11:2, 2 S 23:37 = 1 Ch 11:39, Ne 2:19, so הָיַמֹּנִי 2:10, 3:35; fs. הָעַמֹּנִית 1 K 14:21 = 2 Ch 12:13, 1 K 14:31, so הָעַמּוֺנִית 2 Ch 24:26; הָעַמֹּנִי as subst. coll. Ezr 9:1; mpl. as subst. עַמֹּנִים 1 K 11:5, ´הָע Dt 2:20, Ne 4:1, ´הָעַמּוֺ 2 Ch 26:8 (on 20:1 v. מְעוּנִים); fpl. as adj. עַמֳּנִיֹּת 1 K 11:1, so Ne 13:23 Qr, Kt עמוניות.

[Str5988] † עַמִּיאֵל n.pr.m. (my kinsman is God, GrayProp. N. 254);—LXX Αμ(με)ιηλ: 1. E. Jordan name 2 S 9:4, 9:5, 17:27. 2. a Danite Nu 13:12 (P). 3. David's father-in-law 1 Ch 3:5 (= אֱלִיעָם 2 S 11:3). 4. son of Obed Edom 1 Ch 26:5.

[Str5989,5991] † עַמִּיהוּד n.pr.m. (my kinsman is majesty);—LXX (Σ)εμιουδ, Αμιουδ, etc.: 1. a Geshurite 2 S 13:37 Qr (> Kt עַמִּיחוּר, cf. Dr al., GrayProp. N. 43). 2. an Ephraimite Nu 1:10, 2:18, 7:48, 7:53, 10:22 (all P), 1 Ch 7:26. 3. a Simeonite Nu 34:20. 4. a Naphtalite Nu 34:28. 5. a Judahite 1 Ch 9:4.

[Str5990] † עַמִּיזָבָד n.pr.m. (my kinsman hath bestowed; cf. זָבָד, אֶלְזָבָד, יְהוֺזָבָד, זַבְדִּיאֵל, זְבַדְיָה, and, esp. on Palm. equiv., v. GrayProp. N. 223 f. also Lzb265 Cook46 f.);—son of Benaiah 1 Ch 27:6, LXX Λαιβαζαθ, A Αμιραζαθ, LXXL Αμειναζαβαδ.

[Str5991] עמיחור 2 S 13:37 Kt v. עַמִּיהוּד. above

[Str5992] † עַמִּינָדָב n.pr.m. (my kinsman is noble);—LXX Αμ(ε)ιναδαβ: 1. Aaron's father-in-law Ex 6:23, Nu 1:7, 2:3, 7:12, 7:17, 10:14 (all P), Ru 4:19, 4:20, 1 Ch 2:10, 2:10. 2. Levites: a. 1 Ch 6:7. b. 15:10, 15:11.

[Str5996] † עַמִּישַׁדָּי n.pr.m. (my kinsman is Shadai):—a Danite Nu 1:12, 2:25, 7:66, 7:71, 10:25, LXX Αμ(ε)ισαδαι, LXXL Αμισαδε.

title: II עָמַם
content:
[Str6004] † II. [עָמַם] vb. darken, dim (NH id.; Ar. غَمَّ cover, veil, conceal; Targum עֲמַם grow dark);—Qal Pf. 3 pl. sf. עֲמָמֻהוּ Ez 31:8 dub., but prob. (as Thes) cedars did not eclipse him; עֲמָמוְּ 28:3 no secret do they hold dark (= is held dark) for thee (Ges§ 117 x). Hoph. Impf. 3 ms. יוּעַם זָהָב La 4:1 (fig.) how is the gold dimmed ! cf. Bu.

[Str5971] עֲמָמִים, עַמְמֵי v. I. עַם supr. p. 766

[Str6005] עִמָּנוּאֵל v. sub עִם supr. p. 769

title: עָמַס
content:
[Str6006] † [עָמַס, ?עָמַש] vb. 1. load. 2. carry a load (NH id.; Ph. עמס carry; cf. poss. Ar. عَمِسَ gravis et obscurus fuit dies (Frey));—Qal Impf. 3 ms. וַיַּעֲמֹס Gn 44:13, יַעֲמָ־ס Psalm 68:20; Pt. act. עֹמְסִים Ne 13:15; עֹמְשִים 4:11 (but v. infr.); sf. עֹמְסֶיהָ Zc 12:3; pass. עֲמֻסִים Is 46:3, עֲמוּסוֺת v:1; —1. load (obj. om.) upon (עַל) ass Gn 44:13 (E), Ne 13:15; so abs. 4:11, lit., si vera l. (v. Be-Ry Ryle); but rd. prob. חֲמֻשִׁים RyKau. 2. carry a load Psalm 68:20 (´י, for (ל) his people), carry as a load Zc 12:3 (fig.), pass. Is 46:1 (lit.), v:3 (fig.).

770:b. [עָמַס etc.] ad fin.: add ‘Hiph. Pf. 3 ms. הֶעְמִיס 1 K 12:11 load upon (acc. rei + עַל Pers.) = 2 Ch 10:11.

[Str5986] † עָמוֺס n.pr.m. Amos the prophet;—Am 1:1, 7:8, 7:10, 7:11, 7:12, 7:14, 8:2, LXX Αμως.

[Str6007] † עֲמַסְיָה n.pr.m. name is Judah 2 Ch 17:16, LXX Μασαιας, LXXL Αμασιας (cf. Ph. אשמנעמס, בעלעמס CISi. 139, 169, 719, v. also GrayProp. N. 296 f.).

[Str4614] † מַעֲמָסָה n.f. load, burden;—´אֶבֶן מ Zc 12:3 a stone of burden = heavy stone, hard to lift.

[Str6008] † עַמְעָד n.pr.loc. in Asher, Jos 19:26, LXX Αμιηλ, A Αμαδ, LXXL Αλφααδ.

title: עָמֹק
content:
[Str6009] † [עָמֹק, LagBN 28] vb. be deep (NH in deriv.; Ar. عَمُقَ; Eth. ዐመቀ፡ prob. As. [emêḳu] III. 2 implore (earnestly; ‘ from bottom of one's soul ’), emûḳu, might, nîmeḳu, wisdom (? as unfathomable); Targum in deriv.; Syr. in der. spec.);—Qal Pf. 3 mpl. עָֽמְקוּ Psalm 92:6 (of ´י's designs; cf. As. supr.). Hiph. make deep: Pf. 3 ms. (symbol.) הֶעְמִיק הִרְחִָב Is 30:33 (sc. Tophet; van d. H. הֶעֱמִיק, and so in foll.); 3 mpl. הֶעְמִיקוּ Ho 5:2 the pit of Shittim (?) have they made deep (reading שַׁחַת הַשִּׁטִּים We Now, cf. Che GuKau); הֶעְמִיקוּ סָרָה Is 31:6 (fig.) they have made deep (their) apostasy; sq. vb., with adverbial force שִׁחֵתֻ֭וּ ´ה Ho 9:9 = they are in the depth of corruption (v. שׁחת); Imv. mpl. הֶעְמִיקוּ (Ges§ 63 o), sq. inf. Je 49:8, 49:30 make deep to dwell (of hiding, so most; > Gie take an abject seat, as 13:18, 48:18); Pt. הַמַּעֲמִיקִים לַסְתִּר Is 29:15 they who deeply hide fr. ´י (their) counsel; Inf. abs. הַעְמֵק Is 7:11 = Imv. make deep (ask a sign in the depths of Shₑ’ôl, reading שְׁאָֹלָה; opp. הַגְבֵּהַּ).

[Str6010] עֵ֫מֶק:70 n.m.:Mi 1:4 vale (prop. deepening, depth, v. GASmGeogr. 384 f. 654 f.; cf. בִּקְעָה, גַּיְא, נַחַל);—´י abs. Jos 8:13 +, cstr. Gn 14:17 +; sf. עִמְקֵח Je 49:4, עִמְקָם 47:5 (but v. infr.); pl. עֲמָקִים Mi 1:4, sf. עֲמָקַיִח Is 22:7; —vale, valley, lowland, opp. הֶהָרִים Mi 1:4, amid mts., e.g. about Jerus. Is 22:7, Je 31:40, so perh. לשׁוֵה ´ע Gn 14:17 = הַמֶּלֶח ´ע v:17, 2 S 18:18, cf. תֶבְרוֺן ´ע Gn 37:14 (J), בְּגִבְעוֺן ´ע Is 28:21, Jos 8:13 (JE), הָאֵלָה ´ע 1 S 17:2, 17:19, 21:10 (perh. Wady es-Sant, in Shephelah, W. of Bethlehem, GASmGeogr. 226); אֲשֶׁר לְבֵית רְחוֺב ´ע Ju 18:28 in extreme north; in Moab Je 48:8 (‖ [opp.?] מִישׁוֺר); or wider, e.g. Ju 5:15 (scene of Sisera's defeat; rd. perh. ´ע also for עֲמָלֵק v:14 GFM), יִזְרְעֶָאל ´ע Ju 6:33, Ho 1:5, Jos 17:16 (JE), cf. Ju 7:1, 7:8, 7:12, 1 S 31:7 = 1 Ch 10:7, these all perh. narrow ends of plain (cf. GASml.c.), but v. 1 K 20:28 (opp. הֶהָרִים; ‖מִישׁוֺר v:23; = open country, cf. Aphek v:26); of Jordan-valley Jos 13:19, 13:27 (P); of maritime plain (opp. הָהָר) Ju 1:19, 1:34; fit for chariots, so also אֶרֶץ ´הָע Jos 17:16 (P), cf. Jb 39:21; ´ישֶׁבֶת הָע Je 21:13, cf. Nu 14:25 (v. Gie di); cultivated 1 S 6:13, Je 49:4, 49:4, Jb 39:10, fertile 1 Ch 27:29, Psalm 65:14, Ct 2:1; v. also אַיָּלוֺן, בָּכָא, כְּרָכָה, II. חָרוּץ, יְהוֺשָׁפָט, סֻכּוֺת, עָכוֺר, קְצִיץ, רְפָאִים, שִדִּים; ´בֵּית הָע v. p. 112 a.—For עִמְקָם Je 47:5 rd. עֲנָקִם Anakim LXX Thes Hi Gf Gie Co Rothst; so also (more dub.) 1 Ch 12:16 (van d. H. v15) Gf Gie, where otherwise ´הָע = people of valleys.

[Str6011] † עֹ֫מֶק n. [m.] depth;—abs. Pr 25:3; pl. cstr. עִמְקֵי שְׁאוֺל 9:18 (Köii. 1, 32).

[Str6012] † [עָמֵק] adj. deep, unfathomable;—pl. cstr. עִמְקֵי שָפָה (Ges§ 93 ii) i.e. unintelligible of speech Is 33:19, Ez 3:5, 3:6.—Pr 9:18 v. עֹמֶק.

[Str6013] עָמֹק:17 adj. deep (cf. BaNB § 23 b);—1. ´ע lit. Lv 13:3 + 6 t. Lv 13; f. עֲמֻקָּה of cup Ez 23:32, trench Pr 22:14, 23:27 (all 3 in sim.); מִשְּׁאוֺל ´ע Jb 11:8 (fig.); pl. מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים (sim.) Pr 18:4, 20:5. 2. = unsearchable עָמֹקּ Psalm 64:7, Ec 7:24, 7:24; pl. עֲמֻקוֺת (Baer עֲמוּקוֺת, van d. H. עֲמֻקּוֺת) Jb 12:22.

[Str5987] † עָמוֺק n. pr. m. a priest Ne 12:7, 12:20, Αμουκ.

[Str4615] † מַעֲמַקִּים n. m. pl. depths;—abs. ´מ Psalm 130:1 (fig.); cstr. lit. מַעֲמַקֵּי־יָם Is 51:10; fig. מַיִם ´מ Ez 27:34 (fall of Tyre), Psalm 69:3, 69:15 (distress).

title: I עמר
content:
I. עמר (√ of foll.; mng. dub., perh. related to Ar. غَمُرَ be abundant (of water), surpass, overtop; NH עוֺמֶר, עָמִיר = BH; Targum עָוּמְרָא, עֲמִירָא = BH 1. עֹמֶר).

[Str6016] †I. עֹ֫מֶר n. m.:Lv 23:11 sheaf (swath, row of fallen grain, WetzstZ. f. Ethnol. 1873, 273 (Syr. Dreschtafel), ag. him VogelsteinLandwirthschaft in Pal, 61 who trans. heap of sheaves);—´ע abs. Dt 24:19, Lv 23:11, 23:12, 23:15, cstr. v:10; fig. of food (abs.) Jb 24:10; pl. עֳמָרִים lit. Ru 2:7, 2:15.

[Str6016] †II. עֹ֫מֶר n.m.:Ex 16:22 omer (cf. Ar. غُمَرٌ small drinking cup or bowl; relation to 1. ´ע obscure);—a measure, only Ex 16; —the measure itself v:18, v:32, v:33; amount measured v:16, v:22; = 1/10 ephah v:36; LXX γόμορ.

[Str5995] † עָמִיר n. [m.] swath, row of fallen grain (hay, as Mishn., acc. to Vogelsteinl. c. 74 f. (who is then compelled to rd. עֹמֶר Mi 4:12), cf. title: III עמר
content:

title: ענב
content:
ענב (√ of foll.; cf. NH עֵנָב = BH; Ar. عِنَبٌ id.; Sab. אנעב vineyards SabDenkm47; MordtmZMG xli (1887), 309, 364; Targum עִנָּכָא; perh. also As. inbu, fruit (and not = אֵב q. v.), cf. HomA. und A.94).

Dt 32:14 (coll.); elsewhere pl. עֲנָבִים Gn 40:10 +; cstr. עִנְּכֵי (Ges§ 20 h) Lv 25:5, Dt 32:32; sf. עֲנָבֵמוֺ v:32; —grapes Gn 10:40, 40:11 (E), Am 9:13 (all as yielding juice for drink), Ho 9:10 (sim.), Is 5:2, 5:4 (parable), Je 8:13, Ne 13:15, Lv 25:5 (H); ´מִשְׁרַת ע Nu 6:3 (P), poet. ´דַּם־ע Gn 49:11, Dt 32:14; ´בִּכּוּרֵי ע Nu 13:20, ´אֶשְׁכּוֺל ע v:23 (JE); eaten Dt 23:25, so לַתִים וִיבֵשִׁים ´ע Nu 6:3; ´אֲשִׁישֵׁי ע Ho 3:1 raisen-cakes; רוֺשׁ ´ע Dt 32:32 grapes of poison.

[Str6024] † עֲנָב n. pr. loc. in hill-country of Judah Jos 11:21, 15:50, Αναβ(ωθ), Ανωβ[ν], mod. ‘Anab, 18 1/2 miles SW. from Hebron, BuhlGeogr. 164.

[Str6036] † עָנוּב n.pr.m. 1 Ch 4:8, Εννων, LXXL Ανωβ.

title: עָנֹג
content:
[Str6026] † [עָנֹג, LagBN 31] vb. be soft, delicate, dainty (NH id. Pi. make soft, pliable, live or spend in enjoyment; Ar. غَنِجَ use amorous behaviour, affect langour);—Pu. Pt. f. הַמְּעֻנָּגָה Je 6:2 daintily bred, fig. of Jerusalem. Hithp. 1. be of dainty habit, Inf. cstr. הִתְעַנֵּג Dt 28:56 (woman, ‖רֹךְ). 2. take exquisite delight, Pf. 3 pl. וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ consec Psalm 37:11 (עַל rei); 2 mpl. וְהִתְעַנַּגְתֶּם consec. Is 66:11 (מִן rei); Impf. 3 ms. יִתְעַָ+נּג Jb 27:10; 2 ms. תִּתְעַנַּג Is 58:14, תִּתְעַָ+נּג Jb 22:26 (all c. [שַׁדַּי] ´עַל־י); 3 fs. תִּתְעַנַּג Is 55:2 (ב rei); Imv. ms. ´הִתְעַנַּג עַל־י Psalm 37:4. 3. c. עַל, in bad sense, make merry over, make sport of, Impf. 2 mpl. עַל־מִי תִּתְעַָ+נּגוּ Is 57:4.

[Str6027] † עֹ֫נֶג n.[m.] daintiness, exquisite delight;—´הֵיכְלֵי ע Is 13:22; ´וְקָרָאתָ לַשַּׁבָּת ע 58:13.

[Str6028] † עָנֹג adj. dainty;—´הֶע Dt 28:54 man; הָעֲנֻגָּה v:56 woman; Is 47:1 (Bab. personif.); all ‖[ה]רכ.

[Str8588] † תַּעֲנוּג n.[m.] daintiness, luxury, exquisite delight;—1. luxury: ´ת Pr 19:10; elsewhere pl.; cstr. תַּעֲנֻגוֺת Ec 2:8. 2. sf. בְּנֵי תַּעֲנוָּ+ניִךְ Mi 1:16 thy dainty sons; בֵּית תַּעֲנֻגֶיהָ 2:9 her (their) dainty house(s), > of tender love (rdg. בְּנֵי 2:9 We Now. 3. delight of love, pl. abs. בַּתַּעֲנוּגִים Ct 7:7 (PerlesAnal. 22 f. conj. בַּת עַמִּינָדָב).

title: עָנַד
content:
[Str6029] † [עָנַד] vb. bind around, upon (cf. Ar. عَنَدَ turn aside fr. way; Syr. ܥܢܰܕ defecit, defuit; cf. also עִמָּדִי (for עִמִּי));—Qal Impf. 1 s. לִי אֶעֶנְרֶנּוּ Jb 31:36 (obj. garland, in fig.); Imv. sf. עָנְדֵם Pr. 6:21 (fig.; ‖קָשַׁר).

[Str4575] † מַעֲדַנּוֺת n.f.pl. bonds, bands; so appar. כִּימָה ´הַתְקַשֵּׁר מ Jb 38:31 (by metath. or err. from √ ענד, v. Di Bu).—1 S 15:32 v. ´מ p. 588 supr.

title: I עָנָה
content:
[Str6030] I. עָנָה vb. answer, respond (NH id., respond, make response; Targum עֲנָא; Syr. ܥܢܳܐ; OAram. Palm. ענה; cf. Ar. عنى, عَنَا intend by saying);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. ´ע Mi 6:5 +; sf. עָנַנִי 1 S 28:15 +, עָנָךְ Is 30:19, Je 23:37, עָנָהוּ 1 S 9:17 +; 1 s. עָנִיתִי Ho 14:9, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יַעֲנֶה Gn 41:16 +, וַיַּעַן Am 7:14 +, sf. יַעֲנֵנִי Jb 20:3 +, etc.; Imv. עֲנֵה Mi 6:3, Pr 26:5 etc.; Inf. cstr. עֲנוֺת Gn 45:3 + [2 S 22:36 v. עֲנָוָה]; Pt. עֹנֶה Ju 19:28 +, etc.;—1. answer, respond to sthg. said, actual or implied, Ju 8:8, 1 S 4:20, Jb 9:15 +; esp. a. of men, c. acc. Pers. Gn 45:3 (E), Ju 5:29, 2 K 18:36 = Is 36:21, Jb 5:1 + very oft. (c. 110 t.); specif. be responsive, i.e. answer kindly, grant request 1 K 12:7 (sf. Pers.); = be amenable, docile (toward ´י) Ho 2:17 (of Isr. in fig.); seldom and late, c. acc. of thing replied to, Jb 32:12, 33:13 (De Di Bu), 40:2. b. of God answering (graciously): usu. c. acc. Pers.; by oracle 1 S 14:37, 28:6, 28:15 +, fig. Hb 2:11; by deed 1 S 7:9, 1 K 18:37, 18:37, cf. בָּאֵשׁ v:24, 1 Ch 21:26, and esp. Ho 2:23, 2:24, 14:9, v. also Mi 3:4, Is 41:17, 49:8, Je 33:3, Jb 12:4 +, esp. PsalmPsalm, e.g. 3:5, 4:2, 20:2 + 33 t., etc. (in all c. 77 t.). c. rarely c. acc., or cl., of answer: אֶת־שְׁלוֺם פַּרְעֹה ´אלהים יַע Gn 41:16, Jb 15:2, Pr 18:23; Ne 8:6 they responded, Amen ! 2 S 19:43 they made reply against Isr. (c. עַל against, only here), + quoted answer; c. acc. Pers. + answer 1 S 20:28 Jonathan answered Saul, David asked leave, etc.; c. 2. acc. (c. 20 t.) 2 K 18:36 = Is 36:21, Jb 23:5 +; so = grant, vouchsafe to, נוֺרָאוֺת תַּעֲנֵנוּ Psalm 65:6 terrible things dost thou [´י] vouchsafe to us. d. oft. + אָמַר Gn 18:27 Abr. answered and said, Ex 4:1 (J), 19:8 (E), Jb 4:1 6:1 etc.; + אָמַר אֶ־ל Gn 27:39 + 16 t.; + לְ ´א v:37 + 8 t.; ´י + acc. Pers. + אמר, 1 S 9:8 he answered Saul and said, + 23t. (in all c. 130 t.); seldom + לֵאמֹר † Nu 32:31 (P), ´ע + acc. Pers. + ´עא Gn 23:5, 23:10, 23:14 (P), 41:16, 42:22 (E), Jos 1:16 (D) †. e. seldom + דִּבֶּר Jos 22:21 (P), 2 K 1:10, 1:11, 1:12; ´ע + acc. Pers. + ´ר Gn 34:13 (P). 2. a. respond to an occasion, speak in view of circumstances : 1 S 9:17 (acc. Pers. + quot.), Ju 18:14 ( + אָמַר), Nu 11:28 (JE ; + id.), 2 K 1:11 (+ id.), + 19 t. b fig. יַעֲנֶה אֶת־הַכֹּל Ec 10:19; money meets all demands. †3. a. specif. respond as a witness, testify, so perh. pt. עֹנֶה (abs.) Mal 2:12 (in good sense); c. בְּ Pers.= in the case of = for Gn 30:33; usu. against, 1 S 12:3, 2 S 1:16, Is 3:9, 59:12, Mi 6:3, Je 14:7, Nu 35:30 (P), Ru 1:21 (> Be be occupied with, II. ענה; Vrss Luth KitKau עִנָּה humiliate); c. בְּפָנָיו Ho 5:5, 7:10, Jb 16:8; c. לְפָנָיו Dt 31:21 (+ לְעֵד as witness); c. בְּ Pers. + acc. of charge, סָרָה 19:16, of false witness שֶׁקֶר v:18, עֵד־שֶׁקֶר Ex 20:16 (Ginsb v13), ‖ Dt 5:17, Pr 25:18: abs. (bad implic.) Ex 23:2 (E ; עַל concerning). b. less oft. make response as one accused (respondent) Jb 9:14, 9:15. †Niph. 1. make answer, subj. ´י, c. ל Pers., Pf. 1 S. נַעֲנֵיתִי Ez 14:4; Pt. נַעֲנֶה (Qal not in Ez). 2. be answered: Impf. 3 ms. יֵעָנֶה, a. Jb 11:2 (subj. words). b. of man = receive answer Pr 21:3, so 1 S. אֵעָנֶה Jb 19:7. † Hiph. Pt. מַעֲנֶה בְּשִמְחַת לִבּוֺ Ec 5:19, wholly dub.; Hi (God) causes (all things) to respond in the joy of his heart; De answers to the joy, etc.; de Jong Wild occupies him (II. עָנָה) with the joy, etc.

(213 t.) c. prep.: c. בְּ (142 t.), esp. הַהִוא ´בָּע Gn 21:22 (E) in that time, 38:1 (J), Nu 22:4 (E), Dt 1:9 + 14 t. Dt; הַהִיא ´בָּע Jos 5:2 Am 5:13, Dn 12:1, 12:1. + (69 t., not in P); הַזּאֹת ´בָּע Est 4:14, בָּעִתִּים הָהֵם 2 Ch 15:5, Dn 11:14; בְּכָל־עֵת at all times Ex 18:22, 18:26 (E), Lv 16:2 (P) Psalm 34:2 +; = continually Pr 8:30, בְּכָל־עֵת אֲשֶׁר Est 5:13 as long as I see Mordecai; c. לְ (31 t.; cf. ל 6, p. 516 supr.), 2 S 11:1 + at the time, but Ez 12:27 for distant times, cf. לְעֵת כָּזאֹת Est 4:14, etc.; c. כְּ (21 t.; cf. כ 1 a, p. 453 supr.), †הַזּאֹת ´מָחָר כָּע Jos 11:6 (JE) tomorrow about this time, usu. מָחָר ´כָּע (KöSynt. 401 o) Ex 9:18 (J), 1 S 9:16 (cf. Dr), 20:12, 1 K 19:2, 20:6, 2 K 7:1, 7:18, 10:6 †; כָּעֵת חַיָה v. p. 312; † כָּעֵת הָרִאשׁוֺן Is 8:23 at the former time; כָּעֵת alone Nu 23:23 (JE) at this time = now (prob., cf. Di), Ju 13:23, 21:22 †, etc.; c. מִן (8 t.), מִן הָעֵת הַהִא Ne 13:21, etc.; c. עַד (12 t.), הַהִיא ´עַד־הָע Ne 6:1 up to that time, מֵעֵת עַד־עֵת Ez 4:10, 4:11 etc. (5 t. Dn); c. א־ל, מֵעֵת אֶל־עֵת 1 Ch 9:25. b oft. cstr. defined by n.foll.: בְּעֵת צָהֳרָיִם Je 20:16, עֶרֶב(הָ)לְעֵת 2 S 11:12, Gn 8:11, 24:11 (both J), Is 17:14, Zc 14:7; עַד־עֵת הָעָרֶב Jos 8:29 (JE), כְּעֵת מִנְחַת עֶרֶב Dn 9:21, redundantly לְעֶת־יוֺם בְּיוֺם 1 Ch 12:22, קָצִיר(ה) ´ע Je 50:16, 51:33, הַוָּמִיר ´ע Ct 2:12, וִקְנָה ´ע 1 K 11:4, 15:23, Psalm 71:9, אַפְּ ´בְּע Je 18:23 = פָּנְיְ ´לְע Psalm 21:10 (of anger), לְעִתּוֺת בַּצָּרָה 9:10, 10:1 at time destitution (v. בַּצָּרָה), etc. c. sq. inf. בּוֺא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ ´לְע Jos 10:27 (JE), 2 Ch 18:34, קָרְאָם ´בְּע Je 11:14a (rd. בְּעֵת also vb, Gie), etc. d. sq. cl. c. vb. fin. (poet. or late) Dt 32:35, Jb 6:17, 2 Ch 20:22, 24:11, 29:27 + (cf. 2 c). 2. a. = usual time: צֵאת ´לְע 2 S 11:1 at time of kings' going forth = 1 Ch 20:1; בְּעֵת יַחֵם Gn 31:10; עֵת לֶדֶת Jb 39:1, 39:2. b. proper, suitable time: rain בְּעִתּוֺ Dt 11:14, Je 5:24 +, cf. Lv 26:4 (H), also Psalm 1:3, 104:27, 145:15, Pr 15:23, Is 60:22, Ec 3:11 עֵת מִלְחָמָה v:8; שָׁלוֺם ´ע v:8; sq. inf. Ho 10:12, הַעֵת לָקַחַת 2 K 5:26 is it a time to take money? Hg 1:4, עֶת־בֵּית לְהִבָּנוֺת ´י v:2 (va read עַתָּ בָּא Hi We Now al.); עֵת לַעֲשוֺת Psalm 119:126, cf. Ec 3:2–8 (26 t.); abs. כִּי עֵת Ho 13:13 (Hi We al.; GuKau gives עַתָּ; > Now כָּעֵת); abs. c. neg. Jb 22:16, Ec 7:17; hence (late) יוֺדְעֵי בִינָה לָעִתִּים 1 Ch 12:32, יִדְעֵי הָעִתִּים Est 1:13 i.e. astrologers, etc. c. appointed time, ´בְּעֵת תֵּת וגו 1 S 18:19 at the appointed time of giving, Ez 7:7, 7:12, Is 13:22, פְּקֻדָּתָם ´ע Je 8:12, 10:15 = 51:18, 46:21, 50:27 cf. (c. vb. fin.) 6:15, 49:8, 50:31, אַרְצוֺ ´ע Je 27:7, גּוֺיִם ´ע Ez 30:3, לְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים Ezr 10:14, Ne 10:35 cf.13:31; מוֺעֵד ´עַד־ע 2 S 24:15, Psalm 103:14 (‖מוֺעֵד), etc.; cf. עֵת וּמִשְׁפָּט Ec 8:5, 8:6 (for time of judgment), עִתּוֺ 9:12; esp. לְעֵת קֵץ Dn 8:7 cf. 11:35, 11:40, 12:4, 12:9, עֲוֺן קֵץ ´כְּע Ez 21:30, 21:34 cf. 35:5; לְקֵץ הָעִתִּים Dn 11:13. d. as uncertain עֵת וָפֶגַע Ec 9:11. 3. = experiences, fortunes, pl. אֱמוּנַת עִתֶּיְ Is 33:6, Psalm 31:16; הָעִתִּים אֲשֶׁר עָֽבְרוּ עָלָיו 1 Ch 29:30 †4. occurrence, occasions (= פַּעַם), רַבּוֺת עִתִּיס Ne 9:28 great numbers of times (= very often).

title: II עָנָה
content:
[Str6031] † II. [עָנָה] vb. be occupied, busied with (ב), only Ec (perh. Aram. loan-word; Syr. ܥܢܳܐ be occupied with, ܥܶܢܝܳܢ occupation, affair; cf. Ar. عنى, عَنَا concern one, also be occupied by; Ecclus 42:8 marg.);—Qal Inf. עֲנוֺתִ Ec 1:13, 3:10.

[Str6045] † עִנְיָן n.m.:Ec 1:13 occupation, task, only Ec (Aram. loan-word LagBN 205; common in NH);—´ע abs. Ec 2:26, 3:10, 5:2, 8:16; sf. כַּעַס עִנְיָנוֺ 2:23 his task is (sheer) vextion; עִנְיָן רָע 1:13 an evil (worthless) task, so 4:8 (Mass. עִנְיַן as if cstr., v. Baer1; Baer13; but Köii, 1, 99), and, in weakened sense, 5:12 a bad business, bad affair.

[Str4618] † מַעֲנָה n.f. place for task (?), specif. field for ploughing:—pl. sf. לְמַעֲנוֺתָם Psalm 129:3 Kt they have extended their ploughing-grounds (Qr מַעֲנִיתָם); sg. מַעֲנָה only 1 S 14:14, where text corrupt and meaning dub. v. Comm.

[Str4618] מַעֲנִית Psalm 129:3 Qr v. foregoing.

title: עָנָה
content:
[Str6031] † III.. [עָנָה] vb. be bowed down, afflicted ( NH id.; MI Pi. ויענו l5, אענו l6; As. enû thwart, frustrate, do violence to; Ar. عنو, عَنَا be lowly subsmissive, v. Rahlfs: עָנִי und עָנָי in d. Psalmen (1892), 67 ff.; Targum עַנִּי Pa. oppress; Syr. Ethpe. humble oneself, and deriv.);—Qal Pf. 1 S. עָנִיתִי Psalm 116:10; Impf. 3 ms. יַעֲנֶה Is 25:5, 31:4, etc.;—1. be put down or become low, of song of triumph Is 25:5 (others as Hiph. he putteth down, ‖תַּכְנִיעַ). 2. be depressed, downcast Is 31:4 (of lion; ‖יֵחָת). 3. be afficted Psalm 116:10, 119:67, Zc 10:2. Niph. Pf. 1 S. נַעֲניתִי Psalm 119:107; Inf. cstr. לֵעָנֹת (perh. rd. as Qal Ges§ 51 l) Ex 10:3; Pt. נַעֲנֶה Is 53:7; fs. נַעֲנָה 58:10; —1. humble oneself מִפְּנֵי Ex 10:3. 2. be afficted Psalm 119:107, Is 53:7, 58:10. Piel. Pf. 3 ms. עִנָּה Dt 22:24 + 5 t.; 2 ms. עִנִּיתָ Psalm 88:8; 1 S. עִנֵּיתִי Psalm 35:13, sf. וְעִנִּתִךְ consec. Na 1:12, etc.; Impf. יְעַנֶּה Jb 37:23, etc,; Imv. עַנּוּ Ju 19:24; Inf. abs. עַנֵּה Ex 22:22; cstr. עַנּוֺת Is 58:5 + , etc.; Pt. pl. sf. מְעַנַּיִךְ Is 60:14, Zp 3:19; —1 humble, mishandle, afflict: individual Gn 16:6, 31:50 (J) Ex 22:21, 22:22, 22:22 (E) Jb 30:11; by imprisonment and bonds Ju 16:5, 16:6, 16:19, Psalm 105:18; a nation by war or in bondage Gn 15:13 (J) Ex 1:11, 1:12, Nu 24:24, 24:24 (E) Dt 26:6, 1 S 12:8 (inserting וַיְעַנּוּם מִצְרַיִם, so LXX Dr Bu Kit HPS [cf. Th We]), 2 S 7:10, 2 K 17:20, Psalm 94:5, Is 60:14, Zp 3:19; dynasty of David Psalm 89:23. 2. humble, a woman by cohabit., Gn 34:2 (J) Dt 21:14, 22:24, 22:29, Ju 19:24, 20:5, 2 S 13:12, 13:14, 13:22, 13:32, Ez 22:10, 22:11, La 5:11. 3. afflict as a discipline (God agent) Dt 8:2, 8:3, 8:16, 1 K 11:39, Psalm 88:8, 90:15, 119:75, Is 64:11, Na 1:12, 1:12, La 3:33. 4. humble, weaken, obj. כֹּחַ Psalm 102:24; משׁפט Jb 37:23 (cf. Talm. עִנָּה דִּין); נֶפֶשׁ oneself, by fasting Lv 16:29, 16:31, 23:27, 23:32, Nu 29:7 (P) Psalm 35:13, Is 58:3, 58:5; by an oath Nu 30:14 (P). Pu. Pf. 1 S. עֻנֵּיתִי Psalm 119:71; Impf. 3 fs. תְּעֻנֶּה Lv 23:29; Inf. cstr. sf. עֻנּוֺתוֺ Psalm 132:1; Pt. מְעֻנֶּה Is 53:4; —1. be afflicted, in discipline by God Psalm 119:71, 132:1, Is 53:4. 2. be humbled by fasting Lv 23:29 (P). Hiph. Impf. 2 ms. sf. תַּעֲנֵם 1 K 8:35 = 2 Ch 6:26 afflict, in discipline. Hithp. Pf. 3 ms. הִתְעַנָּה 1 K 2:26; 2 ms. תִתְעַנִּיתָ v:26; Impf. 3 mpl. יִתְעַנּוּ Psalm 107:17; Imv. הִתְעַנִּי Gn 16:9; Inf. cstr. הִתְעַנּוֺת Ez 8:21, Dn 10:12; —1. humble oneself (c. תַּחַת יָדֶיהָ) Gn 16:9 (J). 2. be afflicted, by men 1 K 2:26, 2:26; by God in discipline Psalm 107:17. 3. humble oneself in fasting Ezr 8:21, Dn 10:12.

[Str6035,6041,6041] † עָנָי (?; LagBN 48) n.m. poor, afflicted, humble, meek;—עָנָו Nu 12:3 (Kt; Qr עָנָיו is to ensure the —ָ acc. to Di Köii. 1. 76); elsewh. pl. עֲנָוִים Is 29:19 + 11 t. + Kt עֲנָוִים Is 32:7, Psalm 9:19 (Qr עֲנִיִּים); Qr עֲנָוִים Psalm 9:13, 10:12, Pr 3:34, 14:21, 16:19 (Kt עניים); cstr. עַנְוֵי Zp 2:3 + 2 t., + Kt ענוי (Qr עֲנִיֵּי) Am 8:4 (so Jb 24:4 van d. H.; but עֲנִיֵּי Kt and Qr Baer Ginsb)—these forms shew confusion with עָנִי, which is perh. only another form of עָנָו (otherwise Rahlfsop. cit. 62 f. Dr:‘Poor’ in HastingsDB; עָנָו = humble, meek, עָנִי = pass. humbled, afflicted);—1. poor, needy, Pr 14:21 (Qr). 2. poor and weak. oppressed by rich and powerful Am 2:7, Is 29:19, 32:7 (Kt); ארץ(ה)ענוי Psalm 76:10, Is 11:4, Zp 2:3, Am 8:4 (Kt), Jb 24:4. 3. poor, weak and afflicted Israel (usu. rendered meek) Psalm 10:17, 22:27, 25:9, 25:9, 34:3, 37:11, 69:33 (עָנִי 3, also in all these Psalm Psalm), 147:6, 149:4, Is 61:1 (‖נשׁברי לב, cf. 66:2 עָנִי 3), Psalm 9:19 (Kt) v:13, 10:12 (Qr). 4. humble, lowly, meek Nu 12:3 (Moses); Pr 3:34, 16:19 (both Qr).

[Str6037–38] † עֲנָוָה n.f. humility:—Pr 15:33 + 3 t.; עַנְוָ־ה (contr. because of Maqqeph, see BrMp) Psalm 45:5; עֶנְוָֽתְ Psalm 18:36 (= עֲנֹתְ 2 S 22:36 v.I. ענה; rd. עֶזְרָֽתְח Ol We);—1. humility, meekness Psalm 45:5 (dub.), Pr 15:33, 18:12, 22:4, Zp 2:3 (prob. gloss, v. We Now). 2. condescension Psalm 18:36 (dub., v. supr.).

[Str6039] † עֱָנוּת n.f. affliction:—Psalm 22:25; CheJBL xv (1896), 198 prop. צַעֲקַת cry [cf. LXX Vulgate Targum], (צ dropped out after ץ).

[Str6041] † עָנִי adj poor, afflicted, humble;—´ע Dt 24:12 + 51 t.; pl. עֲיִּים Is 3:15 + 6 t.; cstr. עֲנִיֵּי Is 10:2 + 4 t. (v. also Kt and Qr sub עָנָו supr.); sf. עֲנִיֶּיְ Psalm 72:2, 74:19, עֲנִֶ+יְּ Dt 15:11, עֲנִיָּו Is 49:13; fs. עֲנִיָּה Is 51:21, 54:11 ( + Is 10:30 MT, but rd. עֲנִיהָ, v. I. ענה);—1. poor, needy, ‖אביון Dt 15:11, 24:14, 24:15, Pr 31:20, ‖יתום Jb 24:9, Ex 22:24 (E), Dt 24:12; having right to gleanings Lv 19:10, 23:22 (H); ´יְמֵי ע Pr 15:15, cf. Pr 14:21 (Kt). 2. poor and weak, oppressed by the rich and powerful Is 3:14, 3:15, 32:7 (Qr), 58:7, 29:12, 36:6, 36:15, Pr 30:14, Ec 6:8, Ez 18:17, Zc 7:10, Jb 24:4, also Am 8:4 (Qr); ‖דל Jb 34:28, Pr 22:22; עֲנִיֵּי עַמִּי Is 10:2; עני ואביוך Jb 24:14, Pr 31:9, Je 22:16, Ez 16:49, 18:12, 22:29. 3. poor, weak, afflicted Israel, or pious in Israel afflicted by wicked nations or the wicked in Israel itself Psalm 10:2, 10:9, 10:9, 14:6 (dub., cf. Psalm 53:6) 102:1 (or n.pr.), Is 14:32, Hb 3:14; of Zion, עֲנִיָּה Is 51:21, 54:11; ´שׁד ע Psalm 12:6; ´יחיד וע 25:16; עני ואביון 35:10, 37:14, 40:18 = 70:6, 74:21, 86:1, 109:16, 109:22, pl. Is 41:17; עני וְכוֺאֵב Psalm 69:30; וָרָשׁ ´ע 82:3; ´עֱנוּת ע 22:25; וְגֹוֵעַ ´ע 88:16; ‖דל Is 26:6, Zp 3:12; וּנְכֵה־רוּחַ ´ע Is 66:2; —Zc 11:7, 11:11 v. II. כְּנַעֲנִי;—God does not forget them Psalm 9:13, 9:19, 10:12 (Kt) 74:19, but has compassion on them Is 49:13, saves Psalm 34:7, delivers 35:10, and bestows various favours 68:11, 140:13, the king also judges 72:2, 72:4, and delivers 72:12. 4. humble, lowly, Zc 9:9 (victorious king); opp. לֵצִים Pr 3:34 (Kt); opp. גֵּאִים 16:19 (Kt); עם עני opp. רמות עינים Psalm 18:28 = 2 S 22:28.

[Str6040] † עֳנִי n. m. affliction, poverty;—´ע Ex 3:7 +; עָֹנִי Dt 16:3 +, עָוֺנִי Psalm 107:41, עוני 2 S 16:12 (Kt, but rd. עָנְיִי; > Qr עֵינִי !); sf. עָנְיִי Gn 31:42 +, עָנְיֵח 16:11, etc.;—1. affliction, Jb 36:15, 36:21, Psalm 44:25, 88:10, 107:41, 119:50, 119:92, La 1:3, 3:19; ´ארץ ע Gn 41:52 (E); ´יְמֵי ע Jb 30:16, 30:27, La 1:7; ´כּוּר ע Is 48:10; ´חַבְלֵי ע Jb 36:8; ´אֲסִירֵי ע Psalm 107:10; ´בְּנֵי ע Pr 31:5; ´ראה ע Gn 31:42 (E), Ex 3:7, 4:31 (J), Dt 26:7, 2 K 14:26, Ne 9:9, Jb 10:15, Psalm 9:14, 25:18, 31:8, 119:153, La 1:9, 3:1, ins. also before עַמִּי 1 S 9:16 b LXX Th We Dr Kit Bu HPS; ´ראה בע Gn 29:32 (J), 1 S 1:11, 2 S 16:12 (v. supr.); ´שׁמע ע Gn 16:11 (J); ´העלה מע Ex 3:17 (J); לחם עני Dt 16:3. 2. poverty, בְּעָנְיִי הכינותי זהב 1 Ch 22:14.

[Str8589] † [תַּעֲנִית] n. f. humiliation, by fasting (cf. √ Pi. Hithp.; NH ´ת = fasting), sf. תַּעֲנִיתִי Ez 9:5.

title: IV עָנָה
content:
[Str6030] †IV. עָנָה vb. sing (Ar. غَنَّ sing, chant, غِنَآءٌ singing, chanting, etc.; Syr. ܥܰܢܺܝ sing responsively, ܥܽܘܢܺܝܬܳܐ hymn, refrain; poss. As. enû, resound (?); Egypt. anni is loan-word acc. to Bondi80);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. וְעָנוּ consec. Je 51:14; Impf. 3 ms. יַעַנֶה Je 25:30; 3 fs. וַתַּעַן Ex 15:21; 3 fpl. וַתַּעֲנֶינָה 1 S 18:7, etc.; Imv. עֱנוּ Nu 21:17, Psalm 147:7; Inf. cstr. עֲנוֺת Ex 32:18; 32:18; —sing, utter tunefully, Ex 15:21 (E) and Miriam sang to (ל) them; of uttering shout (הֵידָד), as in vintage Je 25:30 (´י subj.; + אֶ־ל Pers.), in attack 51:14 (+ עַ־ל Pers.); (חֲלוּשָׁה) קוֺל עֲנוֺת גְּבוּרָה Ex 32:18, 32:18 (E); c. ל rei vel Pers. laudat. Nu 21:17 (JE; well); Psalm 147:7 (´י; ‖זַמְּרוּ), Ezr 3:11; + אָמַר 1 S 18:7 the women sang, and said; יַעֲנוּ בַמְּחֹלוֺת לֵאמֹר 21:12, 29:5; c. acc. rei laudat. Psalm 119:172 (cf. ‖ v:171).—Is 14:22 v. עון Pi. intens.: Imv. עַנּוּ־לָהּ Is 27:2 sing sweetly of it; Inf. קוֺל עַנּוֺת Ex 32:18 (E) the sound of distinct singing; cf. לְעַנּוֺת Psalm 88:1.

[Str6034] עֲנָה:12 n. pr. m Horites:—1. Gn 36:2 (read הַחֹרִי for הַחִוִּי v. Di) v:14, v:18, v:20, v:25, v:25, v:29 = 1 Ch 1:38, 1:41. 2. (‘nephew’ of 1.) Gn 36:24, 36:24 = 1 Ch 1:40.—Ανα, Α(ι)να(ν) (cf. n. pr. m. ען, Safa, HalJAs 7, x, 374).

[Str6042] ענו Kt v. עֻנִּי. עֲנוֺק v. 1. עֲנָק. below, p. 778

title: ענז
content:
ענז (√ of foll.; Köii. 1, 38 cp. Ar. عَنَزَ turn aside, whence [fr. movements] عَنْزٌ goat, cf. As. enzu; Syr. ܥܢܙ, cstr. ܥܢܶܙ; also ܥܰܢܙܳܐ; ܥܰܢܳܙܳܐ goat-herd; Ph. Palm. עז; NH עֵז (rare)).

[Str5795] עֵז:74 n. f.:Gn 15:9 she-goat;—abs. ´ע Gn 15:9 + 6 t.; pl. עַזִּים 27:9 + 65 t.; sf. עִזֶּיְ 31:38; —† 1. as property Gn 30:32, 30:33, 30:35 (J), 31:15, 31:38 (E), 1 S 25:2. 2. as food: עִזִּים (גְּדִי)גְּדָיֵי kid(s) of she-goats Gn 27:9, 27:16 (J) + 7 t., שְעִיר עִזִּים 37:31 (J) a buck of goats, he-goat, שֵה עִזִּים Dt 14:4 a (n individual) goat; cf. Lv 7:23 (P; fat forbidden); also ´חֲלֵב ע Pr 27:27 goats’ milk. 3. as sacrificial victim, chiefly P: a. in gen. Lv 22:27 (H), Nu 15:11. † b. in בְּרִית Gn 15:9 (JE; cf. v:18). † c. פֶּסַח Ex 12:5 (שֶה), בְּנֵי עִזִּים 2 Ch 35:7. † d. עוֺלָה Lv 22:19 (H), 1:10, Nu 28:30 (´שְעִיר ע). † e. זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים Lv 3:12, 17:3 (H; cf. v:5), אִשֶּׁה Nu 18:17 (´בְּכוֺר ע). f. חַטָּאת, ´שְעִיר ע Ez 43:22, 45:23, Lv 4:23 + 3 t. Lv, Nu 7:16 + 19 t. Nu; שְעִירַת עִזִּים a single she-goat Lv 4:28, 5:6; עְפִרֵי זִּים 2 Ch 29:21 he-goats. 4. עִזִּים = goats’ hair, as material 1 S 19:13, 19:16, Ex 25:4 + 6 t. P (35:26 obj. of טָווּ!). † 5. in sim. חֲשַפֵי עִזִּים 1 K 20:27 (v. [חָשִיף]); ´כְּעֵדַר הָע Ct 4:1, 6:5, of flowing, undulating hair. † 6. ´צְפִיר הָע Dn 8:5, 8:8 he-goat in vision.

[Str6042] † עֻנִּי n.pr.m. Levites:—1. 1 Ch 15:18, 15:20, ωνει, LXXL Ανανιας. 2. Ne 12:9 Qr (Kt ענו), Ιανα(ι) .

[Str6043] † עֲנָיָה n.pr.m. Ne 8:4, 10:23, Ανανια(ς).

עָנָיו v. עָנָו sub III. ענה. עָנִים v. p. 745.

עִנְיָן v. II. [ענה]. עָנֵם v. עֵין גְּנִּים.

[Str6047] † עֲנָמִים n.pr.gent. in (or near) Egypt Gn 10:13 = 1 Ch 1:11, Αινειαμιειμ, Αινεμετιειμ, etc.; form dub. and locality unknown, v. conj. in Di.

[Str6048] † עֲנַמֶּ֫לֶךְ n.pr.div. of סְפַרְוַיִם (q. v.) 2 K 17:31, Ανημελεχ (om. LXXL); = As. Anu-malik acc. to SchrCOT ad loc., but dub., v. Kitad loc. and reff.; CheExpos. Times, June, 1898, 429 rds. ענומלך, and ins. also 2 K 19:37 (bef. אלהיו); cf. also Hal cited sub עֲנָת.

title: I ענן
content:
I. ענן (√ of foll., perh. orig. cover, as Sab. ענן = טַלל (Heb. חלל), DHMEpigr. Denkm. 26 f.; or < Ar.عَنَّ appear, present oneself, specif. intervene as an obstacle (Lane; cf. LagBN 103), hence عَنَانٌ clouds, as intervening, and so obstructing; cf. NH עָנָן cloud = BH (rare), vb. denom. Pi. עִנֵּן as BH; Targum עֲנָנָא, Syr. clouds).

[Str6051] I. עָנָן:87 n. m:Ex 19:16 cloud-mass, cloud;—´ע(הֶ) abs. Ex 19:9 +; cstr. עֲנַזִ Ho 6:4 +; sf. עֲנֽנְ Nu 14:14, עֲנָנוֺ Jb 26:9, 37:15; pl. עֲנִים Je 4:13; —1. cloud-mass: a. esp. of theophanic cloud (58 t.), chiefly at Exodus in JE (less oft. P), usu. ´עַמּוּד הֶע Ex 13:21; 13:22 + (v. עַמּוּד), but also ´ע alone Ex 34:5 cf. 14:20 (J), Nu 10:34, 11:35, 14:14 (all JE); ´עַב־הֶע Ex 19:9, כָּבֵד ´ע v:16 (E); ´ע in P Ex 16:10, 24:15 + 23 t.; also Dt 1:33, 4:11, 5:19, Psalm 78:14, 105:39; in temple 1 K 8:10, 8:11 = 2 Ch 5:13, 5:14, cf. Ez 1:4, 10:3, 10:4; hence in gen. Psalm 97:2, as symbol of protection Is 4:5; as a barrier La 3:44; cf. אֲבַק רַגְלָיו ´וע Na 1:3. b. of rain-bow cloud Gn 9:13, 9:14, 9:14, 9:16 (P), Ez 1:28 (sim.). c. עֲנַן־בֹּקֶר Ho 6:4, 13:3 (sim. of transitoriness; on phenom. in Pal. v. ChaplinPEQ, 1883, 19), cf. Is 44:22, Jb 7:9 (both id.); sim. of invasion Ez 38:9, 38:16, pl. Je 4:13. d. poet. in various connex. Jb 26:8, 26:9, 38:9; c. אוֺר as thunder-cloud 37:11, 37:15. e. symbol. of gloom Ez 30:18, 32:7; וַעֲרָפֶל ´יוֺם ע Zp 1:15, Ez 34:12, Jo 2:2, cf. Ez 30:3 (all of day of ´ע). † 2. קְטֹרֶת ´ע Lv 16:13 (P) cloud of incense, so Ez 8:11 (del. ´ע LXX Co Berthol, not Toy).

[Str6049] † [עָנַן] vb. denom. Pi. Inf. cstr. sf. c. acc. cogn. עַל־הָאָרֶץ ´בְּעַנְנִי ע Gn 9:14 (P) when I bring clouds, etc.

[Str6053] † עֲנָנָה n. f. cloud (Ges§ 122 t) Jb 3:5.

title: II עָנַן
content:
[Str6049] †II. [עָנַן] vb. Pō‘. practice soothsaying (prob. denom., but orig. meaning dub.; connex. with 1. עָנָן (De1s 2, 6) now gen. abandoned; LöwZMG xxxi (1877), 539 cp. עַיִן eye, so WeSkizzen iii. 148 (but v. infr.); RSJPhil xiv (1885), 119 f. cp. Ar. غُنَّةٌ nasal twang, hum of insects, whence diviners as crooning; Ew Gerber31 of diviner as interpreting hum of insects, whisper of leaves, etc.; WeHeid. 2, 204 now cp. عَنَّ appear, i. e. dealers in phenomena);—Pf. 3 ms. consec. וְעוֺנֵן 2 K 21:6 = 2 Ch 33:6; Impf. 2 mpl. וְלאֹ תְעוֵֺ+ננוּ Lv 19:26 (H); Pt. as subst. מְעוֺנֵן Dt 18:10 (forbidden), pl. מְעֹנְנִים v:14, ´מְעוֺ Mi 5:11, אֵלוֺן מְעוֺנְנִים Ju 9:37 (v. 1. אֵלוֺן; seat of an oracle, cf. RS Sem i. 179 2nd ed. 196); also (without מְ, cf. Sta§ 233 Köi. 349) עֹנְנִים Is 2:6, sf. עֹנְנֵיכֶם Je 27:9; fs. in בְּנֵי עֹנְנָה Is 57:3 sons of a soothsaying woman, fig. of apostates.—Vid. כִּשֵּׁף, II. [נָחַשׁ], [קָסַם].

[Str6052] †II. עָנָן n.pr.m. Ne 10:27, Ηναμ, Η(ι)ναν (cf. n.pr.m. Sab. ענן SabDenkm30; Palm. ענני).

[Str6054] † עֲנָנִי n.pr.m. 1 Ch 3:24, Μανει, Ανανι(ας).

[Str6055] † עֲנַנְיָה n.pr. 1. m. Ne 3:23, Ανανια(ς). 2. loc. Ne 11:32, Ανανια, Ανια; perh. mod. Beit Ḫanîna, c. 4 miles NNW. from Jerusalem, cf. BuhlGeogr. 167.

title: ענף
content:
ענף (√ of foll.; meaning unknown; NH עָנָף = BH, Targum עַנְפָּא (both rare), Syr. ܥܢܳܦܳܐ).

[Str6057] † עָנָף n. [m.] branch(es), bough(s);—usu. sg. coll., abs. ´ע branches of vine Ez 17:8, pl. only sf. עֲנָפֶיהָ Psalm 80:11 (both in fig.); boughs of tree, cstr. עֲנַף Lv 23:40, sf. (as if from …עֶנֶף Köii. 1, 74) עַנְפְּכֶם Ez 36:8; sg. abs. (in fig.) Mal 3:19, of cedar Ez 17:23, 31:3.

[Str6058] † [עָנֵף] adj. full of branches;—fs. עֲנֵפָה Ez 19:10 (of vine, in fig.).

title: ענק
content:
ענק (√ of foll., mng. dub.; cf. Ar. عُنُقٌ, عُنْقٌ neck, Targum עוּנְקָא; also עִינְקָא necklace, Syr. ܥܶܩܳܐ; Eth. ዕምቈ gem; vbs. denom. in Ar., Eth., NH).

[Str6061,6062] †I. עֲנָק n. [m.] neck, only in epith. gent. בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק long-necked (tall) men, early giant people about Hebron and in Philistia, Ενακ, Εναχ, Jos 15:14 (JE) = Ju 1:20, without art. Nu 13:33 (JE), Dt 9:2; also ´יְלִדַי הָע Nu 13:22, 13:28, Jos 15:14 (all JE); called also עֲנָקִים long-necks, Ενακειμ, Jos 14:12, 14:15 (JE), 11:21, 11:22 (D), Dt 2:10, 2:11, 2:21 + Je 47:5 (rd. עֲנָקִים for MT עִמְקָם), and perh. 1 Ch 12:16 (v. עֵמֶק ad fin.); בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים 1:28 (LXX γίγαντες, cf. Nu 13:33), 9:2; עֲנָק later (erron.) as eponym. ancestor of Anaḳim Jos 15:13 = עֲנוֺק 21:11 (both P).—Vid. esp. MeyZAW i (1881), 139 GFMJu 1:10, 1:20 CheEncy. Bib. ANAK.

[Str6060] †II. עֲנָק n. m.:Ct 4:9 necklace, neck-pendant (Aramaism acc. to LagBN 175);—abs. ´ע Ct 4:9 appar. part of necklace, perh. neck-pendant; pl. עֲנָקוֺת Ju 8:26 (ornament of camels), עֲנָקִים Pr 1:9 (of youth; in fig.).

[Str6059] † [עָנַק] vb. denom. serve as necklace;—Qal 3 fs. sf. עֲנָקַתְמוֺ Psalm 73:6 pride is necklace for them. Hiph. Impf. and Inf. abs. הַעֲנֵיק תַּעֲנִיק לוֺ Dt 15:14 thou shalt make a rich necklace for him fr. thy flock, etc., fig. for richly load him.

[Str6063] † עָנֵר n.pr. 1. appar. m. ally of Abram Gn 14:13, 14:24, Αυναν; cf. אֶשְׁכּוֺל, מַמְרֵא. 2. loc. in Manasseh 1 Ch 6:55 Αμαρ, LXXL Ανηρ.

title: ענשׁ
content:
ענשׁ (√ of foll.; mng. dub.; cf. (as denom.) Ph. Niph. [ש]נענ be fined CISi. 165, 20, Palm. ענושותא treasurership; v. also NH עוֺנֶשׁ punishment, עָנַשׁ punish (in general)).

[Str6066] † עֹ֫נֶשׁ n. [m.] indemnity, fine;—´וִיִּתֶּן־ע עַל־הָאָרֶץ 2 K 23:33; of individual ´נשֵֹׁא ע Pr 19:19.

[Str6064] † [עָנַשׁ] vb. denom. (Gerber61 f.) fine, mulct;—Qal Pf. consec. וְעָֽנְשׁוּ Dt 22:19 (2 acc.); Impf. וַיַּעֲנשׁ 2 Ch 36:3 (2 acc.; ‖ 2 K 23:33 supr.); Inf. cstr. עֲנוֺשׁ Pr 17:26 (לְ Pers.); = punish (in gen.) עֲנָ־שׁ 21:11; Pt. pass. עֲנוּשִׁם Am 2:8 those fined, mulcted. Niph. Impf. + Qal Inf. abs. עָנוֺשׁ יֵעָנֵשׁ Ex 21:22 (E) he shall be strictly fined; more gen. Pf. נֶעֱָ+נשׁוּ Pr 22:3 be mulcted, punished = 27:12.

[Str6067,1042–43] † עֲנָת n.pr.m. father of Shamgar Ju 3:31, 5:6, Αναθ (Δειναχ, Κεναθ);—v. also בֵּית עֲנוֺת, עֲנָת ´ב (cf. Tel Am. n. pr. Anati, Wkl125, 43; As. n. pr. deae Anatu (JastrRel. Bab. 153; hence) in Syria and Ph.—also Egypt—ענת (Muss-ArnoltJBL xi (1892), 80 PietschmannPhön. 149 f. HalJAs. 7, x (1877), 374; xiii (1879), 208)).

[Str6068] † עֲנָתוֺת and (1 K 2:26) עֲנָתֹת n.pr. Αναθωθ; 1. loc. (cf. goddess Anat, ref. sub foregoing);—Is 10:30, 1 K 2:26, Je 1:1, 11:21, 11:22, 32:7, 32:8, 32:9, Jos 21:18 (P), 1 Ch 6:45, Ezr 2:23 = Ne 7:27, Ne 11:32; mod. ‘Anâtâ, c. 3 miles NNE. from Jerusalem, cf. BuhlGeogr. 175 GASmGeogr. 315. 2. m. a.1 Ch 7:8. b. Ne 10:20.

[Str6069] † עַנְּתֹתִי adj. gent. of foreg.;—´הָע Je 29:27, 1 Ch 12:3, 2 S 23:27 = הָעַנְּתוֺתִי 1 Ch 11:28, 27:12.

[Str6070] † עַנְתֹתִיָּה n.pr.m. Benjamite 1 Ch 8:24, Ανωθαιθ, Αναθωθ(ι)α.

title: עָסַס
content:
[Str6072] † [עָסַס] vb. press, crush, by treading, tread down (NH עֲסִיסִיה crushed wheat; cf. Ar.عَسَّ go the rounds, [tramp], prowl; Syr. ܥܰܣ explore, v. Brockelmann);—Qal Pf. 2 mpl. fig. הָֽרְשָׁעִים וְעַסּוֺתֶם Mal 3:21 (consec.).

[Str6071] † עָסִיס n.m.:Jo 1:5 sweet wine (prop. pressed out juice);—abs. ´ע Am 9:13 (v. Dr and reff.), Jo 1:5, 4:18; in sim. Is 49:26; cstr. עֲסִיס רִמֹּנִי Ct 8:2.

[Str6073] † עפאים Kt, עֳפָיִם Qr n. [m.] pl. foliage (cf. Ges§ 93 z; Aram. loan-word, Targum עָפְיָא foliage, Syr. ܥܘܽܦܝܳܐ flower, branch);—Psalm 104:12.

title: I עָפַל
content:
[Str6075] †I. עָפַל vb. swell (?; so Thes; inferred fr. deriv.; Ar. عَفَلٌ is a tumour in the vulva or anus, عَفِلَ appar. denom. (cf. II. עֹפֶל) v. As. uplu, prob. tumour (DlHWB 7 ublu, but v. JenTh Lz 1895, 250));—Pu. Pf. 3 fs. עֻפְּלָה Hb 2:4 acc. to MT (subj. נַפְשׁוֺ, cf. GASm); but subst. needed, BrdSK 1889, 121 הַנֶּעֱלָף, We Now הָעַוָּל, cf. GuKau.—Hiph. v. II. עפל. below

[Str6076–77] †I. עֹ֫פֶל n. [m.] mound, hill, only as acropolis;—´ע abs. 2 K 5:24 +, cstr. Mi 4:8; —fortified mound or hill within city, or Jerus. (cf. RobBR i. 267 GuZPV v (1882), 326) Mi 4:8 Is 32:14; S. end of eastern hill Ne 3:26, 11:21, 2 Ch 33:14 ´חוֺמַת הָע Ne 3:27, 2 Ch 27:3 (cf. חמת העפל in קרחה MI21. 22); of Samaria 2 K 5:24.

[Str6076,2890] †II. [עֹ֫פֶל] n.m.:1 S 6:4 tumour;—only pl. Kt עֳפָלִים(בָּ) Dt 28:27, 1 S 5:6, 5:9, 5:12; cstr. עָפְלֵי 6:4; sf. עָפְלֵיכֶם v:5; Qr in all טְחֹרִים(ב), טְחֹרֵי, טְחֹרֵיכֶם, v. [טְחוֺר]. p. 373

title: II עָפַל
content:
[Str6075] †II. [עָפַל] vb. perhaps be heedless (Ar. غَفَلَ be heedless, neglectful, inadvertent);—Hiph. shew heedlessness, Impf. 3 mpl. וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֺת Nu 14:44 (JE) they shewed heedlessness in going up (went up heedlessly), so de Dieu, cited (and allowed) by Di BuhlLex; >Thes al. shewed presumption (I. עפל, this sense dub.).

[Str6078] † עָפְנִי n. pr. loc. in Benj., ´הָע Jos 18:24, LXXL Αφνη.

[Str6079] עפעף v. עוף. p. 733

title: I עפר
content:
I. עפר (√ of foll.; mng. dub.; cf. Ar. عَفَرٌ dust, As. epru, epiru, Tel Am. ḫaparu and aparu (Canaan. glosses); Targum עַפְרָא, Syr. ܥܰܦܪܳܐ; NH עָפָר = BH).

[Str6083] † עָפָר n. m.:Lv 14:42 dry earth, dust;—abs. ´ע Gn 2:7 +, cstr. עֲפַר Gn 13:16 +; sf. עֲפָרֵח Ez 26:12, עֲפָרוֺ Dt 9:21, etc.; pl. cstr. עַפְרֹת Jb 28:6, Pr 8:26; —1. lit.: a. dry, loose earth, thrown (in malice) 2 S 16:13 (‖אֲבָנִים); עַל־ראֹשׁ ´וַיַעֲלוּ ע Jos 7:6 (JE; sign of grief), so Ez 27:30, La 2:10, and (c. זָרַק) Jb 2:12; loose earth (on surface of ground) 1 K 18:38, Am 2:7, Mi 1:10, Is 34:7, 34:9, Lv 17:13 (H) Ez 24:7 (in fig.), Nu 5:17, Jb 14:19, 38:38, 39:14, Gn 26:15 (R), made into siege works Hb 1:10; of sand-storm Dt 28:24 (+ אָבָק); as serpent's food, token of punishment and humiliation, Gn 3:14 (J) Is 65:25 (cf. Mi 7:17 2 e infr.); ´זֹחֲלֵי ע Dt 32:24 (poem; cf. 2 e). b. specif. as material of human body Gn 2:7, 3:19 (J), Ec 3:20, cf. Jb 4:19, 8:19, Psalm 103:14, to which it returns (שׁוּב אֶ־ל) Gn 3:19, Jb 10:9, Psalm 104:29, Ec 3:20; so (c. עַל) Jb 34:15, Ec 12:7. c. = surface of ground Ex 8:12, 8:13, 8:13; (P; הָאָרַץ ´ע), Jb 19:25, Is 25:12, 26:5 (both ‖אֶרֶץ), surface of (whole) earth Jb 41:25, ´מְחִלוֺת ע Is 2:19 (for hiding), so ´ע alone v:10, cf. ´חֹרֵי ע Jb 30:6; = soil, Jb 5:6, 14:8. d. powder of anything pulverized Dt 9:21, 9:21 (cf. דָּק ‖ Ex 32:20), 2 K 23:6, 23:6, 23:12, 23:15, so in sim. 2 S 22:43 = Psalm 18:43, hence = ashes v:4, Nu 19:17. e. debris, of ruined city 1 K 20:10, Ez 26:4, 26:12, Ne 3:34, 4:4, Psalm 102:15. The foll. are late: f. earth of the grave: אֶשְׁכַּב ´לֶע Jb 7:21, so (c. עַל) 20:11, 21:26, cf. 17:16; ´יוֺרְדֵי ע Psalm 22:30, ´שֹׁכְנֵי ע Is 26:19, ´יְשֵׁנֵי אַדְמַת־ע Dn 12:2; tw<m;Arp'[} Psalm 22:16; ´ע in fig. Psalm 30:10. g. mortar (i.e. dried mud) for plastering houses Lv 14:41, 14:42, 14:45 (P). h. (iron-) ore Jb 28:2; עַפְרֹת זָהָב v:6 gold-dust (but v. סַפִּיר). i. material of earth Is 40:12, cf. ראֹשׁ עַפְרֹת תֵּבֵל Pr 8:26 the first of the earth particles of the world. 2. fig.: a. of abundance Gn 13:16, 13:16, 28:14 (all J) 2 Ch 1:9, Jb 27:16, Psalm 78:27 (‖חוֺל יַמִּים), cf. עֲפַר יַעֲקֹב Nu 23:10 (JE); with added idea of commonness, worthlessness Zp 1:7, Zc 9:3. b. of worthlessness (alone) Jb 22:24. c. sim. of the scattered, dispersed 2 K 13:7; ´כֶּע Is 41:2 (so van d. H. Ginsb; Baer ´כֵּע; on meaning v. Du Che, rdg. תְּשִימֵם for יִתֵּן). d. of self-abasement Gn 18:27 (+ אֵפַר), ´וְנִחַמְתִּי עַל־ע וָאֵפֶר Jb 42:6, פִּיהוּ ´יִתֵּן בֶּע La 3:29. e. of humiliation (sitting or lying in dust) Is 47:1 cf. 29:4, 29:4, Jb 16:15, 40:13, Psalm 7:6, 44:26, 119:25, sim. Jb 30:19; licking dust Psalm 72:9, Is 49:23, Mi 7:l7, cf. TelAm. tikalu ipra (of enemies, v. WklAltor. Forsch. iii. 291; also of serpent 1 a supr.); of ´י raising from the dust 1 S 2:8 = Psalm 113:7, 1 K 16:2; of lifting oneself Is 52:2.

[Str6080] † [עָפַר] vb. denom. Pi. וְעִפַּר בֶּעָפָר 2 S 16:13 and kept dusting (him) with dust (throwing [lumps of] dry earth at him).

title: II עפר
content:
II. עפר (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. غُفُرٌ young of mountain-goat, NH עוֺפֶר young of animals).

[Str6082] † עֹ֫פֶר n. m.:Ct 4:5 young hart, stag;—cstr. הָאַיָּלִים ´ע (‖צְבִי) Ct 2:9, 2:17, 8:14; pl. abs. עֳפָרִים תְּאוֺמֵי צְבִיָּה 4:5, 7:4 (all in sim.).

[Str6081] † עֵ֫פֶר n.pr.m. Αφερ, etc.;—1. ‘son’ of Midian Gn 25:4, 1 Ch 1:33 (LXXL Γοφερ). 2. in Judah 1 Ch 4:17 (Α Γαφερ). 3. in Manasseh 5:24.

[Str1036] עַפְרָה v. ´בֵּית לְע p.112 supr.

[Str6084] † עָפְרָה n.pr. 1. loc.: a. in Benj. Jos 18:23 (P), Αφαρ, etc.; 1 S 13:7 Γοφερα; prob. = עֶפְרוֺן 2 and אֶפְרַיִם 6; perh. mod. eṭ-Ṭayyibeh, c. 4 miles NE. from Bethel, cf. GASmGeogr. 252 BuhlGeogr. 177. b. in Manasseh, Εφραθα: Ju 6:11, 8:27; cstr. עָפְרַת אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי 6:24, but ´עָפְרָה וגו 8:32; c. ה loc. עָפְרָ֫תָה Ju 9:5. 2. m. in Judah 1 Ch 4:14, Γοφερα, LXXL Εφραθ.

[Str6085] † עֶפְרוֺן n.pr. Εφρων:—1. m. Hittite, Abr.'s time, acc. to Gn 23:8, 23:10, 23:10, 23:13, 23:16, 23:17, 49:29, עֶפְרֹן 23:6, 25:9, 49:30, 50:13 (all P). 2. loc. 2 Ch 13:19 Kt (עֶפְיִן Qr), cf. עָפְרָה 1 a. 3. mont. ´הַר־ע, on N. border of Judah Jos 15:9.

[Str6085] עֶפְרַ֫יִן 2 Ch 13:19 Qr v. עֶפְרוֺן 2. above

[Str5777] † עֹפֶרֶת n. m.:Je 6:29 (si vera l. Qr) lead (√ dub.; prob. foreign word; cf. Targum אֲבָרָא lead, Syr. ܐܰܒܳܪܳܐ, and (as Aram. loan-word) Ar. أَبَار [v. Dozy], Frä152; perh. also As. abaru, a metal, magnesite acc. to HilprAssyriaca i (1894), 80 ff. Hptib. 83);—´כִּכַּר ע Zc 5:7 a round weight (disc) of lead, ´אֶבֶן־הָעו v:5; with other metals (v. בְּדִיל) : ´עוֺ Ez 22:18, 22:20, 27:12 הָעֹפָרֶת Nu 31:22 (P); ´עֹפ also Jb 19:24 (with which chiselled letters are filled acc. to Di and most; Bu rds. ´בְּע in [a tablet of] lead); also (as flux) Je 6:29 (rdg. Qr; so Gf Co; emend. Gie); ´עוֺ in sim. Ex 15:10 (song).

[Str5890,6086] עֵפָ֫תָה v. עֵיפָה sub II. עוף. עֵץ v. II. עצה, 781

title: I עָצַב
content:
[Str6087] †I. [עָצַב] vb. hurt, pain, grieve (NH Nithp. and in deriv.; Targum עֲצַב be in pain(rare); Eth.ዐጸበ፡ be hard, difficult, LagBN 50, cf. 201 cp. Ar. غَضِبَ be angry, but dub.);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. sf. עֲצָבוֺ 1 K 1:6 his father had not pained him (LXX Klo Gr עֲצָרוֺ, but v. Benz); ins. עָצַב (with other words) 2 S 13:21 LXX Ew Th We Kit Bu HPS; Inf. cstr. sf. לְבִלְתִּי עָצְבִּי 1 Ch 4:10 that it (רָעָה) may not pain me; Pt. pass. cstr. עֲצוּבַת רוּחַ Is 54:6 hurt in spirit (of Zion under fig. of deserted wife). Niph. Pf. 3 ms. נֶעְצַב 1 S 20:24 be pained for (אֶל Pers.; del. LXX HPS); נֶעֱצַב 2 S 19:3 the king is in pain (is grieving) for (עַל Pers.); Impf. 3 ms. יֵעָצֵב 1 S 20:3 lest he be pained; + בָּהֶם instr. Ec 10:9 shall be hurt by them (i.e. אֲבָנִים; only here of physical pain); 2 mpl. תֵּעָֽצְבוּ Gn 45:5 be not grieved (+ יִחַר; sq. כִּי that ye sold me), cf. Ne 8:10, 8:11 (abs.) do not grieve. Pi. Pf. 3 pl. עִצְּבוּ c. acc. Is 63:10 they vexed his holy spirit (+ מָרוּ); Impf. 3 mpl. בְּבָרַי יְעַצֵָּבוּ Psalm 56:6 my affairs they vex (Thes al.), but improb., < Che ´בְּדָבָר יְע with speech they vex (me). Hiph. Impf. 3 mpl. sf. יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ Psalm 78:40 they used to cause him [´י] pain. Hithp. Impf. 3 ms. וַיִּתְעַצֵּב אֶל־לִבּוֺ Gn 6:6 and he was vexed to his heart (of ´י; ‖וַיִּנָּחֶם); 3 mpl. וִיִּתְעַצְּבוּ Gn 34:7 (+ וַיִּחַר, sq. clause with כִּי).

[Str6089] †I. עֶ֫צֶב n.[m.] pain, hurt, toil ;—1. ´ע pain Gn 3:16 (of travail), Pr 10:22. 2. hurt (of mind), ´דְּבַר־ע Pr 15:1 a word that hurts (opp. מַעֲנֶה־רַךְ). 3. toil Pr 14:23; pl. לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים Psalm 127:2 bread of (gained by) toils; sf. עֲצָבֶיְ Pr 5:10.

[Str6090] †I. עֹ֫צֶב n. [m.] pain;—´ע 1 Ch 4:9 (of travail); ´דֶּרֶח־ע Psalm 139:24 hurtful way (of any wicked habit; > Targum Thes way of idolatry; II. עֹצֶב) ; sf. עָצְבְּ Is 14:3 of the pain of exile.

title: II עָצַב
content:
[Str6087] †II. [עָצַב] vb.Pi. shape, fashion (NH Pi. stretch child into shape; BuhlLex cp. عَضَبَ out, cut off [whence idea of carving, fashioning]);—Pi. Pf. יָדֶיךָ עִצְּבוּנִי וַעיַּעֲשוּנִי Jb 10:8 thy hands shaped me, etc. Hiph. Inf.cstr. לְהַעֲצִבָה Je 44:19, but rd. בָהּ-, to fashion her, i.e. make images of her (poss. denom. from עָצָב).

[Str6090] †II. [עֹ֫צֶב] n.m. idol;—sf. עָצְבִּי Is 48:5.

[Str6091] † [עָצָב] n.[m.] idol;—always pl. עֲצַבִּים (Ges§ 93 ee): Ho 4:17, 8:6 (כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב), 13:2 (כֶּסֶף), ‖מַסֵּכָה), 14:9, Zc 13:2, 2 Ch 24:18 (+ אֲשֵׁרִים); cstr. עֲצַבֵּי Psalm 106:38, 135:15 (כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב); sf. עֲצַבֶּיהָ Is 10:11 (‖אֱלִילֶיהָ), Je 50:2 (‖גִּלּוּלֶיהָ), Mi 1:7; עֲצַבֵּיהֶם 1 S 31:9 = 1 Ch 10:9, 2 S 5:21 (but read אֱלּֽהֵיהֶם as ‖ 1 Ch 14:12, so LXX We Dr al.), Is 46:l, Psalm 106:36, 115:4 (כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב).

title: עצד
content:
עצד (√ of foll.; cf. Ar.عَضَدَ lop trees with a مِعْصَدٌ, a kind of reaping-hook; Eth.ዐፀደ፡, ዐደድ፡ reap, ምኣዕዠድ፡, ምኣዕዠድ፡ sickle; NH מַעֲצָד axe (smaller than כַּשִּׁיל LevyNHWB ii. 423).

[Str4621] † מַעֲצָד n.[m.] axe;—Je 10:3; in Is 44:12 prob. del. (so Du CheHpt Skinner).

title: I עָצָה
content: [Str6095] †I. [עָצָה] vb. shut (Ar. (و et ي) غَضَا IV. shut eyes; Eth. ዐጸወ፡ shut door);—Qal Pt. act. עֹצֶה עֵינָיו Pr 16:30 he that shuts his eyes (SS cp. עצּם [Is 29:10], which Gr reads).

title: II עצה
content:
II. עצה (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; cf. Sab. עצַם wood DHMZMG xxxvii (1883), 341, 412, Ar. غِضَةٌ, orig. عِضَهَةٌ nom. unit. of عِضَاهٌ large, thorny trees (v. Lane; also NöGGA 1862, 544; ZMG xxxii (1878), 406 LagBN 158 f.); Eth. ዕዥ፡: tree, wood; As. iṣ(ṣ)u; Ph. עץ wood; NH = BH; Aram. אָע (init. א by dissim.); BaNB § 2, c. 1 thinks originally bilit.).

[Str6086] עֵץ:329 n.m.:Gn 2:9 tree, trees, wood;—´ע abs. Gn 3:3 +, cstr. 3:24 +, עֵ־ץ 2:16 +; sf. עֵֽצְ Dt 28:42, etc.; pl. עֵצִים Ju 9:8 +, cstr. עֲצֵי Is 7:2 +, sf. עֵצֶיְ Dt 29:10, עֵצֵינוּ La 5:4, etc.;—1. (c. 150 t.) a. a standing tree Gn 18:4, 18:8 (J) +, Ex 15:25 (J; of shrub ?), Je 17:18 = Psalm 1:3 (sim.); to be felled Dt 19:5, 2 K 6:6; הָעֵצִים (appar. incl. vine and bramble) in allegory Ju 9:8 + 6 t. Ju 9; עֵץ הַחַיִּים † Gn 2:9, 3:22, 3:24 (J), cf. חַיִּים ´ע fig. of source of (life and) happiness † Pr 3:18, 11:30, 13:12, 15:4; הַדַּעַת טוֺב וָדָע ´ע Gn 2:9, 2:16 (J); יַעַר(ה)עֲצֵי Is 7:2 (sim.), 44:14, Ez 15:2 +; עֲצֵי הַשָּדֶה Is 55:l2, Ez 17:24 (fig.) , +; עֲצֵי לְבָנוֺן 2 Ch 2:7; עֲצֵי־מַיִם † Ez 31:14; ´עֲצֵי י † Psalm 104:16; עֲצֵי עֵדֶן † Ez 31:9, 31:16, 31:18, 31:18; עֲצֵי לְבוֺנָה Ct 4:14; of vine עֵץ הַגֶּפֶן † Ez 15:2, 15:6 ; תַּחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲָ+נן place of illicit worship † Dt 12:2, Je 2:20, 3:6, 3:13, 1 K 14:23, 2 K 16:4, 17:10, Ez 6:13, Is 57:5, 2 Ch 28:4, cf. עַל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן Je 17:2; כָּל־עַץ עָבֹת Ez 20:28. b. coll. trees, עֵץ־הַגָּן Gn 2:16, 3:1, 3:2, 3:8 (all J); usu. later, ´י 1:12, 1:29, 1:29 (P), +; עֵץ פְּרִי fruit-bearing trees Gn 1:11 (P), Psalm 148:9, cf. Ec 2:5, פְּרי עֵץ Ex 10:15 (J), Ez 36:30, Lv 23:40 (H), cf. Jo 2:22; עֵץ־מַאֲכָל Dt 20:20, Lv 19:23 (H), Ez 47:12, Ne 9:25; עֵץ הַזַּיִת Hg 2:19 olive trees, עֵץ שֶׁמֶן Ne 8:15, עֵץ־שָׁמֶן Is 41:19; סֲבָח־עֵץ Psalm 74:5 thicket of trees; עֵץ הַשָּרֶה Ex 9:25 (J), +; עֵץ הַיַּעַר † Ez 15:6, cf. Is 10:19, 44:23; כִּימֵי הָעֵץ Is 65:22 (sim. of great age). c. pl. of trees felled for building, 1 K 5:20, 5:32 (+ אֲבָנִים); עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים 2 S 5:11 = 1 Ch 14:1 + 7 t.; עֲצֵי בְרוֺשִׁים 1 K 52:22, 52:24, 9:11; (´אַלְגּ)עֲצֵי לְמֻגִּים, v. ´אַלְגּ p. 38 supr. 2. (c. 175 t.; c. 120 t. pl., to denote pieces [or articles] of wood) a. wood, as material; for building, 2 K 12:13 (+ אַבְנֵי מַתְצֵב), 22:6 = 2 Ch 34:11 (both + id.), Ne 2:8 +; עֲצֵי שָׁמֶן 1 K 6:23, 6:31, 6:33 cf. v:32; עֲצֵי־גֹּפֶר Gn 6:14 (Noah's ark), עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים Ex 25:5, 25:10 + 20 t. Ex (of tabern. and its furniture; all P) Dt 10:3; מִגְדַּל־עֵץ Ne 8:4; מוֺטִת עֵץ Je 28:13 (in fig.; opp. בַּרְזֶל ´מ); כְּלִי־עֵץ article of wood Lv 11:32, 15:12, Nu 31:20, cf. 35:18 (all P). Hence b. עֵצִים = articles of wood Ex 7:19 (P; ‖אֲבָנִים), 1 Ch 29:2; so עֲצֵי בְרוֺשִׁים 2 S 6:5 (but v. בְּרוֺשׁ ad fin); specif. הָעֵץ = helve of axe Dt 19:5; (וֺ)עֵץ חֲנִית 1 S 17:7 Qr (Kt חֵץ) = 1 Ch 20:5, 2 S 21:19, 23:7; עֲצֵי הָעֲגָלָה 1 S 6:14 (i.e. wood of which cart was made), עֲצֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה Ju 6:26; esp. timbers of a house Zc 5:4, Hb 2:11, Lv 14:45, of a city 1 K 15:22 = 2 Ch 16:5, Ez 26:12; עֵץ of pole on which bodies of slain (criminals and others) were exposed (perhaps orig. trees) Gn 40:19 (E), Jos 8:29, 8:29, 10:26, 10:26, 10:27 (all JE), Dt 21:22, 21:23; late (in Pers.) used for executing criminals (? by hanging = gallows), תָּלָח עַל־עֵץ Est 2:23 + 8 t. Est. † c. of idols, עֵץ וָאֶבֶן Dt 4:28, 28:36, 28:64, 29:16, 2 K 19:18 = Is 37:19, Ez 20:32, cf. Je 2:27, 3:9, Hb 2:19; so עֵץ alone Ho 4:12, Is 40:20, cf. 44:19, 45:20; אֲשֵׁרָה כָּל־עֵץ Dt 16:21. d. (fire-) wood Jos 9:23, 9:27 (J), v:21 (P), Dt 19:5 Is 30:33 +, rd. עֵצִים also Ez 24:5 (for MT עצמים) Bö Ew Sm Co Berthol Toy; esp. for sacrifices 1 K 18:23, 18:23 +, Gn 22:7, 22:9, 22:9, Lv 1:7 + 6 t. Lv (all P), 2 S 24:22 ‖ 1 Ch 21:23, +; עֲצֵי עוֺלָה Gn 22:3, 22:6 (P). e. אֶרֶז(הָ)עֵץ cedar-wood, used in purifications Lv 14:4, 14:6, 14:49, 14:51, 14:52, Nu 19:6 (all P). f. פִּשְׁתֵּי הָעֵץ Jos 2:6 woody-flax, i.e. flax on the stalk.—Je 10:8 Gie prop. הֶבֶל מֹעֲצֹתָו for MT הֲבָלִים עִץ הוּא.—מֹאֶסֶת כָּל־עֵץ Ez 21:15 is dub., Sm prop. מָאֵסְתָּ כָל־עֵץ, Co מֹאֲסֵי כָל־עֹז, Berthol וּמְנַסֵּף כָּל־עַז; SiegfKau Toy leave untranslated.

[Str6097] †II. עֵצָה n.f. coll. trees Je 6:6, but rd. עֵצָהּ (עֵץ c. sf. 3 fs.), so Orient. Codd. LXX SyrVer Vulgate Targum Hi Gf Gie.—1. עֵצָה v. sub יָעֵץ.

title: III עצה
content:
III. עצה (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; cf. As.eṣên-ṣêri,eṣên of the back, prob. spine; Ar. عَصَّاء os cruris, Lane2068 c bone of the shank, عُصْعُص os caudae coccygisve).

[Str6096] † עָצֶה n.[m.] either spine or os sacrum, bone close to fat-tail, ´הֶע Lv 3:9.

title: IV עצה
content:
IV. עצה (√ of foll.; LagBN 157 cp. غَضَا a land abounding with the trees called غَد,َاء).

[Str6100] † עֶצְיוֺן גֶּ֫בֶר n.pr.loc. usu. Γασιων [Γες] Γαβερ, near Elath at head of Gulf of Aḳaba 1 K 9:26 = 2 Ch 8:17, ָ+גּבֶר ´י 1 K 22:49 = 2 Ch 20:36; עֶצְיֹן ָ+גּבֶר Dt 2:8, Nu 33:35, 33:36 (P).

title: עָצֵל
content:
[Str6101] † [עָצֵל] vb.Niph. be sluggish (NH in der. species, and deriv.; cf. Ar. عَظِلَ III. stick fast in coitu, Lane2086; Syr. ܥܛܶܠ be stupid);—Impf. 2 mpl. אַל־תֵּעָֽצְלוּ לָלֶכֶת Ju 18:9 be not sluggish in going.

[Str6102] עָצֵל:14 adj. sluggish, lazy;—alw. ´י abs.;—´אִישׁ־ע Pr 24:30; elsewhere subst. sluggard Pr 6:6, 6:9 + 10 t. Pr + ´הֶע 10:26.

[Str6104] † עַצְלוּת n.f. id.;—´לֶחֶם י Pr 31:27.

title: I עָצֹם
content:
[Str6105] †I. [עָצֹם, cf. LagBN 31], עָצַם vb. be vast, mighty, numerous (NH Nithp. contend strenuously, and in deriv.; Ph. in עצמת mighty deeds, עצמם bones; Ar. عَظُمَ be great in bone, or anything, عَظُمٌ, bones; Eth. ዐፅም፡ id.; Aram. עִטְמָא, ܥܰܛܡܳܐ thigh):—Qal Pf. 3 ms. וְעָצַם consec. Dn 8:24, 11:23; 2 ms. עָצַמְתָּ Gn 26:16; 3 pl. עָֽצְמוּ Is 31:1 +, עָצֵָמוּ Psalm 38:20; Impf. 3 mpl. וַיַּעַצְמוּ Ex 1:7, 1:20; Inf. cstr. עָצְמַת Is 47:9; sf. עָצְמוֺ Dn 8:8; —1. be mighty, Gn 26:16 (J; c. מִן comp.), Dn 8:8, 8:24, 11:23. 2. be numerous, ‖דַבּוּ etc., Is 31:1, בְּעָצְמַת חֲבָרַיִח מְאֹד 47:9, Je 5:6, 30:14, 30:15, Ex 1:7 (P), v:20 (J), Psalm 38:20, 69:5; c. מִן comp. Albr.:ZAW xvi (1896). 73) bone, substance, self;—abs. ´י Gn 2:23 +; עָצֶם; Pr 15:30, 16:24; cstr. עֶצֶם Ex 24:10 +; sf. עַצְמִי Jb 19:20 +, etc.; pl. עֲצָמוֺת 2 K 23:16 +; cstr. עַצְמוֺת Jos 24:22 +; sf. עַצְמֹתַי Jb 4:14 +, etc.; also עֲצָמִים Ez 24:4 +, sf. עֲצָמַי Gn 2:23 +, etc.;—1. bone: a. of living Pers. [Str6099,6110] עָצוּם:31 adj. mighty, numerous;—´ע Gn 18:18 +, pl. עֲצוּמִים Is 8:7 +, עֲצֻמִים Mi 4:3 +; sf. עֲצוּמָיו Psalm 10:10; —1. mighty, esp. of people, strong in numbers (oft. ‖רַב, גָּדוֺל) Gn 18:18, Ex 1:9 + 3 t. JE; Dt 4:38 + 6 t. D, Mi 4:3, 4:7, Zc 8:22, Is 60:22 (opp. צָעִיר), of locusts Jo 1:6, 2:2, 2:5, cf. v:11; so of חַיִל Dn 11:25; עַם לאֹ עָצוּם, i.e. feeble Pr 30:26 (of the שָׁפָן); less oft. of individ. ´מְלָכִים ע Psalm 135:10; of waters Is 8:7; ´ע alone Pr 18:18 the mighty, Dn 8:24; Psalm 10:10 his mighty ones i.e. claws, of lion, so Ew De Che Bae al.). 2. numerous, countless (all ‖רַב): Am 5:12, Psalm 35:18; as subst. = many Is 53:12, Pr 7:26.—Is 41:21 v. עֲצֻמָה sub III. עצם. below

[Str8592] † [תַּעֲצֻמָה] n.f. might;—pl. intens. עז זְתַעֲצֻמוֺת Psalm 68:36 strength and abundant might.

[Str6111] † עַצְמֹוֺן n.pr.loc. Ασε(λ)μωνα on extreme S. border of Canaan, Nu 34:5, c. ה loc. עַצְמֹ֫נָה v:4, עַצְמ֫וֺנָה Jos 15:4.

title: II עָצַם
content: [Str6105,6095] † II. [עָצַם] vb. shut the eyes (NH Hiph.; poss. connex. with Syr. ܥܡܰܨ = id., Ar. غَمَضَ, IV (on غَمُضَ = ض v. NöZMG xxxii (1878), 406); NH עִמֵּץ close eyes of dead; cf. Baes 5f.);—Qal Pt. וְעֹצֵם עֵינָיו מִן Is 33:15 shutteth his eyes from seeing Pi Impf. 3 ms. וַיְעַצֵּם אֶת־עֵינֵיכֶם Is 29:10 he hath tightly shut your eyes (cf. I. עצה).

title: III עצם
content:
[Str6099] III. עצם (√ of foll., si vera l.; cf. Ar. عَصَمَ defend, protect, عِصْمَةٌ defence, v. Du and cf. Thes; > De Di al. your mighty things strong arguments (fr. עָצוּם, sub I. עצם, which foll. perhaps imitates in vocalization)).

[Str6110,6099] † [עֲצֻמָה] n.f. defence;—pl. sf. עֲצֻמוֺתֵיכֻם (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. ´עַצֻּמ) Is 41:21 bring forward your defences, defensive arguments (CheHpt עַצְּבוֺתֵיכֻם your idols, after Gr, [so Lo Klo explain ´עצמ, as mightiest aid, I. עצם]).

[Str5719,6112] עצנו(ה) 2 S 23:8, v. 1. עָדִין sub I. עדן. p. 726

title: עָצַר
content:
[Str6113] עָצַר:46 vb. restrain, retain (NH id.; cf. prob. As eṣêru, retain, restrain, DlHWB 122 JägerBAS i. 483 Zehnpfundib. 500; Eth. ዐጸረ፡ press, Ar. عَصَرَ; Targum עֲצַר Syr. ܥܨܰܪ id.);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. ´ע Gn 20:18 +, sf. עֲצָרַנִי 16:2; 1 S. יָצַרְתִּי Dn 10:8, 10:16; etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יַעְצֹר 1 S 9:17 +, יַעְצָ־ר 2 Ch 2:5; sf. יַעֲצָרְכָה 1 K 18:44, etc.; Inf. abs. עָצֹר Gn 20:18, cstr. לַעִצֹר 2 Ch 22:9, וַעְצֹר Jb 4:2 (Ges§ 28 b); Pt. pass. עָצוּר Je 33:1 +, etc.;—1. restrain, c. acc. Pers. Gn 16:2 (J; + מִן, i.e. prevent), עָצֹר עָצַר בְּעֵד כָּל־רֶחֶם 20:18 (E), cf. abs. Is 66:9 (opp. מוֺלִיד); sq. inf. 2 K 4:24; c. acc. Pers. alone 1 K 18:44 hinder, stop; c. acc. of sky (hindering rain) Dt 11:17, 2 Ch 7:13; pt. pass. abs. shut up, or hindered (for reasons not given) Je 36:5, Ne 6:10 (? by a vow, or by ceremonial uncleanness, cf. RS Sem i. 436 f., 2nd ed. 455 f.); = shut up (c. ב, in prison) 2 K 17:4, pt. pass. Je 33:1, 39:15, fig. 20:9; on עָצוּר וְעָזוּב (5 t.) v. I. עזב; עֲצֻרָה לָנוּ 1 S 21:6 women have been kept away with ref. to us (cf. RSl. c.); עָצוּר מִפְּנֵי 1 Ch 12:1 kept away from before Saul; = detain, c. acc. Ju 13:15, 13:16; in Jb c. בְּ, בְּמִלִּין ´ע 4:2, cf. 29:9, so בַּמַּיִם 12:5; בְּעַמִּי ´ע 1 S 9:17 is rule over, etc. (si vera l.); ins. also (with other words) 10:1 LXX We Dr al. 2. (late) retain, c. acc. כֹּחַ 2 Ch 13:20, 22:9, Dn 10:8, 10:16, 11:6; + inf. = be able to 1 Ch 29:14, 2 Ch 2:5; om. כֹּחַ 14:10 (+ עִמְּ), 20:37 (+ inf.). † Niph. be restrained, stayed, of plague: Pf. 3 fs. נֶעֱצָרָה Nu 17:15; Impf. 3 fs. תֵּעָצַר 2 S 24:27 = 1 Ch 21:22, וַתֵּעָצַר Nu 17:13, 25:8 (P) 2 S 24:25, Psalm 106:30; be shut up (of sky), Inf. cstr. בְּהֵעָצֵר 1 K 8:35 = 2 Ch 6:26; be under restraint or detention Pt. נֶעְצָר 1 S 21:8 + ´לִפְחנֵי י (? i.e. kept by a vow, cf. HPS and Ne 6:10 supr.).

783:b. עָצַר: cf. As. uṣurtu, taboo SACJA, 1904, 754.

[Str6114] † עֶ֫צֶר n.[m.] restraint (?), only ´יוֺרֵשׁ ע Ju 18:7 a possessor of restraint, i.e. ruler, but LXX Vulgate wealth, so Thes al., text very dub., cf. GFM: Bu conj. That ´ע combines readings אֹצָר and עשֶׁר.

[Str6115] † עֹ֫צֶר n.[m.] restraint, coercion;—´ע abs.: וּמִמִּשְׁפָט ´מֵע Is 53:8 from (as a result of) coercion and judgment he was taken off; cstr. רָעָה ´ע Psalm 107:39; רָחַם ´ע Pr 30:16 restraint of womb, barrenness (so Psalm 107:39 PerlesAnal. 85).

[Str6116] † עֲצָרָה, עֲצֶ֫רֶת n.f. assembly (? as confined, held in);—abs. עֲצָרָה Is 1:13 + 2 t.; עֲצֶ֫רֶת Dt 16:8 + 3 t., עֲצָרֶת 2 Ch 7:9; cstr. עֲצֶָרֶת Je 9:1; pl. sf. עַצְרֹתֵיכֶם Am 5:21; —1. sacred assembly, rejected by ´י, Is 1:13 and (at Bethel, etc.) Am 5:21; for Baal 2 K 10:20; Dt 16:8 (last day of Maṣṣoth), Lv 23:36 (P), Nu 29:35 (P), Ne 8:18 (all of day after feast of booths), cf. 2 Ch 7:9 [NH of feast of weeks, Targum עֲצַרְתָּא JosAnt. iii. 10, 6 Ἀσάρτα]; occasional, Jo 1:14, 2:15. 2. assemblage, company (in gen.), בֹּגְדִים ´ע Je 9:1 an assemblage of deceivers (Gr עֲדַת; Che חֶבְרַת).

[Str4622] † מַעְצוֺר n.[m.] restraint, hindrance;—´מ 1 S 14:6 sq. inf., ´י has no hindrance in delivering.

[Str4623] † מַעְצָר n.[m.] restraint, control;—´מ Pr 25:28 a man whose spirit is without control.

title: עקב
content:
עקב (√ of foll., meaning dub.: Thes assumes be protuberant, whence both עָקֵב heel and II. עָקֹב hilly).

[Str6119] †I. עָקֵב n.m. heel, footprint, hinderpart (Arab. عَقِبٌ heel, fig. end (of a month), عِقْبَةٌ mark, sign, trace; Aram. עִקְבָּא, ܥܩܶܒ he3l, footprint, fig. trace, mark (cf. Wsd 2:4 SyrVer Ecclus 13:26 HCT SyrVer), also end, extremity);—´ע abs. Gn 3:15 +, cstr. עֲקֵב 25:26, pl. cstr. עִקָבֵי Ct 1:8, עִקְּבֵי Gn 49:17, Ju 5:22, עִקְּבוֺת Psalm 77:20, 89:52, etc.;—a. heel, of man, Gn 25:26 וְיָדוֺ אֹחֶזֶת בַּעֲקֵב אָחִיו, as obj. of attack from behind, 3:15 וְאַתָּה תְּשׁוּפֶנּוּ עָקֵב, Jb 18:9 פַּח ´יאֹחֵז בְּע, Je 13:22 נֶחְמְסוּ עֲקֵבָיִךְ are treated violently, i.e. are rudely exposed (‖נִגְלוּ שׁוּלַיִח); as instrument of attack, Psalm 41:10 ´הִגְדִּיל עָלַי עָ hath made great the heel against me, i.e. given me insidiously a great fall (fig. for taken some cruel advantage of me; cf. ὑποσκελίζω ); of an animal, Gn 49:17 הַנּשֵׁח עִקְּבֵי סוּם, Ju 5:22 b. mark of heel, footprint, Ct 1:8 צְאִי־לָח בְּעִקְבֵי הַצּאֹן, Psalm 56:7 יִשְׁמְרוּ עֲקֵבַי they mark my footprints, i.e. watch me insidiously wherever I go 89:52 אֲשֶׁר הֵֽרְפוּ עִקְּבוֺת מְשִׁיחְֶָ i.e. followed him mockingly, of ´י (fig.) Psalm 77:20 עִקְּבוֺתֶיְ לאֹ נוֺדָעוּ thy footprints were not known (the waters closing over them). c hinder-part, rear (of a troop of men), Gn 49:19 :וְהוּא יָגוּב עָקֵב (rd. אָשֵׁר :עֲקֵבָם) he will troop on their rear, Jos 8:13 עֲקֵבָם (cf. Di).

[Str6117] † עָקַב vb. follow at the heel, fig. assail insidiously, circumvent, overreach (denom. from עָקֵב; cf. Ar. عَقَبَ follow (at the heel), succeed, III. bring consequence on, i.e. punish, Qor 22:59, IV. make to follow, i.e. reward or punish, عَاقِبَةٌ end, final lot 6:11 reward 6:136 ܥܩܰܒ hold back (rare), follow, Pa. investigate, search out: Eth. ዐቀበ፡ is keep, guard);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. Ho 12:4 בַּבֶּטֶן עָקַב אֶת־אָחִיו he attacked his brother at the heel (cf. Gn 25:26 sub עָקֵב); Impf. 3 ms. Gn 27:36 הֲכִי קָרָא שְׁמוֺ יַעֲקֹב וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם and he hath overreached me now twice; + Inf. abs Je 9:3 בָּל־אָח עָקוֺב יַעֲקֹב surely overreacheth (‖רָכִיל יַהֲלֽח). [LXX πτερνίζω, to attack with the heel; but this dub. In ‘supplant,&rs. also, the fig. is a different one.] Pi.
