Jb 37:4 וְלאֹ יְעַקְּבֵם dub.; poss attack at the heel (cf. זִנֵּב), hence fig. hold back; more prob. rd. וְלאֹ יְעַכְּבֵם holdeth them not back (sc. בְּרָקָיו his lightnings), when his voice is heard from עִכֵּב to hold back (common in NH; Targum עַכֵּב).

[Str6120] †II עָקֵב adj. verb overreacher, Psalm 49:6 עֲוֺן עֲקֵבַי יְסֻבֵּנִי i.e. of those who would take some insidious advantage of me.

[Str6121] †I. עָקֹב adj. 1. insidious, deceitful, Je 17:9 עָקֹב הַלֵּב מִכֹּל. 2. foot-tracked (denom. from 1. עָקֵב) Ho 6:8 גִּלְעָד קִרְיַת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן עֲֹקֻבָּה מִדָּם.

[Str6121] †II. עָקֹב adj. steep, hilly (v. √; cf. عَقَبَةٌ difficult mountain path, Qor 90:11 ዐቀብ፡ hill);—Is 40:4 והיה הֶעָקֹב לְמִישׁוֺר let the steep ground (Ch) become a plain (‖הָֽרְכָסִים). Cf. Ecclus 6:20.

[Str6122] † עָקְבָה n.f. insidiousness, 2 K 10:19 זְיֵהוּא ´עָשָה בְע.

[Str6118] † עֵ֫קֶב n.[m.] consequence, usu. as adv. acc. as a consequence of, because (that) also reward, end (v. sub עָקַב; and cf, عَقِبٌ heel fig. consequence, result);—1. Is 5:23 מַצְדִּיקֵי רָשָׁע עֵקֶב שֹׁחַד (adv. acc.) in consequence of a bribe. Psalm 40:16 (= 70:4) על עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם (pleon.) according to the consequence of their shame, i.e. in consequence of the disgrace falling upon them. Hence as conj. עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר as a consequence of (the fact) that, because, Gn 22:18 אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ ´בְּקֹלִי ע 26:5, 2 S 12:6 ; so עֵקֶב כִּי 2 S 12:10, Am 4:12 כִּי זאת אעשה לך ´ע; עֵקֶב alone, Nu 14:24, and (sq. impf.) Dt 7:12 תשׁמעון ´ע in consequence of your hearkening, etc., 8:20. 2. consequence = gain, reward, Psalm 19:12 בְּשָׁמְרָם עֵקֶב רָב, Pr 22:4 ´עשֶׁר וגו ´יִרְאַת י(וְ)עֵקֶב עֲנָוָה. 3. end (of time), adv. acc., Psalm 119:33 ´וְאֶצֳּרֶנָּה ע to the end, v:112 לְעוֺלָם ´ע (cf. Ecclus 16:3; Targum עִקְבָּא (rare)).

[Str6126] † עַקּוּב n.pr.m LXXB usu. (Ι)ακουν[μ] A LXXL Ακ(κ)ουβ:—1. descendant of David 1 Ch 3:24. 2. heads of post-exilic families: a. Ezr 2:42 = Ne 7:45. b. Ezr 2:45 (si vera l.). 3. Levites: a. 1 Ch 9:17. b. Ne 8:7. c. Ne 11:19, 12:25.

[Str3290] יַּעֲקב:344, יַעֲקוֺב:5 n.pr.m. et gent. Jacob, Ιακωβ, son of Isaac and Rebekah, father of tribes of Isr. (expl. fr. עָקֵב heel Gn 25:26, Ho 12:4; i.e. supplanter; cp. with עָקַב overreach Gn 27:36; one closely following acc. to LagBN 127; connexion with Pal. city (?) called in Egyptian Y‘kb’ara (i.e. יַעֲקֹב־אֵל) is obscure; cf. MeyZAW vi.1 ff. WMMAs. u. Eur. 162 ff. JenZA x(1895–6), 347 ff.; v.also Bab. n.pr.m. Yaïḳubilu, Pinches in HomAHT 61, 96, 112; hence OT יַעֲקֹב perhaps orig. יעקבקל or the like. cf. Palm. n.pr. בלעקב, עתעקב);—יַעֲקוֺב Je 30:18 + 3 t. Je, Lv 26:42; יַעֲקֹב 215 t. Hex. (chiefly JE; 180 t. Gn once Lv, etc.), 34 t. Psalm 42 t. Is (27 t. 40–66), etc.;—1. as n.pr.m. Gn 25:26 + 205 t. (+ אַבְרָהָם, יִצְחָק19 t.); also ´בֵּית יַע of people (v. בַּיִת 5 d (γ)), ´בְּנֵי יַע (v. בֵּן 1 j (β)), ´זֶרַע יַע (v. זֶרַע 4 f), ´עֵין יַע (v. עַיִן ), etc. 2. as n.pr.gent. (c. 100 t.; poet. and proph.) Nu 24:5, 24:19, Dt 32:9, Psalm 44:5, Is 10:21, 17:4, Je 10:25, 30:7 +; ‖יִשְרָאֵל Nu 23:7, Dt 33:10, Is 14:1, Psalm 14:7 + c. 35 t.; specif. of N. Isr. Am 7:2, 7:5, Ho 12:13 (+ 10:11, 12:3 prob., v. Now), Mi 1:5, 1:5, Is 9:7; of Judah Mi 3:1, 3:8, Ob:10, Is 65:9, Mal 2:12 + al. post-exilic; ´גְּאוֺן יַע v. גָּאוֺן; † ´אֵל יַע Psalm 146:5, ´אֱלוֺהַּ יַע Psalm 114:7 †; ´אֱלֽהֵי יַע 2 S 23:1, Is 2:3 = Mi 4:2 + 9 t. PsalmPsalm + Psalm 24:6 (´יַע ´א for MT ´יַע alone), so LXX SyrVer Vulgate Ew Ol Hup Bae We Che al.; read ´יַע ´א also prob. 2 S 23:2 (for ´יִש ´א, ‖´צוּר יִש) Vulgate HPS; ´קְדוֺשׁ יַע Is 29:23 (‖´יִש ´א); ´מֶלֶךְ יַע 41:21 (‖יהוה).— On יַעֲקֹב v. esp. Dr: ‘Jacob’ in HastingsDict. Bib. ii. 526 ff.

[Str3291] † יַעֲקֹ֫בָה n.pr.m. Simeonite 1 Ch 4:36 Ιωκαβα, A Ιακαβα, LXXL Ιεκεβα.

title: I עָקַד
content:
[Str6123] †I. [עָקַד] vb. bind (NH id., bind bent limbs together; Ar. عَقَدَ tie, tie fast; Eth. ዐቀደ፡ Syr. ܥܩܰܕ and esp. ܥܰܘܩܶܕ bend, twist; Targum עֲקַד as NH; also kneel, cf. Chr. Pal., SchwallyIdiot.71);— Qal Impf. וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶת־יִצְחָק Gn 22:9.

[Str1044] עֵ֫קֶד n.[m.] ? binding, cf. הָרֹעִים ´בֵּית ע. p. 112

title: II עקד
content:
II. עקד (√ of foll.; usu. identif. with I, whence עָקֹד striped with bands, but dubious; LagBN 31 vocalizes √ עָקֹד).

[Str6124] † עָקֹד adj. striped, streaked ;—of Jacob's goats and sheep; as subst. ´ע Gn 30:40 (coll.), pl. עֲקֻדִּים 31:8, 31:8; pl. as attrib. 30:35, 30:39, pred. 31:10, 31:12.

[Str6125] † [עָקָה] n.f. Psalm 55:4 v. עוק.

title: עקה
content:
עקה (√ of foll.; cf Ar. عَقَا hinder).

[Str4624] † מַעֲקֶה n.[m.] parapet;—Dt 22:8.

title: עָקַל
content:
[Str6127] † [עָקַל] vb.. bend, twist (NH esp. in deriv.; Targum in deriv.; Syr.ܥܩܠ twist, in der. spec.; Ar. عَقَلَ bind camel's folded fore-shank and arm together);—Pu. be bent out of shape, crooked, Pt. fig. מִשְׁפּט מְעֻקָּל Hb 1:4 crooked justice.

[Str6128] † [עֲקַלְקָל] adj. intens. crooked;—fpl. אֳרָחוֺת עֲקַלְקַלּוֺת Ju 5:6 i.e. roundabout paths (GFM); sf. עֲקַלִקַלּוֺתָם Psalm 125:5 their crooked-nesses.

[Str6129] † עֲקַלָּתוֺן adj. crooked (acc. to SmZAW iv. 213 constellation Draco;—´לִוְיָתָן נָחָשׁ ע Is 27:1.

[Str6130,3292,885,1142] † עֲקָן n.pr.m. in Edom;—´וַע Gn 36:27, (I)ουκαμ = יַעֲקָן 1 Ch 1:42, Ωναν, Ιαακαν etc. (v. LagBN 84.Anm.**; also בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָן and ´יע ´בְּאֵרֹת ב ).

title: עקר
content:
עקר (√ of foll.; mng. dub.; cf. Aram. עִקָּרָא ܥܶܩܳܪܳܐ root; Eth. ዐቅኣር፡ medicine; Ar. vb. appar. denom. عَقَرَ extirpate, Targum עֲקַר id.; NH עָקַר = BH).

[Str6133] †I. עֵ֫קֶר n.m. offshoot, member (? from root);—cstr. מִשְׁפַּחַת גֵּר ´ע Lv 23:47 a member of a sojourner's family. below

[Str6131,5193] † [עָקַר] vb. denom. pluck or root up—Qal Inf. cstr. לַעֲקוֺר c. acc. Ec 3:2 (opp. נָטַע). Niph. Impf. 3 fs. עֶקְרוֺן תֵּעָקֵר Zp 2:4 (word-play).

[Str6131] † עִקֵּר vb.Pi.denom (from עֵקַר or other like word = (root-sinew), hamstring;—hamstring horses (on Arab. funeral usage, with camel and horse v. WeHeid. 2, 181): Pf. 3 ms. ´ע Jos 11:9, Impf. 3 ms. וַיְעַקֵּר 2 S 8:4 = 1 Ch 18:4, 2 ms. תְּעַקֵּר Jos 11:6 all c. acc.; Pf. 3 mpl. עִקְּרוּ שׁוֺר Gn 49:6they hamstrung an ox.

[Str6135] † עָקָר adj. barren;—´ע of male Dt 7:14, עֲקָרָה of female v:14 (mankind and beasts), Ex 23:26 (E; female); elsewhere of women Gn 11:30, 25:21, 29:31 (all J), Ju 13:2, 13:3, 1 S 2:5, Jb 24:21, Psalm 113:9 (עֲקֶרֶת cstr.); of personif. Zion Is 54:1.

[Str6134] †II. עֵ֫קֶר n.pr.m. in Judah 1 Ch 2:27, Ακορ, Ικαρ.

[Str6137,4610] † עַקְרָב n.m. scorpion (appar. quadrilit.; NH id.; As. aḳrabu; Eth. ዐቅረብ፡; Ar. عَقْرَبٌ; Targum עַקְרַבָּא);—abs. עַקְרָב Dt 8:15 (coll.; of wilderness), pl. עַקְרַבִּים Ez 2:6 (fig. of enemies); ´יִסַּר בָּע 1 K 12:11, 12:14 = 2 Ch 10:11, 10:14, i.e. scourges with points, stings.—Vid. also מַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים. p. 751

785:b. עַקְרָב: < [f.] as in NH Syr. Mand. Ar. (Levy gives Talm. [Aram.] as m., but are rdgs. correct ?), Nö (privately).

[Str6138] עֶקְרוֺן:22 n.pr.loc. Eḳrôn, Ακκαρων (in As. Amḳarruna COTGloss., DlPa 289 who prop. עַקָּרוֺן );—Philistine city, one of the famous five, Am 1:8, Jos 13:3 (D) + 4 t. Jos (P), Ju 1:18, 1 S 5:10, 5:10 + 5 t. 1 S; 2 K 1:2, 1:3, 1:6, 1:16, Je 25:20, Zp 2:4, Zc 9:5, 9:7; mod. ‘Âkir RobBR i. 227 ff. GASmGeogr.198 BuhlGeogr.187 f.

[Str6139] † עֶקְרוֺנּי adj. gent. of foregoing, c. art. = subst. the Eḳrônite Jos 13:3 (D); pl. הָעֶקְרֹנִים 1 S 5:10.

title: עָקַשׁ
content:
[Str6140] † [עָקַשׁ] vb. twist (NH id. (rare));—Niph. Pt. cstr. דְּרָכַיִם Pr 28:18 one crooked in ways (< pl., cf. Toy). Pi. Pf. 3 pl. עִקְּשׁז לָהֶס Is 59:8 their paths they have twisted. Impf. 3 mpl. יְעַקֵָּשׁזּ Mi 3:9 all that is straight they make crooked; Pt מְעַקֵּשׁ דְּרָכָיו Pr 10:9 (cf. Niph.). Hiph. Impf. וַיּעְקְשֵׁנִי Jb 9:20 (Ges§ 53 n) he hath declared me crooked, devious (in life).

[Str6141] † I. עִקֵּשׁ adj. twisted, perverted;—abs. וּפְתַלְתֹּל ´דּוֺר ע Dt 32:5 a generation twisted and crooked, ´לֵבָב ע Psalm 101:4; as n.m. (of one devious in life) the perverted 2 S 22:27 = Psalm 18:27, Pr 22:5, of things 8:8; cstr. דְּרָכַיִם ´ע 28:6, שְפָתָיו ´ע 19:1, עִקֶּשׁ־לֵב 17:20; pl. אָרְחֹתֵיהֶם עִקְּשִׁים 2:15 whose ways are twisted; cstr. עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵב 11:20.

[Str6142] † II. עִקֵּשׁ n.pr.m. a Tekoan 2 S 23:26 = 1 Ch 11:28, 1 Ch 27:9; Εισκα, Εκκις, etc.

[Str6143] † עִקְּשׁוּת n.f. crookedness:—cstr. פֶּה ´ע crookedness of mouth Pr 4:24, 6:12 (cf. עִקֵּשׁ 19:1).

[Str4625] † [מַעֲקָשׁ] n.[m.] twisted, crooked place;—pl. מַעֲקַשִׁים Is 42:16 (opp. מִישׁוֺר).

[Str6144] † I. עָר n.pr.loc. in Moab, S. of Arnon (Ηρ Nu 21:15, elsewhere chiefly Αροηρ);—´ע Nu 21:15, Dt 2:9, 2:18, 2:29; עָר מוֺאָד Nu 21:28, Is 15:1; —usually interpreted as capital city (עָר = עִיר) of Moab (DHMZMG xxxvii (1883), 398 cp. Sab. ער fortified height, cf. MordtmHim. Inschr. 29 HalÉt. Sab. 159 so Ar. ٱلْعُرُّ, dial. of Yemen); BuhlGeogr.269 f. thinks name of district S. of Arnon.

[Str6145] † II. עָר n.m. only 2 t.: עָרְֶָ 1 S 28:16 (v. Dr.); rd. חָרְֶָ thine adversary Klo HPS (al. as altern. with foll.) > עִם רֵעְֶָ LXX SyrVer Targum Th Bu Kit (?) al.; עָרֶיְ Psalm 139:20 is very dub.; Hup עָלֶיְ, Ol Che al. שְׁמְֶָ; Bae leaves untranslated.

[Str6147] עֵר v. I. עִוּר

title: I ערב
content:
I. ערב (√ of foll; prob. …עָרֵב mix; NH עָרַב mix; so Targum Pa. (oft.), Syr. ܥܪܰܒ mix (rarely, in der. forms), ܥܰܪܽܘܒܳܐ mixture).

[Str6154] † I. עֵ֫רֶב n.m.:Ex 12:38 mixture, mixed company;—heterogeneous body attached to a people; to Israel Ex 12:38 (E), Ne 13:3; to Egyptians Je 25:20 (Vulgate joins to v:19, so Gie); to Chaldeans 50:37; in Je 25:24 del. הָעֶרֶב …וְאֵת as doublet (so Gie, cf. LXX); in 1 K 10:15 rd. עֲרָב (as ‖ 2 Ch 9:14, so Benz Kit al.); Ez 30:5 rd. prob. id. (Co).

[Str6154] II. עֵ֫רֶב n.[m.] woof (as mixed, interwoven, with warp);—Lv 13:48 + 8t. 13 (all opp. שְׁתִי warp), cf. GFMPAOS 1889, clxxviii.

[Str6157] עָרֹב:9 n.m.:Ex 8:20 prob. swarm (mixture, from incessant, involved motion; LagBN 112 doubts);—of plague of stinging flies, coming in a swarm (v. DIEx) Ex 8:17, 8:17 + 5 t. 8(J), Psalm 78:45, 105:31.

title: II עָרַב
content:
[Str6148] † II. עָרַב vb. take on pledge, give in pledge, exchange (NH go surety for (rare); Ph. ערב surety; OAram. ערבא pledge; Targum עֲרַב, Syr. ܥܪܰܒ, go surety for; usu. identified with I. ערב—mix, exchange, pledge—but quite uncertain; cf. BuhlLex LagBN 203);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. ´ע Gn 44:32 + 4 t.; 2 ms. עָרַבְתָּ Pr 6:1; Impf. 1 S. sf. אֶעֶרְבֶנּוּ Gn 43:9; Imv. עֲרֹב Psalm 119:122, sf. עָרְבֵנִי Is 38:14, so Jb 17:3 (but v. infr.); Inf. cstr. לַעֲרֹב Ez 27:9; Pt. עֹרֵב Pr 17:18, etc.;—1. c. acc. Pers. taken on pledge, i.e. go surety for the safety of, Gn 43:9 (J), 44:32 (J; + מֵעִם Pers.); for the debts of Pr 11:15, 20:16, 27:13; of God Is 38:14 go surety for me, Psalm 119:122, so Jb 17:3 (si vera l., v. עֵרָבוֺן); acc. Pers. om., לְ ´ע Pr 6:1 go surety to one (in behalf of another, ‖תָּקַע לַזָּר כַּפֶָּיְ); c. acc. rei Pr 22:26 (‖תֹּקְעֵי־כָף). 2. give in pledge, c. acc. rei Ne 5:3 (i.e. mortagage), fig. אֶת־לִבּוֺ ´ע Je 30:21 so עֲרֻבָּה לִפְנֵי רֵעֵהוּ ´ע Pr 17:18 (‖תֹּקֵעַ כָּף). 3. exchange (in trade), c. acc. cogn. מָעֲרָבֵךְ Ez 27:9, 27:27. Hithp. 1. recipr.: Imv. הִתְעָ֫רֶב נָא אֶת־אֲדֹנִי 2 K 18:23 exchange pledges (make a bargain) with my lord = Is 36:8. 2. a. have fellowship with, בְּ Pers., Pf. 3 pl. הִתְעָֽרְבוּ Ezr 9:2; Impf. 3 mpl. וַיִּתְעָֽרְבוּ Psalm 106:35; 2 ms. תִּתְעָרָב c. לְ Pers. Pr 20:19, c. עִם Pers. 24:21. b. share in, בְּ rei, 3 ms. יִתְעָרַב Pr 14:10 in his joy no other shares..

[Str6161] † עֲרֻבָּה n.f. thing exchanged, pledge, token;—sf. עֲרֻבָּתָם 1 S 17:18 = a token from them, i.e. response, token of welfare, Th Dr al.; abs. as acc. cogn. ´עָרַב ע Pr 17:18 give a pledge.

[Str6162] † עֵרָבוֺן n.[m.] pledge;—´נָתַן ע give a pledge Gn 38:17, 38:18, ´לָקַח ע v:20 (all J), receive (back) a pledge (when condition is fulfilled).—Jb 17:3 rd. perh. עֶרְבֹנִי (for MT עָרְבֵנִי), as obj. of שֹימָה set my pledge (a surety for me), so Beer Bu al.

[Str4627] † I. [מַעֲרָב] n.m. usu. coll. articles of exchange, merchandise (only of Tyre, Ez 27);—sf. מַעֲרָבֵךְ v:13, v:17, v:19, v:25, v:27 a, v:34; as acc. cogn. c. עָרַב v:9, v:27; pl. sf. מַעֲרָבַיִךְ v:33 perh. thy (diverse) wares (DHMVOJ viii (1894), 4 prop., ingeniously, meaning imports, deriving fr. V. ערב enter, but improb.).

[Str8594] † [תַּעַרֻבָה] n. f. pledge;—only pl. in phr. בְּנֵי הַתַּעַרֻבוֺת 2 K 14:14 i.e. hostages = 2 Ch 25:24.%

title: III עָרַב
content:
[Str6149] †III. [עָרַב] vb. be sweet, pleasing (NH id. (rare); Hiph. Impf. יעריבו Ecclus 40:21; Targum עָרִיב adj. pleasant, sweet);—Qal Pf. 3 fs. עָֽרְבָה Je 31:26 my sleep was sweet to me (לִי), שְׁנָתְֶָ ´וְע consec. Pr 3:24; of offering ´לי ´לאֹ ע Mal 3:4; 2 fs. עָרַבְתְּ Ez 16:37 c. עַל Pers., to whom thou wast pleasing; 3 pl. לאֹ עָֽרְבוּ לִי Je 6:20 (of sacrif.); Impf. 3 ms. יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִיחִי Psalm 104:34 let my meditation be pleasing unto him! 3 fs. תֶּעֱרַב לְ Pr 13:19 (of realized wish); 3 mpl. לאֹ יֶעֶרְבוּ לוֺ Ho 9:4 (of sacrifice; but Kue Che We GASm Now read יַעַרְכוּ).

[Str6156] † עָרֵב adj. sweet, pleasant;—לָאִישׁ ´ע לֶחֶם שָׁקֶר Pr 20:17; ´קוֺלֵח ע Ct 2:14.

title: IV ערב
content:
IV. ערב (√ of foll.; poss. be arid; Thes cp. Eth. ዖሮቦእ be arid, sterile, so BaentschDie Wüste (1883), 17, but dub.; Syr. العَرَبَة = BH; Ar. العَرَبُ n. pr. of depression S. of Dead Sea).

[Str6152] † עֲרַב n.[m.] desert-plateau, steppe (cf. CheIntr. Is. 129);—בַּעֲרָב בַּעֲרַב (si vera l.) Is 21:13, 21:13 in the steppe (of what we know as N. Arabia); but in vb Vrss Lo Che GuKau al. בָּעֶרֶב in the evening.

[Str6163] † עֲרָבִי n. gent. of foregoing, steppe-dweller;—Is 13:20; בַּמִּדְבָּר ´כַּעֲרָבִ Je 3:2.

[Str6152] † עֲרָב n. pr. gent. coll. steppe-dwellers of N. Arabia (WetzstZvölkerpsych. vii. 463 f.; extended later (so Herodii. 11 etc.) to whole peninsula, cf. Ar. غَرَبَ the Arabs, Bedúwy the people, DoughtyArab. Deserta, i. 224; Sab. ערבן, ערב, אערב CISiv. p. 123, As. Aribu, Arubu, Arabi, people in N. Arabia, DlPa 295 f. 304 f. COTJe 25, 24; also Urbi DlPa 305 f. of nomad ‘Arab’ tribes);—הַשֹּׁכְנִים בַּמִּדְבָּר ´מַלְכֵי ע Je 25:24 (v. 1. עֵרֶב), 2 Ch 9:14 + ‖ 1 K 10:15 (v. id.); ´ע also Ez 27:21 + 30:5 (v. id.); v. esp. NöArabia in Ency. Bib.

[Str6163] † עַרְבִי adj. gent. Arabian (in strictly ethnographic sense, Nöl. c.);—´הָע as subst. Ne 2:19 Geshem the Arabian, so 6:1; pl. הָעַרְבִים Ne 4:1, 2 Ch 21:16, 22:1; also (written as NH) הערביים 26:7 (Qr הָעַרְבִים), and even הָעַרְבִיאִים 17:11.

[Str6160] I. עֲרָבָה:61 n. f. desert-plain, steppe;—abs. ´ע 2 S 4:7 +, sf. עַרְבָתָהּ Is 51:3; pl. עֲרָבוֺת Je 5:6, Psalm 68:5, cstr. עַרְבוֺת 2 K 25:5 +, עַרְבֹת Je 52:8; —1. earliest use:a. arid steppe W. of Dead Sea (in S. Judah) 1 S 23:24, also Ez 47:8, Is 51:3, whence name ´יָם הָע Jos 3:16 (JE) ‖יָם הַמֶּלַח), also 2 K 14:25, Dt 4:49, and (‖ id.) 3:17, Jos 12:3 (D); נַחַל הָעֲרָבָה Am 6:14 must be E. of Dead Sea, si vera l., but rd. prob. מִצְרַיִם ´נ v. נַחַל. b. Jordan-valley W. of river + adjacent plain; near ford (opp. Jericho) 2 S 2:29, cf. Jos 8:14 (JE); also Dt 11:30, 2 K 25:4 = Je 39:4 = 52:7; —2 S 15:28, 17:16 v. עֲבָרָה c. Jordan-valley E. of river 2 S 4:7. 2. in D: a. esp. of E. Jordan plain Dt 1:1 (prob.) Jos 12:1, 12:3, E. half of Jordan-valley Dt 3:17, 4:49; of entire Jordan-valley (between כִּנֶּרֶת and Dead Sea, mod. El-Ghôr, the Depression) Dt 1:7, Jos 11:2, 11:16; W. Jordan plain only Jos 12:8; depression S. of Dead Sea (mod. Wady el-‘Arabah) Dt 2:8. 3. in P always pl. cstr. עַרְבוֺת מוֺאָב (E. Jordan) Nu 22:1 + 11 t. (v. מוֺאָב); עְרֵחוֺ ´ע (W. Jordan) Jos 4:13, 5:10, also 2 K 25:5 = Je 39:5 = 52:8. 4. appar. N. Arabian desert Is 40:3, 41:19. 5. in gen. the steppe (oft. ‖מִדְבָּר), Je 17:6, 50:12, Is 33:9, 35:1, 35:6, Jb 24:5, 39:6, Psalm 68:5; זְאֵב עֲרָבוֺת Je 5:6 (fig. of invader); cf. description of Exodus אֶרֶץ עֲרָבָה וְשׁוּחָה Je 2:6; in sim., of a plain, of future land of Judah Zc 14:10.—Vid. Dr:Dt 1, 1 and reff. BuhlGeogr. 111.

[Str6164] עַרְבָתִי v. בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה

title: V ערב
content:
V. ערב (√ of foll.; cf. As. erêbu, enter, go in; erêb šamši, sunset; Ar. غَرَبَ set (distinct fr. غَرَبَ depart, = Sab. עַרב withdraw, acc. to DHMEpigr. Denkm. 27), غَرْبٌ place of sunset, west; Sab. מערבם, מערבי [not עַ !] west, western, CISiv. p. 199 DHMl. c.; Eth. ዐርበ፡ set (of heavenly bodies), so Syr. ܥܪܶܒ; ܥܪܽܘܒܬܳܐ evening (LagBN 64 f.); Zinj. מערב west; NH עֶרֶב = BH. Hence also Εὐπώπη, Europe, LewyFremdw. 139).

[Str6153] עֶ֫רֶב:131 n.[m. 1 S 20:5 del. הַשְּׁלִישִׁית v. We Dr al.] (sun)set, evening;—abs. ´ע 2 K 2:16 +, עָרֶב Ex 12:18 +; cstr. עֶרֶב Pr 7:9; du. עַרְבַּיִם Ex 30:8 + 4 t., בָּיִם- 12:16 + 5 t. (all P);—1. a. evening, orig. sunset, and hence perh. ´לְעֵת ע at the time of sunset † Gn 8:11 (J), 24:11 (J; ‖לְעֵת צֵאת הַשֹּׁאֲבֹת), 2 S 11:2, Is 17:14 and (of the day of ´י) Zc 14:7, ´עֵת הָע Jos 8:29 (JE) †; usu. ´ע alone = time of sunset, evening: ´בָּע in the evening Gn 19:1 (J), 29:23 (E), Ex 12:18 (P), Dt 16:6 (+ שֶׁמֶשׁ כְּבוֺא), 1 K 22:35 (cf. ‖ 2 Ch 18:34 where + לְעֵת בּוֺא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ) + 20 t. + ´בָּע(־)בָּע 2 Ch 13:11, 13:11 = every evening; ´לָע at evening only late: † 1 Ch 16:40, 23:30, 2 Ch 2:3, Ezr 3:3, Psalm 59:7, 59:15, 90:6, Ec 11:6 †; ´לִפְנוֺת ע at the turn of evening † Gn 24:63 (J), Dt. 23:12; ´ע as adv. acc. Ec 16:6 (P), Psalm 55:18; as marking duration of impurity, in phr. ´עַד־הָע Lv 11:24 + 30 t. P + Lv 22:6 (H); of Day of Atonement ´מֵע ´עַד־ע 23:32 (P). b. du. in phrase (only P) בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם between the two evenings, i.e. prob. between sunset and dark (v. Thes [various views fully given]; otherwise Di:Ex 12:6; on form as poss. only expanded pl. v. Ges§ 88 c), † Ex 12:6, 16:12, 29:39, 29:41, 30:8, Lv 23:5, Nu 9:3, 9:5, 9:11, 28:4, 28:8 †. c. other phrases are: ´צִלְלֵי ע Je 6:4 (dist. fr. צָהֳרָיִם and לָיְלָה v:5), ´ע(הָ)מִנְחַה † 2 K 16:15, Ezr 9:4, 9:5, Psalm 141:2, Dn 9:21 †; ´זְאֵבֵי ע v. 1. זְאֵב; for all combin. with בֹּקֶר morning, v. ´ב 1 d, e. 2. (late poet.) = night, עָרֶב Jb 7:4; cf. בְּנֶשֶׁף בְּעֶרֶב יוֺם Pr 7:9 (‖בְּאִישׁוֺן לַיְלָה וִאֲפֵלָה).

[Str6150] † [עָרַב] vb. denom. become evening; grow dark (?);—Qal. Inf. cstr. רָפָה הַיּוֺם לַעֲרוֺב Ju 19:9, but rd. prob. נָטָה הַיּוֺם לַעֶרֶב LXXL GFM; Pf. 3 fs. fig. עָֽרְבָה Is 24:11 all joy has grown dark, but rd. עָֽבְרָה has passed away Lo Gr PerlesAnal. 91 CheHpt al. Hiph. Inf. abs. הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב 1 S 17:16 doing it at morning and at evening.

[Str4628,4629] † II. מַעֲרָב n.[m.] west (late) (place of sunset);—מִמַּעֲרָבָה ( = בָהּ-, cf. De Ges: § 91 e) Is 45:6 from its setting-place (opp. מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ); מַעֲרָב opp. מִזְרָח also 43:5, 59:19, Psalm 103:12, 107:3, so ´לַמּ westward 1 Ch 7:28, 12:16 (van d. H. v15), 26:16, 26:18; ´מ opp. מוֺצָא Psalm 75:7; מִן־הַּמַּעֲרָב (alone) Dn 8:5; c. ה loc. מַעֲרָבָה 1 Ch 26:30 westward, sq. לְ = to the west of 2 Ch 32:30, 33:14, לַגִּבְעָה ´מִמּ Ju 20:33 acc. to LXX (not B) Vulgate Be GFM al. (v. [מַעֲרֶה]).

title: VI ערב
content:
VI. ערב(√ of foll.; cf. Ar. غَرِبَ be black, غُرَابٌ crow (raven, rook, etc.); As. ârivu, êribu; Aram. ܥܽܘܪܒܳܐ, עוְּרְבָּא, all crow, raven).

[Str6158–59] † עֹרֵב n.m.:Lv 11:15 raven;—´הָע Gn 8:7 (J), Lv 11:15 (H) = Dt 14:14, Jb 38:41; כָּעוֺרֵב Ct 5:11 black as the raven; עֹרֵב ´בְּנֵ Psalm 147:9 young ravens; pl. abs. הָעֹרְבִים1 K 17:4, 17:6; cstr. עֹרְבֵי־נַחַל Pr 30:17.

[Str6155] † II. [עֲרָבָה] n.[m.] poplar (populus Euphratica = Ar. غَرَبٌ We in DeGn (4), 568 KerstenZPV ii. 209 De: Is (4) 44, 4 Löwp. 300 Anm.; NH עֲרָבָה √ obscure);—pl. abs. עֲרָבִים עַל־יִבְלֵי־מָיִם Is 44:4, cf. Psalm 137:2; cstr. עַרְבֵי־נָחַלLv 23:40 (H), Jb 40:22; נַחַל־הָעֲרָבִים Is 15:7 (a wady in Moab; identification dub., v. conjectures in BuhlGeogr. 124).

title: עָרַג
content:
[Str6166] † [עָרַג] vb. long for (cf. Ar. عَرَجَ ascend, II. bend, incline toward (على); عَرِيجٌ high, elevated; Eth. ዐርገ፡ ascend; NH עֲרוּגָה = BH);—Qal Impf. 3 fs. תַּעֲרֹג Psalm 42:2 (of stag, c. עַל rei in sim.); c. אֶל, of longing for God v:2 (subj. נַפְשִׁי), so תַּעֲרוֺג Jo 1:20 (of beasts, craving water).

[Str6170] † [עֲרוּגָה] n.f. garden terrace or bed;—cstr. עֲרוּגַת הַבּשֶֹׁם Ct 5:13 bed of balsam (sim.); pl. cstr. ´עֲרֻגוֺת הַבּ 6:2, מַטָּעָהּ ´ע Ez 17:7 i.e. where the vine was planted, עֲרֻגֹת צִמְחָהּ v:10 (all fig.).

[Str6166] † I. עֲרָד n. pr.loc. Can. city in the Negeb, Αραδ (Egypt. ‘a-ru-dâ WMM: As. u. Eur. 168, 170);—Ju 1:16, ´מֶלֶח־ע Nu 21:1 (JE) = 33:40, Jos 12:14 (D, Α(ι)ραθ, A LXXL Αδερ); prob. mod. Tel Arad, 16 1/2 miles S. of Hebron; cf. GFM: Ju 1:16 Buhl: Geogr. 182

[Str6166] † II. עֲרָד n.pr.m. Benjamite 1 Ch 8:15, Ωρηρ, A Αρωδ, LXXL Αραδ.

title: עָרָה
content:
[Str6168] † [עָרָה] vb. be naked, bare (Ar. عَرِىَ be naked; Ph. ערה [Pi.] lay bare (cf. Bloch Lzb); As. ûru, nakedness, also desert waste (cf. [עָרָה] infr.) JägerBAS ii. 282 and reff.; NH עֶרְוָה = BH, Targum עִירְיְתָא; Syr. ܥܪܳܝܽܘܬܳܐ in Lexx);—Pi. Pf. 3 ms. עֵרָה Is 22:6, Zp 2:14; Impf. 3 ms. יְעָרֶהIs 3:17; 3 fs. וַהְּעַר Gn 24:20; 2 ms. juss. תְּעַר Psalm 141:8; 3 mpl. וִיעָרוּ 2 Ch 24:11; Imv. mpl. עָ֫רוּ Psalm 137:7, 137:7; Inf. abs. עָרוֺת Hb 3:13 (Ges§ 75 n);—1. lay bare Is 3:17, 22:6, Zp 2:14 (indef. subj.); of laying foundations bare, i.e. tearing down walls, etc. Hb 3:13 (yet on text v. Now), abs. עָ֫רוּ עָרוּ Psalm 137:7, 137:7. 2. lay bare by removing contents, empty, water-jar Gn 24:20 (J; + אֶל loc.), chest 2 Ch 24:11. 3. pour out, אַל־תְּעַר נַפְּשִׁי Psalm 141:8 (i.e. slay). Hiph. Pf. 3 ms. הֶעֱרָה : 1. make naked, of sexual offences Lv 20:18, 20:19 (both ‖גִּלָּה). 2. pour out, לַמָּוֶת ´הֶע נַפְשׁוֺ Is 53:12 (fig. for slay, cf. Qal 3). Niph. pass. of Hiph. 2 : 3 ms. יֵעָרֶה עָלֵינוּ רוּחַ Is 32:15 (fig.) until there be poured upon us a spirit from on high. Hithp. 1. Impf. 2 fs. תִּתְעָרִָי La 4:21 thou shalt make thyself naked (of Edom under fig. of drunken woman). 2. Pt. מִתְעָרֶה Psalm 37:35 usu. pouring himself, i.e. spreading himself out like a tree (Bae doubts; Du מִתְעַלֶּה lifting himself up, cf. LXX).

[Str6169] † עָרָהע n.f. bare place;—pl. עָרוֺת Is 19:7 (si vera interpr.; > LXX ἄχ(ε)ι, Ki Saad reeds).

[Str6172] עֶרְוָה:54 n.f. nakedness, pudenda;—abs. ´ע Ex 28:42 Lv 18:6; usu. cstr. עֶרְוַת Gn 9:22 +, sf. עֶרְוָתְְֽ Ex 20:23 (Ginsb), Lv 18:10; עֶרְוָתֵךְ Is 47:3 +; תוֺ- Lv 20:17, תָהּ- 18:7 +; sf. 3 fpl. עֶרְוָתָן v:9, v:10; —1. pudenda, of man ´רָאָה ע implying shameful exposure Gn 9:22, 9:23 (J); mostly of woman: fig. of Jerus. (c. רָאָה) La 1:3, Ez 16:37; usu. c. נלה : lit. ´תִּגָּלֶה ע i.e. be exposed to view Ex 20:23 (Ginsb; van d. H. v26; E), so, as shameful punishment, fig. of Egypt Is 20:4 (gloss acc. to Du Che Di-Kit), Bab. 47:3, of Jerus. Ez 16:37, 23:10, 23:29 (עֶרְוַת זְנוּנַיִךְ; all three obj. of act. vb.); chiefly euphem. for cohabit., ´גִּלָּה ע Lv 18:6 + (v. גלה Pi. 1 a; fig. of Jerus. (vb. pass.) Ez 16:36; ´רָאָה ע in same meaning Lv 20:17, 20:17 (H; of both sexes); ´ע also 18:8, 18:10, 18:16 (H); ´כִּסָּה ע cover nakedness Gn 9:23 (J), Ex 28:42 (P; ´בְּשַר ע), Ho 2:11 (fig. of Isr.), Ez 16:8 (of Jerus.); reviling words are אִמְֶָּ ´לְבשֶׁת ע 1 S 20:30 (cf. Doughty: Arab. Deserta i. 269). 2. עֶרְוַת דָּבָר nakedness of a thing, i.e. prob. indecency, improper behaviour Dt 23:15, 24:1 (v. Dr). 3. fig. הָאָרֶץ ´ע Gn 42:9, 42:12 (E), i.e. its exposed, undefended parts (Ar. عَوْرَةٌ).

[Str6181] † עֶרְיָה :6 n.f. nakedness;—alw. abs. ´ע;—־בּשֶׁת´ע Mi 1:11 (in) nakedness, (in) shame (fig. of town Shaphir); of Jerus. ´עֵרֹם וְע Ez 16:7 + 3 t. (v. עֵרֹם sub II. עור); of bow Hb 3:9 (v. II. עור).

[Str4626,4629] † [מַעֲרֶה], מַ֫עַר n.[m.] bare, naked place (hence Μαραθών, Marathon, acc. to Lewy: Fremdw. 144);—1. bare place, or space: cstr. מִמַּעֲרִ־הָ+גּבַע Ju 20:33 bare (open) space of Geba’ (si vera 1.; but v. II. מַעֲרָב); כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ 1 K 7:36 according to the clear space on each (plate, v. לוּחַ). 2. sf. מַעְרֵח Na 3:5 fig. of Nineveh (pudenda exposed in shameful punishment; cf. עֶרְוָה).

[Str4638] † מַעֲרָת n.pr.loc in Judah Jos 15:59, Μαψαρωθ, A LXXL Μα(α)ρωθ.

[Str8593] † תַּ֫עַר n.m. :Psalm 52:4 and (Is 7:20) f. razor, sheath;—1. a. razor, abs. ´יְגַלַּח בְּת Is 7:20 (fig.); subj. of לאֹ יַעֲבֹר עַל־ראֹשׁ Nu 6:5, obj. of הֶעֱבִיר עַ־ל 8:7 (P), cf. cstr. הַגַּלָּבִים ´ת Ez 5:1; abs. מְלֻטָּשׁ ´כְּת Psalm 52:4 (sim. of tongue). b. cstr. הַסֹּפֵר ´ת Je 36:23 = penknife. 2. sheath, always sf. of sword: בְּתַעְרָהּ 2 S 20:8; of drawing sword, ´שָׁלַף מִתּ 1 S 17:51, ´הוֺצִיא מִתּ Ez 21:8, 21:10, ´תֵּצֵא מִתּ v:9; of sheathing, הֵאָֽסְפִי אֶל־תַּרְעֵךְ Je 47:6; הָשַׁב אֶל־תַּעְרָהּ Ez 21:35.

[Str6171] † עָרוֺד n.[m.] wild ass (prob. Aram. loanword ( = Heb. פֶּרֶא), Targum עֲרָדָא, עֲרוֺדָא Syr. ܥܪܳܕܳܐ; Mand. אראדא, cf. Hom: NS 133);—Jb 39:5.

789:a. עָרוֺד: perh. √ عرّد [run away?], < √ غرد schreien [DHM zu Aṣma‘ï, Farq p.43] das auch vom Wildesel vorkommt Amra alqais 4. 21, Zuhair 1. 25.’—NöFünf Mo‘all, ii. 75 (SB Wlender Ak. cxlii).

title: עָרַךְ
content:
[Str6186] † עָרַךְ vb. arrange or set in order (NH id.; also roll dough, Targum עֲרַךְ id.; Ph. ערכת CIS: No. 132:4 valuation, Bloch, but dub.; Ar. عَرَكَ III. contend in battle, مَعْرَكٌ, مَعْرَكَةٌ battleground);—Qal Pf. 3 ms. ´ע Jb 32:14, 2 Ch 13:3, ´וְע consec. Lv 1:12, 6:5; עָרַכְתִּי Nu 23:4 +, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יַעֲרֹךְ Ex 27:21 +, etc.; Imv. עֶרְכָה Jb 33:5, עִרְכוּ Je 46:3, 50:14; Inf. abs. עָרֹךְ Is 21:5; cstr. עֲרְֹ Ju 20:22 +; Pt. act. pl. עֹרְכִים Is 65:11, etc.; pass. עָרוּךְ Je 6:23 +, cstr. עֱרוּךְ Jo 2:5, etc.;—not in D;—1. a. arrange in order, seven altars Nu 23:4, i.e. I have built seven altars in a row (cf. בנה v:1), flax-stalks Jos 2:6 (both JE); esp. b. set or lay in order, as wood Gn 22:9 (E), 1 K 18:33, cf. Tophet Is 30:33, Lv 1:7; offerings Lv 1:8, 1:12, 6:5; lamp(s) Ex 27:21, Lv 24:3, 24:4 (all P), lamp (fig. of dynasty) Psalm 132:17; ‘shew’–bread Ex 40:4, 40:23 (upon [עַל] sacred שֻׁלְחָן both c. acc. cogn.), Lv 24:8 (P). c. in common life (cf. RS: Sem i. 189 f., 2nd ed. 200 f.), arrange a table (i.e. dishes in order upon it), שֻׁלְחָן Is 21:5, Pr 9:2 (fig. of wisdom), Ez 23:41 (of Jerus. in fig.); Psalm 23:5, 78:19 (fig.; subj. God); in idolatr. worship Is 65:11. d. arrange a battle, i.e. draw up in battle order, מִלְחָמָה Ju 20:22, 1 S 17:8, 2 S 10:8 = 1 Ch 19:9, 1 Ch 12:37 (van d. H. v36), 2 Ch 14:9, עֹרְכֵי מִלְחָמָה 1 Ch 12:34, 12:36 (van d. H. v33, v35); ´עֱרוּךְ מ Jo 2:5; + אֵת with, i.e. against Ju 20:20, Gn 14:8, עִם 2 Ch 13:8; + לִקְרַאת 1 S 17:2, 1 Ch 19:17 b; מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת ´ע 1 S 17:21; לַמִּלְחָמָה עָרוּךְ כְּאִישׁ Je 6:23, 50:42; obj. om. Ju 20:22, 20:23, + לִקְרַאת 1 S 4:2, 2 S 10:9, 10:10 = 1 Ch 19:10, 19:11, 2 S 10:17; + אֶל against Ju 20:30, Je 50:14, 1 Ch 19:17 a, לְ against Je 50:9; —Jb 6:4 read יַעַכְרוּנִי Di Bu Du. e. arrange weapons of army in order for battle Je 46:3, 1 Ch 12:9 (van d. H. v8). f. arrange words (מִלִּין) Jb 32:14 (אֶל ֔ against), so (obj. om.) 33:5 (לְפָנַי ֔), 37:19, Psalm 5:4 (prob.; > of arranging a sacrifice); cf. recount things in order, יַעְרְכֶהָ לִי Is 44:7. g. state in order, set forth a legal case Jb 13:18, 23:4, so prob. (obj. om.) of God Psalm 50:21 (לְעֵינֶיְ ֔), and (pass. of בְּרִית) 2 S 23:5 (cf. Dr).—הֲיַעֲרֹךְ שׁועך Jb 36:19 is difficult: Di will he set thy cry (שַׁוְעְֲ) in order? BI (for לאֹ) לוֺ ´הֲיֵעָרֵךְ שׁ shall thy cry be set in order unto him? (sense good, although Niph. not found); v. al. in Di. 2. a. compare (as result of arranging in order): ־לוֺ´מַה־דְּמוּת תַּע Is 40:18 what likeness will ye compare to him? אֵין עֲרֹךְ אֵלֶיְ Psalm 40:6. b. intrans. be comparable, c. לְ, Psalm 89:7 (‖דָּמָה), c. sf. of thing compared Jb 28:17, 28:19.

[Str6187] עֵ֫רֶךְ :33 n.m. :Lv 27:25 order, row, estimate;—cstr. ´ע Ju 17:10, Ex 40:23; sf. עֶרְכִּי Psalm 55:14, עֶרְכְּ Lv 5:15 +, etc.;—1. order, row, בְּגָדִים ´ע Ju 17:10 a (complete) suit of clothes (laid out in order), LXX: B στολὴν ἱμαρίν; לֶחֶם ´ע Ex 40:23 i.e. loaves arranged in a row, so ´ע alone v:4 (P); עֶרְכּוֺ Jb 41:4 his symmetry (v. חִין sub חנן). 2. estimate, valuation, made by ordering, classifying: אִישׁ כְּעֶרְכּוֺ 2 K 23:35; in 12:5 read עֵרֶךְ (for MT עוֺנֵּר) money of a man's valuation LXX Benz Kit, and prob. del. כֶּסֶף נַפְשׁוֺת עֶרְכּוֺ (? ´עֶרֶח נ ´כ Kit) as gloss (StaZAW v (1885), 288 f.); כְּעֶרְכִּי Psalm 55:14 a man acc. to my valuation, fig. for my equal; elsewhere P, of priest's valuation of trespass-offering Lv 5:15, 5:18, 5:25, vows, and redemption-money 27:2, 27:3, 27:3, 27:4 + 17 t. 27 (כֶּסֶף עֶרְכְּ v.15, v:19, מִכְסַת הָעֶרְכְּ v:23 [del. ךְָ], cf. v:23 b [del. id.]), Nu 18:16.—Jb 28:13 read דַּרְכָּהּ LXX Di al.

[Str6186] † [עָרַךְ] vb. denom. Hiph. value (for taxation), tax (from עֵרֶח 2.);—Pf. 3 ms. הֶעֶרִיח אֶת־הָאָרֶץ 2 K 23:35; in P, ´וְהֶע consec., c. acc. Pers. Lv 27:8, 27:12 c.sf. v:14; Impf.. יַעֲרִיח v:14; sf. יַעֲרִיכֶנּוּ v:8.

[Str4633] † [מַעֲרָךְ] n.[m.] arrangement;—pl. cstr. מַעַרְכֵיסּלֵב Pr 16:1 to man belong arrangements (plans) of the mind (cf. לֵב 3).

[Str4634,4630] † מַעֲרָכָה n.f. row, rank, battle-line;—1. a. ´מ battle-line 1 S 4:2, 4:12, 4:16, 4:16; ´וַיָּ֫רָץ הַמּ 17:22 and he ran to the battle-line, so v:28 (on ref. here to Isr.'s line of. HPS), ´לפְרַאת מ ´מ v:21; ´עֹדְרֵי מ 1 Ch 12:39 (van d. H. v38); nearly = battle הַחַיִל ´הַאיּצֵא אֶל־הַמּ 1 S 17:20. b. pl. ranks = army; cstr. ´מַעַרְכוֺת יִש 1 S 17:10, 17:45, ´מַעַרְכֹת יִש v:8; ´מ אֱלּהִים חַיִּים v:26, v:36; פְּלִשְׁתִּים ´מ 23:3 and 17:23 Qr, so LXXA (v. om. B) Valgate Targum; sg. LXXL SyrVer (> Kt מערות). 2. נֵרוֺת הַמַּעֲרָכָה Ex 39:37 lamps of the row, i.e. arranged in a row.

790:a. מַעֲרָכָה ad fin.: add ‘3. order, arrangement: ´בַּמּ: Ju 6:26 in the (proper or usual) arrangement of an alter, cf. עָרַח 1 a Nu 23:4 of alter.’

[Str4635] † מַּעֲרֶ֫נֶת n.f. row, line;—only of the rows of ‘shew’-bread; abs. ´מ Lv 24:7, מַעֲרָכֶת v:6 (P); elsewh. Chr: ´לֶחֶם הַמּ 1 Ch 9:32, 23:29, Ne 10:34, ´שֻׁלְחַן הַמּ 2 Ch 29:18, cf. 1 Ch 28:16; cstr. מַעֲרֶכֶת לֶחֶם 2 Ch 13:11 the row of bread, so ´מ 2:3 the row of continuity, bread continually present in rows; pl. abs. שׁתַּיִם מַעֲרָכוֺת Lv 24:6.

title: ערל
content:
ערל (√ of foll,; meaning dub.; cf. Ar. غُرْلَةٌ foreskin; Aram. עוּרְלְתָא, ܠܘܬܐܥܘܕ; NH = BH; also Egypt. karna θ a BrugschÄZ 1876, 128 KrallSB der Wlener Ak., hist.-phil. Cl. cxvi (1888), 659 f.).

[Str6190] עָרְלָה:16 n.f. foreskin;—´ע Gn 34:14, Je 9:24; cstr. עָרְלַת Ex 4:25, Dt 10:16, etc.; pl. הָעֲרָלוֺת (not ´ֳ) Jos 5:3 (Köii. 1, 158); cstr. עָרְלוֺת Je 4:4 + 2 t.; עָרְלֽתֵיהֶם 1 S 18:27; —foreskin 1 S 18:25, 18:27, 2 S 3:14, cf. נִּבְעַת הָעֲרָלוֺם Jos 5:3 hill of the foreskins, near Gilgal; of circumcision, ´כרת ע Ex 4:25 (J), ´בְּשַר ע Gn 17:11 + 5 t. P (v. II. מוּל), אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר ´לוֺ ע Gn 34:14 (P), i.e. one uncircumcised; cf. Je 9:24; fig. of fruit trees, עָרְלָתוֺ Lv 19:23 (P; v. [עָרַל]; fig. of heart, לבב ´ע Dt 10:16, Je 4:4.

[Str6188] † [עָרַל] vb. denom. count as foreskin, i.e. as uncircumcised;—Qal Pf. 2 mpl., c. acc. cogn. וַעֲרַלְתֶּם עָרְלָתוֺ Lv 19:23 ye shall regard its fruit as uncircumcised, and not eat it (for three years) (> SS remove its foreskin (its fruit), as Vulgate, cf. LXX περικαθαριεῖτε τὴν ἀκαθαπσίαν ά̓τοῦ). Niph. Imv. הֵעָרֵל Hb 2:16 be counted uncircumcised, i.e. be object of mockery; but dub., read probably הֵרָעֵל reel (LXX SyrVer We Now BuhlLex).

[Str6189] † עָרֵל:35 adj. having foreskin, i.e. uncircumcised;—´ע Ex 12:48 + 5 t.; cstr. עֶ֫רֶל Ez 44:9, 44:9; עֲרַל Ex 6:12, 6:30; f. עֲרִלָה Je 6:10; pl. עֲרִלִים Lv 19:23 + 20 t.; cstr. עַרְלֵי Je 9:25 + 2 t.;—uncircumcised person Ex 12:48, Jos 5:7 (P), Philistines Ju 14:3, 15:18, 1 S 14:6, 17:26, 17:36, 31:4, 2 S 1:20, 1 Ch 10:4; of other nations Is 52:1, Je 9:25; esp. as slain Ez 28:10, 31:18, 32:19 + 9 t. 32; in v:27 rd. מֵעוֺלָם so Hi and most (v. on meaning Toy31, 18); עָרֵל זָכָר uncircumcised male Gn 17:14 (P); בָּשָר ´ע Ez 44:7, 44:9 uncircumcised of flesh; fig. of fruit trees Lv 19:23 (cf. [עָרַל] supr.); שְפָתַיִם ´ע fig. of incapacity to speak Ex 6:12, 6:30; of character, לב ´ע Je 9:25, Ez 44:7, 44:9, cf. לֵבָבָם הֶעָרֵל Lv 26:41 (P), עֲרֵלָה אָזְנָם Je 6:10 their ear is uncircumcised (unreceptive).

[Str5903,6174] עֵרֹם, עָרֹם, עָרוֺם v.II. עור p. 735 f

title: I עָרַם
content:
[Str6192] † I. [עָרַם] vb. Niph. be heaped up (cf. Sab. אערמחו pl. of [ערם] dam, so Ar. عَرِمٌ cf. DHMZMG xxx (1876), 676; VOJ i. 25 who cp. BH עֲרִמָה Ar. عَرَمَةٌ (which Frä135 thinks Aram. loan-word), cf. ܥܪܰܡ Pa. heap up; > WetzstZeitschr. für Ethnol. 1873, 279 (Syr. Dreschtafel) who cp. عَرَمَ strip [whence עַרְמוֺן infr.], and thinks עֲרֵמָה = bare heap);- Pf. 3 pl. נֶעֶרְמוּ מַיִם Ex 15:8.

[Str6194] † עֲרֵמָה n.f. heap;—abs. ´ע Ru 3:7; cstr. עֲרֵמַת Hg 2:16, Ct 7:3; pl. עֲרֵמוֺת abs. Ne 13:15 +, cstr. 3:34; abs. עֲרִמִים Je 50:26; —heap of rubbish (עָפָר) Ne 3:34; ´ע = ruin-heap Je 50:26; = grain-heap (of threshed grain, عَرَمَةٌ unthreshed, acc. to Wetzstl.c.), Hg 2:16, Ne 13:15, Ru 3:7; חִטִּים ´ע Ct 7:3; of grain and fruit 2 Ch 31:6, 31:6, 31:7, 31:8, 31:9.

title: II ערם
content:
II. ערם (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. عَرَمَ strip flesh from bone (to eatit), strip leaves from trees (said of camels); عُرَامٌ bark of tree (stripped off)).

[Str6196] † עַרְמוֺן n.[m.] plane-tree (as stripped of bark);—´ע Gn 30:37 (J); pl. עַרְמֹנִים Ez 31:8.

[Str4636] מַעֲרֻמֵּיהֶם 2 Ch 28:15 v. sub II. עור. p. 736

title: עָרֹם
content:
[Str6191] † [עָרֹם LagBN 31] vb. be shrewd, crafty (NH id., Hiph.; Ar. عَرَمَ, عَرِمَ, عَرُمَ be ill-natured, cross; Targum adj. עָרִים shrewd, Syr. ܥܪܝܡ id., and vb. in der. spec. (Pe. in Lexx.));—Qal Inf. abs. in עָרֹם יַעְרִם 1 S 23:22 he is exceedingly crafty. Hiph. Impf. be crafty, 3 ms. יַעְרִם 1 S 23:22; be or become shrewd יַעְרִם Pr 15:5, 19:25; all these Qal Impf. in —ִ acc. to BaZMG xliii (1889), 180 so Ges§ 63 n BuhlLex, but perh. rd. יֶעְרַם as Qal; true Hiph. in 3 mpl. יַעֲרִימוּ סוֺד Psalm 83:4 they make crafty (their) counsel against thy people.

[Str6193] † [עֹ֫רֶם] n.[m.] craftiness;—sf. בְּעָרְמָם Jb 5:13 (possibly from עָרְמָה Ges§ 91 e al.).

[Str6195] † עָרְמָה n.f. craftiness, prudence;—1. ´בְע craftily Ex 21:14 (E), Jos 9:4 (JE). 2. ´ע in Pr, in good sense, prudence Pr 1:4, 8:5, 8:12.

[Str6175] † עָרוּם adj. crafty, shrewd, sensible;—1. crafty, ´ע as pred., of serpent Gn 3:1; pl. as subst. מַחְשְׁבוֺת עֲרוּמִים Jb 5:12, ´לְשׁוֺן ע 15:5. 2. in Pr, in good sense (opp. אֱוִיל, כְּסִיל, פֶּתִי); as attrib. אָדָם עָרוּם Pr 12:23 a shrewd or sensible man; ´ע as subst. = id., v:16, 13:16, so ´חָכְמַת ע v:8; = prudent man 14:15, 22:3, 27:12; pl. עֲרוּמִים 14:18.

[Str6197–98] עֵרָן, עֵרָנִי v. sub I. עור. p. 735

title: ערס
content:
ערס (√ of foll.).

[Str6182] † [עֲרִיסָה] n.f. meaning dub., usu. coarse meal; LXX AV RV dough, so Toy (with ?) (NH עַרְסָן barley-meal; Syr. ܐܰܪܣܳܢܳܐ (in Lexx) hulled barley, or (cf. LagGGN 1889, 301 f.) wheat); > SmEz CoEz kneading-trough (so NH עֲרִיסָה Jastr; appar. secondary, עֲרִיסָה also [bed], cradle, v. ערש);—only רֵאשִׁית עֲרִיסֹתֵיכֶם Ez 44:30, עֲרִיסֹתֵינוּ ´ר Ne 10:38; עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם ´ר Nu 15:20, 15:21 (P).

[Str6176–77,6199] עַרְעָר, עַרְעֹר, עֲרֹעֵר, עֲרוֺעֵר v. II. ערר

title: I ערף
content:
I. ערף (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; NH עוֺרֶף = BH; Ar. عُرْفٌ mane of horse, also part of neck where hair grows, etc.).

[Str6203] † עֹ֫רֶף n.m.:Dt 31:27 back of neck, neck;—´ע abs. Jos 7:12 +; cstr. Gn 49:8 +; sf. עָרְפִּי Jb 16:12, עָרְפְּ Dt 31:27, etc.;—1. back of neck of fleeing foe ´וגו ´יָֽדְ בְּע Gn 49:8 (poem in J), cf. וְאָחַז בְּעָרְפִּי Jb 16:12 (fig.); Ex 23:27 (E), Psalm 18:41 = 2 S 22:41; turn (הָפַח, פָּנָה) one's back before (לִפְנֵי) a foe Jos 7:8, 7:12 (JE), abs. Je 48:39; fig. of apostasy אֶל ´פָּנָה ע Je 2:27, 32:33 (opp. פָּנָה פָנִים) abs. ´וַיִּתְּנּוּ ע 2 Ch 29:6; of ´י's disfavour וְלאֹ פָנִים אֶרְאֵם ´ע Je 18:17 with the back and not the face will I look at them. 2. fig. in ´קְשֵׁה־ע stiff of neck, i.e. obstinate, of Isr. Ex 32:8, 33:3, 33:5, 34:9 (all JE), Dt 9:6, 9:13; עָרְפְּ הַקָּשֶׁה Dt 31:27; with vb. ´הִקְשָׁה ע i.e. be obstinate, intractable 10:16, Je 7:26, 17:23, 19:15, 2 K 17:14, 17:14, Ne 9:16, 9:17, 9:29, 2 Ch 30:8; cf. ´גִּיד בַּרְזֶל ע Is 48:4 (‖קָשֶׁה אָתָּה); ´הִקְשָׁה ע of individual 2 Ch 36:13, Pr 29:1. 3. of bird: nip its head מִמּוּל עָרְפּוֺ Lv 5:8 (P).

[Str6202] † [עָרַף] vb. denom. break the neck of an animal;—Qal Pf. 2 ms. sf. וַעֲרַפְתּוֺ consec. Ex 13:13, 34:20 (JE), 3 pl. וְעָֽרְפוּ־שָׁם אֶת־הָעֶגְלָה consec. Dt 21:4; Pt. act. עוֺרֵף כֶּלֶב Is 66:3; pass. הָעֶגְלָה הָעֲרוּפָה Dt 21:6; Impf. 3 ms. יַעֲרֹף Ho 10:2 fig. of breaking down altars.

[Str6204] † עָרְפָּה n.pr.f. sister-in-law of Ruth, Ru 1:4, 1:14, Ορφα.

title: II עָרַף
content:
[Str6201] † II. [עָרַף] vb. drip, drop (cf. Ar. غَرَفَ lade out water with the hand (as with ladle), cf. Ph. ערפת portico (whence rain drips) v. HoffmAbh. d. GGW xxxvi, May, 1889, 12 f.; cf. also Ar. غُرْفَةٌ upper-room; מערף ענן Ecclus 43:22 the dropping of a cloud, As. irpu, irpitu, cloud(s));—Qal Impf. 3 mpl. שָׁמָיו יַעַרְפוּ־טָל Dt 33:28 his heavens drop dew; fig., of speech, intrans., יַעֲרֹף כַּמָּטָר לִקְחִי 32:2 let my teaching drop like the rain (‖תִּזַּל כַּטַּל אִמְרָתִי).—Cf. רָעַף.

[Str6183] † [עָרִיף] n.[m.] cloud;—pl. sf. בַּעֲרִיפֶיהָ Is 5:30 (PerlesJQ 1899, 689 prop. בְּעַד יָפְיָהּ, referring sf. to ארץ, and cp. Psalm 139:11).

[Str6205] † עֲרָפֶל n.m. cloud, heavy cloud (perh. fr. above √ + ל afform.; NH = BH; Syr. ܥܰܪܦܶܠܴܐ; Targum עֲרָפֵילָא; Mand. ארפילא NöM 126, 128; on vocaliz. v. BaNB 160 and against him SchwallyZAW x (1890), 178 who prop. עַרְפֶּל);—´ע in which God dwells Ex 20:18 (Gi; van d. H. v21), 1 K 8:12 = 2 Ch 6:1; + עָנָן Dt 4:11 (also חשֶׁח), 5:19, Psalm 97:2; Jb 22:13 v. בַּעַד; תַּחַת רַגְלָיו ´ע 2 S 22:10 = Psalm 18:10; as swaddling-bands of sea Jb 38:9; fig. of misery Is 60:2 (‖חשֶׁח); of ´י's judgment Je 13:16 (‖צַלְמָוֶת), as a past day ´יוֺם עָנָן וַע Ez 34:12 = (of future day of ´י) Zp 1:15 (‖יוֺם חשֶׁח וַאֲפֵלָה) = Jo 2:2 (‖ id.).

title: עָרַץ
content:
[Str6206] † [עָרַץ] vb. cause to tremble, tremble (in terror, or awe) (cf. Ar. عَرِصَ quiver, flicker; Syr. ܥܪܰܨ come upon suddenly or violently, PS s.v. passim; cf. Egypt. ‘u-ra-ḏ-au(t), they terrified (= ערצו) WMMAs. u. Eur. 76);—Qal Impf. 2 ms. תַּעֲרֹץ Dt 7:21 +; 2 fs. תַּעֲרָוֺצִי Is 47:12; 1 S. אֶעֱרוֺץ Jb 31:34, etc.; Inf. cstr. עֲרֹץ Is 2:19 +;—1. cause to tremble (i.e. strike with awe) c. acc. הָאָרֶץ Is 2:19, 2:21 (subj. ´י; ins. prob. also v:10); הֶעָלֶה נִדָּף ´תַּע Jb 13:25 wilt thou strike with awe the driven leaf ? abs. cause trembling = inspire awe Is 47:12 (of Bab.), Psalm 10:18. 2. intrans. tremble, feel dread (D), Dt 1:29, 7:21, 20:3, 31:6, Jos 1:9; c. acc. Jb 31:34 because I stood in awe of the great multitude. Niph. Pt. אֵל נַעֲרָץ Psalm 89:8 El, terrible in the company of the holy ones (‖נוֺרָא). Hiph. 1. regard, or treat, with awe, as awful: 2 mpl. וְלאֹ תַעֲרִָיצוּ Is 8:12 (acc. מוֺרָאוֺ); 3 mpl. יַעֲרִָיצוּ 29:23 acc. ´אֶת־אֱלֽהֵי יִש. 2. inspire with awe (cf. Qal 2);—Pt. sf. הוּא מַעֲרִֽצְכֶם Is 8:13 he shall be your awe-inspirer.

[Str6178] † [עָרוּץ] adj. dreadful (prop. Pt. pass.) cstr. בַּעֲרוּץ נְחָלִים Jb 30:6 in the (most) dreadful of ravines.

[Str6184] † עָרִיץ adj. awe-inspiring, terror-striking;—´ע of ´י, כְּגִבּוֺר עָרִיץ Je 20:11; pl. as subst. עָרִיצִים, in bad sense of formidable adversaries, personal, Je 15:21 (‖רָעִים), Jb 6:23 (‖צָר), and national, Psalm 54:5 (‖זָרִים), = ´עֲדַת ע 86:14 (‖זֵדִים), ´הֲמוֺן ע Is 29:5 (‖זָרָיִח); esp. of Chaldeans Is 13:11, cstr. עָרִצֵי גוֺיִם most terrifying of the nations Ez 28:7 (‖זָרִים) 30:11, 31:12 (‖זָרִים), 32:12; so (prob.) sg. עָרִיץ Is 49:25 (rd. ´ע also for צַדִּיק v:24, so Lo Ew Che Gr al.); without specif. ref. גּוֺיִם עָרִיצִים Is 25:3 awe-inspiring nations (Du Che take ´ע as subst.), ´רִוּחַ ע v:4 (del. as gloss Di al.), ´זְמִיר ע v:5 (del. verse as gloss Du Che); late, of wicked in gen., as ruthless ´רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע ע Psalm 37:35 I have seen a wicked man ruthless; as subst., Is 29:20 (‖לֵץ), Jb 15:20 (‖רשׁע), pl. 27:13 (‖ id.), Pr 11:16; rd. also (ים)עָרִיצִ Is 11:4 (for MT אֶרֶץ), so Che BrMP Du Gr al. (‖רָשָׁע).

[Str4637] † מַעֲרָצָה n.f. awful shock, crash;—Is 10:33, of ´י's lopping off (tree-)crown (fig.).

title: עָרַק
content:
[Str6207] † [עָרַק] vb. gnaw (Ar. عَرَقَ id.; Syr. ܥܪܱܩ Pa.);—Qal Pt. pl. הַעֹרְקִים צִיָּה Jb 30:3 they who gnaw the dry (ground; fig. of scanty subsistence); sf. עֹרְקַי v:17 my gnawing (pains) do not sleep.

792:a. [עָרַק] = Syriac. in Lexx., and Pa.; but Syriac. usu. flee, as Targum.

[Str6208] † עַרְקִי adj. gent. Arḳite, inhabitant of city ï Arḳa (As. Arḳa COTGloss. DlPa 282, TelAm. Irḳat(a), Egypt. Arḳantu, cf. As. n.gent. Irḳanatai COTGloss, Ency. Bib.:i. 310);—only ´הָע as n.coll. Gn 10:17, τὸν Αρουκαῖον, = 1 Ch 1:15, A id., LXXL τὸν Αρακει: mod. ‘ Arḳa, near Mediterranean, c. 60 miles N. of Beirut (cf. Ency. Bib.:l. c.).

title: I ערר
content:
I. ערר (√ of foll.; on this [and not עור] v. NöZMG xxxii (1878), 404 LagSymm. ii. 91 f.; cf. Palm. מערתא sepulchre).

[Str4631,4632] מְעָרָה:40 n.f. cave;—abs. ´מ Gn 19:30 +; cstr. מְעָרַת 23:19 +; pl. מְעָרוֺת Ju 6:2 +, cstr. id. Is 2:19; —cave, esp. as place of sojourn or refuge Gn 19:30 (J), 1 S 24:3, 24:3, 24:7, 24:8, 24:10 (Ginsb; v4, v8, v9, v11 van d. H. Bear), 1 K 19:1, 19:13, Ez 33:27, Jos 10:16 (בַמַּקֵּדָה ´מ) + 7 t. Jos 10, Ju 6:2, 1 S 13:6, 1 K 18:4, 18:13, cf. Psalm 57:1, 142:1; מְעָרוֺת צֻרִים Is 2:19, hence פָּרִצִים ´מ Je 7:11 robbers' cave; Is 32:14 den (of wild beasts);—עֲדֻלָּם ´מ 1 S 22:1, 2 S 23:13, whence in ‖ 1 Ch 11:15, rd. prob. ´מְצֻדַת ע or מְצָדַת We, cf. Dr, Bu Kit HPS;—as burial place, הַמַּכְפֵּלָה ´מ Gn 23:9 + (v. מַכְפֵּלָה) = ´מ alone 23:11, 23:17, 23:20, 49:29, 49:32 (all P). אֲשֶׁר לַצִּידֹנִים ´מ Jos 13:4 (D), cave-region in Lebanon E. of Sidon, mod. Mughâr Ǧezzîn, acc. to most, but dub.; perhaps, rather, near Tyre BuhlMDPV 1895, 55.

title: II עָרַר
content:
[Str6209] † II. [עָרַר] vb. strip oneself (‖ form of ערה, II. עור);—Qal Imv. עֹ֫רָה Is 32:11 (‖פְּשֹׁ֫טָה; acc. to Ges§ 110 k Hi De al. ms. with fpl. subj.; acc. to Ew§ 226 a Du Di al. fpl., shortened from ערנה etc.). Pō‘. Pf. 3 pl. עוֺרְרוּ אַרְמְנוֺתֶיהָ Is 23:13 they have laid bare (the foundations of) her palaces, i.e. destroyed them; so Pilp. Inf. abs. + Hithpalp. Impf. 3 fs. עַרְעֵר תִּתְעַרְעַר Je 51:58 be laid utterly bare, cf. ערה Pi. 1.

[Str6185] † עֲרִירִי adj. stripped, specif. childless;—´ע Gn 15:2 (JE), Je 22:30; pl. עֲרִירִים Lv 20:20, 20:21 (H).

[Str6199,6176] † עַרְעָר adj. stripped, destitute;—´הָע as subst. Psalm 102:18 the prayer of the destitute.—Je 17:6 v. עֲרוֺעֵר. below

[Str6176] † I. עֲרוֺעֵר n.[m.] prob. a tree or bush; juniper ? (Ar. عَرْعَرٌ juniper (or cypress ? v. Lane), so TristrNHB 358 RobBR ii. 124; on format. v. LagBN 162 BaNB 160);—עֲרוֺעֵר בַּמִּדְבָּר Je 48:6, + 17:6, where rd. prob. עֲרֹעֵר בָּעֲרָבָה (for MT עַרְעָר; > Gf al. conversely, rd. עַרְעָר 48:6).

[Str6177,5735] † II. עֲרֹעֵר:10, עֲרוֺעֵר:5, עַרְעֹר:1 n.pr.loc. Αροηρ, MI26 ערער;—1. city on N. bank of Arnon, S. limit of E. Jordan Isr., עֲרֹעֵר Nu 32:34 (JE), Dt 2:36, 3:12, 4:48, Jos 12:2 (D) 2 K 10:33, 1 Ch 5:8; עֲרוֺעֵר Jos 13:9 (D), v:16 (P), 2 S 24:5; Moabitish Je 48:19 (cf. MI26); once עַרְעֹר Ju 11:26; mod. ‘ Ar‘âir Buhl Geogr. 269, TristrMoab 129 ff. 2. city near Rabbah in Ammon, עֲרֹעֵר Ju 11:33, ´עֲרוֺ Jos 13:25 (P), site unknown. 3. city in S. Judah, עֲרֹעֵר 1 S 30:28 (LXX Αροηρ + Αμμαδει, latter orig. acc. to We, indicating form ערערה; LXXL Παγουηλ); + Jos 15:22 rdg. ´ע (or עַרְעָרָה) for MT עַדְעָרָה, LXXB Αρουηλ, We:1 S 30:28 (cf. Dr HPS), DIad loc. Benn Steuern; poss. ‘ Ar‘âra c. 9 miles S. of E. from Beersheba, but cf. BuhlGeogr. 183.—Is 17:2 rd. עָרֶיהָ עֲדֵי עַד LXX Lo LagSem. i. 30 Che BuhlLex al. (for MT עָרֵי עֲרֹעֵר).—Vid. also CheEncy. Bib. 317.

[Str6200] † עֲרֹעֵרִי adj. gent. of foreg.; ´הָע 1 Ch 11:44.

title: ערש
content:
ערש (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. عَرْشٌ booth, shed, throne, عَرِيشٌ grape-trellis, woman's (camel-) saddle; Eth. ዐረሽ፡ booth (? also ዐርኣት፡ bed); As. irsûu, bed, couch; NH עֲרִיסָה cradle, Targum עַרְסָא, Syr. ܥܰܪܣܳܐ, Palm. ערשא; the common idea is appar. that of a wooden structure, frame, cf. NöZMG xi (1886), 737).

[Str6210] † עֶ֫רֶש n.f.:Jb 7:13 couch, divan;—cstr. ´ע Dt 3:11 +; abs. עָרֶש Am 3:12; sf. עַרְשִי Jb 7:13 +, etc.; pl. sf. עַרְשוֺתָם Am 6:4; —couch, divan, Am 3:12, 6:4 (‖מִטּוֺת), + 2 S 17:28 (rd. עַרְשת מִשְׁכָּב Klo NeMarg. 18 HPS, cf. LXX); for lying at night Jb 7:13, Psalm 6:7 (‖מִטָּה), Pr 7:16, עֶרֶש יְצוּעָי Psalm 132:3 the coach of (consisting in) my bed; couch of sickness Psalm 41:4; marriage couch Ct 1:16; perhaps transf. to sarcophagus, as last couch עַרְשוֺ עֶרֶש בַּרְזֶל Dt 3:11 (v. Dr).

title: ערשׁ
content:
ערשׁ (√ of foll.; meaning unknown).

[Str3298] † יַעֲרֶשְׁיָה n.pr.m. Benjamite 1 Ch 8:27, Ιασαραια, A Ιαρασια, LXXL Ιερσια.

title: עשב
content:
עשב (√ of foll.; mng. dub.; cf. As. ešêbu [bear fruit], II. I, causat. (DlPr 87), išbu, perh. = H; Ar. عَشِبَ is be dry, but عُشْبٌ fresh, juicy herbage; NH = BH, cf. Targum עִסְבָּא, Syr. ܥܶܣܒܳܐ, Palm. עשביא).

[Str6212] † עֵ֫שֶב n.m.:Gn 1:11 herb, herbage;—´ע abs. Dt 11:15 +; cstr. Gn 2:5 +; sf. עֶשְבָּם Is 42:15; pl. cstr. עִשְּבוֺת (d. f. dirim.) Pr 27:25; —herb, herbage, in oldest use oft. gen. (therefore incl. grass [דֶּשֶׁא]): הַשָּדֶה ´ע Ex 9:22 (E), Gn 2:5 (+ שִיחַ) Ex 9:25 (+ עֵץ), 10:15 (+ id; all J) Am 7:2, so הָאָרֶץ ´ע Ex 10:12 (E), + פְּרִי הָעֵץ v:15 (J), whence Psalm 105:35; appar. gen. also in הארץ ´ע Jb 5:25, Psalm 72:16, ´ע alone 92:8; כָּל־הַשָּדֶה ´ע Je 12:14, ´ע alone Dt 32:2 (‖דֶּשֶׁא), Is 42:15, Psalm 102:5, 102:12, and Dt 29:22, Mi 5:6, Pr 19:12; hence ´ע as food for cattle Dt 11:15, Psalm 106:20 cf. Je 14:6, Zc 10:1; עִשְּבוֺת הָרִים Pr 27:25 (‖דֶּשֶׁא, חָצִיר); but as human food (hence excluding דֶּשֶׁא) הַשָּדֶה ´ע Gn 3:18 (J); esp. P Gn 1:29 (+ עֶץ), ´יֶרֶק ע v:30, 9:3, hence ´ע Psalm 104:14 (‖חָצִיר for cattle); ´ע disting. fr. דֶּשֶׁא, עֵץ also Gn 1:11, 1:12, שָדֶה ´ע + דֶּשֶׁא, חָצִיר 2 K 19:26 + Is 37:27.

title: I עָשָה
content:
[Str6213] I. עָשָה:2622 vb. do, make (NH = BH; MI23, MI26 עשתי, l.:3, l.:9 ואעש, l.:24 Imv. עשו; OH n.pr. עשיו, אלעשה, מעשיהו; not Aram., and not certainly found in S. Sem. lang.; on Sab. v. esp. DHMSB Berl. Ak. 1886, 849);—Qal:2524 Pf. 3 ms. Gn 3:1 +, sf. עָשָהוּ Ho 8:6 +; 3 fs. עָֽשְתָה Dt 22:21 +, וְעָשָת consec. Lv 25:21; 2 ms. עָשִיתָ Gn 3:14 +, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יַעֲשֶה Gn 18:25 +, וַיַּעֲשֶה 1 K 16:25 + 3 t., וַיַּעַש Is 5:2 +; יַעֲשֵה Is 64:3, 2 ms. תַּעֲשֶה 1 S 10:8, תַּעֲשֵה Gn 26:29, Jos 7:9, juss. (c. אַל) תַּעַש Gn 22:12 +, תַּעֲשֵה 2 S 13:12, Je 40:16 Qr (Kt תַּעַש); 1 S. אֶעֱשֶה Gn 2:18 +, וָאֶעֱשֶה Ez 20:14, Dn 8:27, וָאַעַש Dt 10:3 + 4 t. Ez; etc.; Imv. ms. עֲשֵה Ju 10:15 +; fs. עֲשִי Je 6:26 +, etc.; Inf. abs. עָשה 44:17 +; עָשוֺ 7:5 + 2 t. (4:18 van d. H. עָשוּ); cstr. עֲשוֺת Gn 2:4 +, עֲשה 50:20 + 2 t., עֲשוֺ 31:28, sf. עֲשתוֺ 41:32 +, עֲשהוּ † Ex 18:18, etc.; Pt. act. עשֶֹׁה Is 5:5 +, sf. הָעשֹׁוֺ Jb 40:19 (but v. infr.); pl. עשִֹׁים Gn 24:49 +; sf. עשָֹׁי Jb 35:10 (yet v. Ges§ 124 k), etc.; pass. עָשוּי Ex 3:16 +, הֶעָשוּ Jb 41:25 (Ges§ 75 k); f. עֲשוּיָה Ez 21:20 +, etc.;—I. 1. do (1560 + t.): a. (1) c. acc. act. Gn 3:14 (J) 20:10 (E) + oft.; do right in eyes of ´י 2 K 12:3, 14:13 +, evil 8:18, 8:27 + (cf. I. עַיִן 3 c); do God's commands, statutes, etc., Dt 16:12, 30:8, Nu 15:39 (P); חַיִל ´ע 1 S 14:48 + do might, i.e. mightily, valiantly; Pr 31:39 do efficiency, i.e. efficiently; = commit (offence) Lv 20:13 (H), Dt 20:18; sq. מִן part., וְעָשָה מֵאַחַת מֵהֵנָּה Lv 4:2 and shall do a single one of them (things prohibited; v. מִן 3 b (d)), cf. ´וְעָשוּ אַחַת מִכָּל־מִצְוֺת י v:13, v:22, 5:17 (all P); do = perform a work, c. acc. cogn. מַעֲשֶה Ex 18:20, 23:12 (E), also (´י subj.) Dt 11:7, Dn 9:14, Ec 3:11; c. acc. מְלָאכָה Gn 2:2, 2:2 (J), Ex 20:9, 20:10 = Dt 9:13 (10 Words); c. acc. דְּרָכֶיְ † Is 58:13; מְלוּכָה עַל ´ע 1 K 21:7 = exercise sovereignty over; of ´י performing signs (אֹתֹת) Jos 24:17 (E), Nu 14:11, 14:22 (JE), Dt 11:3, so Moses Ex 4:17 and (מֹפְתִים) v:21. (2) do something to one (ל Pers.) Gn 20:9 (E), Ju 9:56 +; c. עַל reflex. Je 26:19 do evil against ourselves; esp. ´י subj., c. לְ, do good to Ex 18:9 (E), 2 K 8:66, or evil Gn 42:28 (E); in phr. so may God do to me, etc. 1 S 3:17, 2 K 6:31 + (v. יסף Hiph. 1.). (3) do something for one (ל Pers.) Gn 30:31, 1 K 11:8 +, dir. obj. om. 1 S 20:4; + ל rei Ju 21:7, 21:16 what shall we do for them, for wives ? c. עַל Pers. Ne 5:19; c. dat. eth. (ל) 1 S 10:7; c. לְ, of ´י doing kindness for 1 S 22:3; executing vengeance for Ju 11:36 (+ מִן of enemy); ´י doing a sign (אוֺת) for † Ju 6:17 (elsewhere נָתַן אוֺת לְ), cf. עֲשֵה־עִמִּי אוֺת לְטוֺבָה Psalm 86:17. (4) do something (in relation or intercourse) wilth (אֵת Pers.), ´י subj. Dt 1:30 all that he did with you, 10:21 (cf. Psalm 86:17 supr.), human subj. 2 Ch 24:24 (obj. שְׁפָטִים), Ru 2:11. (5) seldom c. ב, usu. of executing judgment upon 1 S 28:18, Is 48:14, more gen. Est 1:15 what shall we do with the queen ? also, subj. ´י, Ez 25:11, 28:26, Psalm 149:7, 149:9, Nu 33:4 (on false gods); in good sense, ´חֲסָדִים בּ ´ע Ne 13:14. (6) of ´י doing the justice (מִשְׁפַּט) of any one, i.e. maintaining his cause 1 K 8:45, 8:49, Psalm 9:5. (7) c. adv. do thus, כֹּה, Jos 6:14 (JE), acc. to, כְּ Gn 6:22 (P), 18:21 (J), 1 K 2:6; acc. as, כַּאֲשֶׁר Gn 27:19 (J); Ex 1:17 (E) +; c. בְּ of manner, Ju 9:16 a, Ez 8:18, 25:15. b. work for (ל rei) Gn 30:30 (J); c. ל Pers. 1 S 14:6, Ez 29:20 (for ´י); work in (ב) gold or other material 1 K 7:14, 2 Ch 2:6, 2:13, Ex 31:4, 31:5, 35:32 (all P); c. בָּהּ (i.e. בָּעֲבֹדָה) Ex 5:9 (J) in toil; work with (עִם) God 1 S 14:45, so prob. of God's working with (אֵת) Moses and Aaron 1 S 12:6 (usu. appoint); c. אֵת with (of Pers. in whose company, in whose field Ru 2:19, 2:19 (gleaning); work בְּחֵפֶץ כַּפֶּיהָ Pr 31:13; without prep. Ex 36:1, Ne 3:28. 2. deal with, c. עִם, 2 Ch 2:2, Dn 1:13 (כַּאֲשֶׁר acc. as); c. אֵת, Ez 20:44, Psalm 109:21; Ez 22:14, Zp 3:19 (perh.; Gr Now ins. כָּלָה, v. II 1 g), + כְּ Je 21:2, + בְּ of manner Ez 23:25, 23:29; c. לְ Pers. + בְּ 25:12; c. בְּ Pers., Je 18:23, Dn 11:7, + כְּ acc. to Ne 9:24, Est 3:11. 3. oft. in phr., do kindness (חֶסֶד) with: c. עִם (עִמָּדִ) Gn 19:19, 24:12, 12:14 (J), Ju 1:24, 8:35, 1 S 15:6, 2 S 2:5, 10:2 = 1 Ch 19:2 +; c. עַל, 1 S 20:8 (but rd. עִם Vrss We Dr al.); abs., Psalm 109:16; obj. חֶסֶד + אֱמֶת, c. עִם, Jos 2:14 (JE) Ju 9:19, 2 S 2:6; c. אֵת with, Gn 24:49, 32:11, 47:29 (all J); c. לְ, Ex 20:6 = Dt 5:10, 2 S 22:51 = Psalm 18:51; so טוֺב ´ע, c. עִם, Gn 26:29 (J), cf. Ju 8:35, 9:16; c. אֵת with, 1 S 24:19, 2 S 2:6. 4. abs. act, act with effect, esp. of ´י, 1 K 8:32, 8:39, Je 14:7, Ez 20:9, 20:14, 20:22, Psalm 22:32, 37:5, 52:11, Dn 9:19; of men 2 Ch 31:21, Dn 8:12, 8:24, 11:28, 11:30, 11:32; c. ל Pers. Ez 31:11. II. 1. make (670 + t.): a. c. obj. concr., ark Gn 8:6, altar 13:4, idols Ju 18:24, 18:31 +, etc. b. oft. of God's making (creating) Gn 3:1 (J), 1:7, 1:16, 1:25 (P), Ne 9:6, Jb 9:9, Pr 8:26, 2 Ch 2:11, Psalm 95:5 +; making man Psalm 100:3, 119:73 (made by God's hands), in the womb Jb 31:15, 31:15; making, constituting, nation Dt 26:19, 32:6, 32:15; pt. sf. עשֵֹׁהוּ his Maker Is 17:7, Pr 14:31, 17:5 (הָעשֹׁוֺ Jb 40:19 is improb., most rd. הֶעָשָוּי, with various interpr. of foll. words); עשְֶֹׁ Is 51:13, עשֵֹׁנִי Jb 32:23 (Ginsb; v22 van d. H. Baer), עשֵֹׁנוּ Psalm 95:6; so appar. pt. pl. עשָֹׁי Jb 35:10, עשַֹׁיִךְ Is 54:5 (Ges§ 124 k expl. as sg.). c. make something, c. לְ reflex., make for thee Ex 20:4, Dt 9:12, 10:1 +, for (ל) another 1 S 2:19, 2 S 7:11, 1 K 2:24 +; obj. מִשְׁתֶּה banquet Gn 40:20, Est 5:4, also (no ל) Gn 29:22 (E) Ju 14:10, Est 5:5, 5:12 and (fig., ´י subj.) Is 25:6; c. ל rei, Dt 22:8; c. ל of animal Gn 33:17 (J). d. make a name (שֵׁם) for oneself (ל) 2 S 7:9, 1 Ch 17:8, also (no ל) 2 S 8:13; a new heart for oneself (ל) Ez 18:31. e. make war with (אֶת) Gn 14:2, Jos 11:18 (D); c. עִם, Dt 20:12, 20:20, 1 Ch 5:10, 5:19; abs. 1 Ch 22:8; c. ל reflex. Pr 24:6; pt. עשֵֹׁה מִלְחָמָה 2 Ch 11:1, 26:11, 26:13; make peace, c. ל Pers. Jos 9:15 (J); אִתִּי בְרָכָה ´ע 2 K 18:31 make an agreement with me. f. c. ב, ´פֶּרֶץ בּ ´ע Ju 21:15 ´י brought a catastrophe upon (cf. פרץ). g. c. 2 acc., make something out of (acc. mater.) Ex 25:18, 28:13, 37:17, 37:24, Ct 3:10, Dt 10:3 +; make something into something (Ges§ 117 ii) Ho 8:4, Gn 27:9, Ju 17:4, Nu 11:8, 17:3, Psalm 104:4; make something כָּלָה, i. e. utterly destroy it Na 1:8, Zp 1:18, Ez 20:17, Ne 9:31; c. pt. pass. as 2nd acc. Ex 38:7 they made it נְבוּב לֻחֹת hollow with boards, 39:9; but also c. acc. + לְ, Ho 2:10 gold they made into (ל) the Baal, Ju 8:27, Ex 27:3 (P), Dt 9:14, Je 37:15, Ez 4:9, Is 44:17, 44:19; make something for (ל Pers.), + מִן of material Ct 3:9. 2. produce, yield: of grain, yielding meal Ho 8:7, 8:7, vineyard, grapes Is 5:2, 5:2, 5:4, 5:4, 5:10, tree, fruit 2 K 19:30 = Is 37:31, Ho 9:16, Je 12:2, 17:8, Ez 17:23 (all fig.), Gn 1:11, 1:12 (P); branches Jb 14:9 and (fig.) Ez 17:8; land, fruit Lv 25:21 cf. Hb 3:17, abs. Gn 41:47; of seed Is 5:10, vine, shoots Ez 17:6 (fig.); of cows, yielding milk Is 7:22; hippop. producing fat Jb 15:27. 3. prepare, esp. of dressing and cooking food, Gn 18:7, 18:8, Ju 6:19, 13:5, 1 S 25:18 (pass.), 2 S 12:4, 12:4, Gn 27:14, 27:17, 27:31, 2 S 13:5, 13:7, 1 K 17:12, Ex 12:39 (+ ל reflex.); a bullock for sacrifice (v. infr.) 1 K 18:23, 18:25, 18:26; כְּלֵי גוֺלָה Ez 12:3 (+ ל reflex.); a chamber Ne 13:7; prepare to build (+ ל Pers. and inf.). 4. make offering, e.g. עוֺלָה Ju 13:16, Je 33:18, Lv 16:24, עוֺלָה וָזֶבַח 2 K 5:17 (+ ל dei), הַחַטָּאת Lv 14:19, אִשֶּׁה Nu 15:3, 15:14, various offerings 1 K 8:64, Lv 9:22, Ez 45:17, 46:2 +; + ´לי to ´י Lv 17:9 +; also c. acc. of thing sacrificed (perh. orig. prepare or provide, v. supr.) Ez 43:25, 43:25, 46:15, Lv 14:30, 15:15, 15:30, 16:9, Nu 6:11, 6:17, Psalm 66:15 (+ ל dei) +; abs. = offer sacrifice Ex 10:25 (E + ´לי), to (ל) heathen gods 2 K 17:32. 5. attend to, put in order: pare (the nails) Dt 21:12; wash (feet) 2 S 19:25; trim (beard) v:25 (cf. Fr. faire la barbe, Ger. die Haare machen). 6. observe, celebrate, religious festival, e.g. passover Ex 12:48, Nu 9:4, 9:6, 9:13, Jos 5:10, also (+ ´לי) Ex 12:48, Nu 9:10, 9:14 (all P), Dt 16:1 +; sabbath Ex 31:16, Dt 5:15; feast of weeks 16:10, booths 16:13, Purim Est 9:21, 9:27, etc. 7. acquire property of various kinds (cf. ‘ make money ’) Gn 12:5, 31:5 (J), Is 15:7, Je 17:11, 48:36, Dt 8:18, Ez 22:18, 28:4, 28:4, 38:12, 2 Ch 32:29, Ec 2:8 ; + ל reflex. Dt 8:17, 2 S 15:1, 1 K 1:5; of fruits from vineyards, etc. Psalm 107:37. 8. appoint priests 1 K 12:31, 13:33, 2 Ch 2:17 (all + מִן source), a feast 1 K 12:32, 12:33 (+ ל Pers.); ordain a sacrifice Nu 28:6, a festal day Psalm 118:24; institute, אוֺב וְיִדְּעֹנִי ghost and familiar spirit 2 K 21:6 = 2 Ch 33:6 (cf. DrDt 18, 11). 9. bring about, of ´י's effecting a deliverance Ex 14:13 (לָכֶם), 1 S 11:13, 2 S 23:10 (ins. also ‖ 1 Ch 11:13 Dr), v:12; cause, sq. cl. c. שֶׁ Ec 3:14. 10. use, לִמְלַאכְתּוֺ ´וְע 1 S 8:16; pass. Ex 38:24. 11. spend, pass, days of life Ec 6:12. Niph.:97 Pf. 3 ms. נַעֲשָה Ju 16:11 +; 3 fs. נֶעֶשְתָה 2 S 17:23 +, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יֵעָשֶה Gn 29:26 +, 3 fs. c. ו subord. וְתֵעָש Est 5:6, 7:2, 9:12 (Ges§ 109 f.), etc.; Inf. cstr. הֵעָשוֺת Est 9:1; 9:14, etc., Pt. נַעֲשֶה Ne 5:18, etc.;—1. be done (pass. of Qal I 1): a. subj. מְלָאכָה Ju 16:11 (c. ב instr.), Ne 6:16 (c. מֵאֵת אֱלֽהִים ), v:9, Ex 12:16 + 4 t.; subj. om. Ez 44:14, indef. Est 4:1; c. כֵּן 9:14; be done, כַּתּוֺרָה Ezr 10:3; be committed, of offence, Dt 13:15, Nu 15:24, Ec 4:1 + 3 t.; c. neg. not (yet) done, i.e. future Is 46:10; be accomplished, performed, fulfilled Ez 12:35, 12:38, Dn 11:36, Est 5:5, 7:2, 9:12; be executed, carried out, of sentence Ec 8:11, decree Est 9:1; be followed, of counsel 2 S 17:28; nearly = occur Ec 1:9, 1:9, 1:13, 9:3, 9:6, subj. מַעֲשֶה 1:14, 2:17, 4:3, 8:9, 8:17, subj. הֶבֶל v:14, עִנְיָן v:15. b. Impf. c. neg., is (are) not done, not acc. to usage, of flagrant offences Gn 20:9 (E), 29:26 (c. כֵּן), 34:7 (both J), 2 S 13:12 (כֵּן); hence (P) not to be done, forbidden by ´י Lv 4:2, 4:13, 4:22, 4:27, 5:17. c. be done to, c. ל of animal 1 S 11:7 (כֹּה); ל Pers. Ex 2:4 (E) 21:31 (E; כַּמִּשְׁפָּט), Is 3:11, Je 5:13 (כֹּה), Lv 24:19 (H; כֵּן), Nu 15:34 (P) + 8 t.; be done for, ל Pers. Ju 11:37, Est 6:3, עִם Pers. v:3; ל rei Nu 15:11 (כָּכָה). d. be done upon, against (ב) Dn 9:12. † 2. (pass. of Qal II): a. be made, of conr. things 1 K 10:20 = 2 Ch 9:19 (throne), Je 3:16 (ark), 2 K 12:14, Ez 43:18, Ex 25:31, Nu 4:36 (P); c. acc. mat; Lv. 2:7. b. be produced from (מִן) vine Nu 6:4. c. be prepared, of food Ex 12:16, Lv 6:14, 7:9 (all P), Ne 5:18, 5:18. d. be offered, מִנְחָה Lv 2:8, 2:11, kid Nu 28:15, 28:24. e. be observed, passover 2 K 24:22, 24:23 (ל dei) = 2 Ch 35:18, 35:19; Purim Est 9:28. f. be used Lv 7:24 (P), + ל rei 13:51 (P) Ez 15:5, 15:5. † Pu. Pf. 1 S. עֻשֵּיתִי Psalm 139:15 I was made.

[Str6214] עֲשָהאֵל:18 n.pr.m. Ασαηλ, LXXL Ασσαηλ (on this and foll. cf. אֶלְעָשָה);—1. brother of Joab and Abishai 2 S 2:18, 2:18 + 7 t. 2, + 3:27, 3:30, 23:24, 1 Ch 2:16, 11:26, 27:7. 2. Levites: a. 2 Ch 17:8 (Ιασειηλ, Ασιηλ). b. 31:13. 3. post-exil. name Ezr 10:15.

[Str6221] † עֲשִיאֵל n.pr.m. Simeonite 1 Ch 4:35, Ασιηλ.

[Str6222] † עֲשָיָה n.pr.m. Ασαιας, etc.; LXXL in Kgs. Αζαριας;—1. servant of Josiah 2 K 22:12, 22:14 = 2 Ch 34:20. 2. Simeonite 1 Ch 4:36. 3. Levites: a. 6:15, 15:6, 15:11. b. 9:5.

[Str3299] † יעשו(ו) Kt, יַעֲשָי (וְ) Qr, n.pr.m. one with foreign wife Ezr 10:37, LXX καὶ ἐποίησαν.

[Str3300] † יַעֲשִיאֵל n.pr.m. 1. hero of David 1 Ch 11:47, (Ι)εσσιηλ. 2. Benjamite ruler 27:21, Ασειηρ, LXXL Ιασσιηλ.

[Str4639] מַעֲשֶה:233 n.m.:Gn 20:9 deed, work;—abs. ´מ Gn 44:15 +, cstr. מַעֲשֵה Is 5:12 +; sf. מַעֲשֵהוּ Ju 13:12 +, etc.; pl. מַעֲשִים Gn 20:9 +; cstr. מַעֲשֵי Je 1:16 +; sf. מַעֲשָיו 1 S 19:4 (or sg., so Dr) +, etc.;—oft. acc. cogn. c. עשה;—1. a. (1) deed, thing done by man Nu 16:28 (JE), 1 K 13:11, Is 26:12; —1 S 20:19 is obscure; (2) implic. evil Gn 44:15 (J), Ex 23:24 (E), Ne 6:14 + 8 t., + sg. coll. doing(s) Mi 6:16, Lv 18:3, 18:3 (H), 2 Ch 17:4, יְדֵיהֶם ´מ La 3:64, Hg 2:14, Jb 33:17 (rdg. מִמַּעֲשֵהוּ LXX Di Siegf Bu), Ez 16:30 (behaviour); explic. מַעֲשֵינוּ הָרָעִים Ezr 9:13 cf. Ec 4:3, 8:11, 8:14, מַעֲשֵי־אָוֶן Is 59:6; specif. of idolatr. practices, יְדֵיכֶם ´מ sg. Dt 31:29, Je 25:6, 25:7, 32:30, pl. 44:8, cf. sg. 1 K 16:7, 2 K 22:17 = 2 Ch 34:25; (3) implic. right, praiseworthy 1 S 19:4, 2 K 23:19, Jon 3:10, Pr 31:31; of duty in gen. אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשוּן ´הַמּ Ex 18:20 (E) = what they are to do; explic. Ec 4:4, 8:14; (4) as basis of judgment (good or bad) Is 66:18, Psalm 33:15, 62:13, Ec 12:14, יְדֵיהֶם ´מ Je 25:14. b. (1) work, labour, husbandry Ex 23:16 (E), Gn 5:29 (J), Ju 19:16, יְדֵיכֶם ´מ Hg 2:17; enforced labour of Isr. in Egypt Ex 5:5, 5:13 (J); in gen. 23:12 (E); also of product of labour 23:16, cf. Is 65:22, Ec 5:5; ´שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמּ Ez 46:1 the six working-days; of religious work, ´עֲבֹדַת בֵּית הָא ´מ 1 Ch 23:28, cf. ´מ 2 Ch 31:21 (2) business, pursuit, Gn 46:33, 47:3 (J), Ju 13:12, 1 S 25:2, Is 54:16; in gen., occupation Is 29:15, Ec 2:4, 2:11, 3:17, 3:22, 8:9, 9:7, 9:10; (3) undertaking, enterprise Is 19:14, 19:15, Dt 15:10; יָדְֶָ ´מ Dt 2:7 + 5 t. Dt, 2 Ch 32:30, Jb 1:10, Psalm 28:4, יָדֵינוּ ´מ Psalm 90:17, 90:17. (4) achievement Je 48:7, Est 10:2; (5) in weakened sense, מַעֲשֶיְ Pr 16:3 thine affairs; nearly = occurrences Ec 1:14 (pl.), 2:17, 8:17 (sg.). c. deed(s), work(s) of ´י, esp. in deliverance and in judgment, Ju 2:7, 2:10, Jos 24:31 (D), Psalm 33:4 + 21 t., + יָדָיו ´מ etc. Is 5:12, Psalm 28:5, 92:5 + 4 t.; הָאֱלֽהִים ´מ in gen. Ec 7:13, 8:17, 11:5 cf. 3:11. 2. a. (1) work, thing made, by man, אֹפֶה ´מ Gn 40:17 (E) baker's work; יְדֵי יוֺצֵר ´מ La 4:2; oft. of furnishings of tabern., חשֵׁב ´מ Ex 26:1 + 7 t., רֹקֵם ´מ 26:36 + 5 t., אֹרֵג ´מ 28:32 + 2 t., חָרָשׁ ´מ 28:11, cf. יְדֵי אָמָּן ´מ Ct 7:2; of holy oil, etc, רֹקֵחַ ´מ Ex 30:25 + 2 t. (ins. רֹקֵחַ perh. also 2 Ch 16:14); hence ´מ = work of art Is 3:24 (of coiffure), cf. ´כְּלִי מ Nu 31:51; sq. n. of material, pattern, etc., עִזִּים ´מ v:20 (i.e. goats’ hair), v. also Ex 27:4, 28:14 +; in temple, שְבָכָה ´מ 1 K 7:17, ´מ שׁוּשַׁן v:19, etc.; צַעֲצֻעִים ´מ 2 Ch 3:10, cf. הַחֲבִתִּים ´מ 1 Ch 9:31 the work of (consisting in) bread-wafers; = materials of (prepared for) הָעוֺלָה 2 Ch 4:6; in theoph. לִבְנַת הַסַּפִּיר ´מ Ex 24:10 (J); ´מ of ships 2 Ch 20:37; in gen. Is 29:16; Ez 27:16, 27:18 = thy manufactures, wares; מַעֲשַי Psalm 45:2 = my verses (ποίημα, poem); (2) workmanship Ez 1:16, 1:16 (v:16 a del. Co Toy) 1 K 7:8, Ex 28:8 + 11 t.; (3) יְדֵי אָדָם ´מ of idols (contemptuously) Dt 4:28, 2 K 19:18 = Is 37:19 = 2 Ch 32:19, Psalm 115:4, 135:15, cf. Is 2:8 (יָדָיו ´מ), Ho 14:4, Mi 5:12, Je 1:16; so (יְדֵי) ´מ חָרָשׁ Dt 27:15, Je 10:3, 10:9 cf. Ho 13:2; חֲכָמִים ´מ Je 10:9; תַּעְתֻּעִים ´מ v:15, 51:18; appar. also מַעֲשֵהֶם Is 41:29 cf. 57:12, Ez 6:6; יָדָיו ´מ of altars Is 17:8. b. work (made by) God Ex 32:16 (E); esp. (poet. and late), of created things, Psalm 103:22, 104:24 + 4 t. Psalm; אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיְ ´מ 8:4, יָרֶיְ ´מ 102:26 (both of heavens), cf. 19:2 (heavenly bodies), 8:7 (animals); of man Jb 14:15, 34:19, cf. לָדַעַת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי מַעֲשֵהוּ 37:7 (but rd. prob. אנשׁים Vulgate Ol Di al.); of nation Is 19:25, 60:21, 64:7; of weights Pr 16:11 (but rd. perh. הַמֶּלֶךְ) for ´י Gr Toy). c. product of olive-tree, זַיִת ´מ Hb 3:17; fig. product of righteousness Is 32:17.

[Str4640–41] † מַעֲשֵיָהוּ, יָה-, מַעֲשַי n.pr.m. (work of ´י; cf. n. pr. מעשיהו on Isr. seal, Cl-Gann, v. Lzb315);—Μα(α)σσαια(ς), etc., LXXB Ezr 10:21 Μασαηλ:—1. priest, Je.'s time, מַעֲשֵיָה Je 21:1, 29:25, 37:3; perh. 35:4 (יָהוּ-). 2. 29:21. מַעֲשֵיָהוּ 3. Levites: a. 1 Ch 15:18, 15:20. b. 2 Ch 23:1. 4. officials: a. 26:11. b. 34:8. 5. sons of Ahaz 28:7. 6. Levite 1 Ch 6:25 rdg. מַעֲשֵיָה for MT בַּעֲשֵיָה q. v., cf. Kit. מַעֲשֵיָה of various post-exil. men: 7. Ne 3:23 (Μαδασηλ, A Μαασιου). 8. a. 8:4, 8:7. b. 10:26. c. 11:5. d. v:7. e. 12:41. f. v:42. 9. a. Ezr 10:18. b. v:21 Μασαηλ, Μασειας). c. v:22. d. v:30. 10. מַעֲשַי (van d. H. מַעְשַי) Μα(α)σαι(α), a priest 1 Ch 9:12.

title: II עָשָה
content:
[Str6213] † II. [עָשָה] vb. Pi press, squeeze (NH עִשָּה Pi. compel; Targum עַסִּי Pa. crush, gnash (teeth); cf. Ar. غَشِىَ compress a woman);—Pf. 3 pl. עִשּוּ דַּדֵּי בְּתוּלִים Ez 23:3, 23:8 (unchaste act); Inf. cstr. דַּדַּיִךְ…בַּעֲשוֺת v:21 rd. Pi. בְּעַשּוֺת (Ew Co Toy, al.).

[Str6215] עֵשָו:97 n.pr.m. Esau, Ησαυ;—Esau, elder son of Isaac Gn 25:25, 25:26 + 7 t. 25, 26:34, 27:1 + 24 t. 27, 28, 32:4 + 15 t. 32, 33, 35, Jos 24:4, 24:4, Mal 1:2, 1:3, 1 Ch 1:34; identif. with אֱדוֺם Gn 36:1, 36:8, 36:19, ancestor of Edomites v:9; v:43, cf. 1 Ch 1:35; dwelling in Mt. Seir Gn 36:8 (25 t. in all, Gn 36) Dt 2:5, Jos 24:4; בְּנֵי עֵשָו = Edomites Dt 2:4, 2:8, 2:12, 2:22, 2:29; עֵשָו = Edom Je 49:8, Ob:6, בֵּית עֵשָו v:18, v:18, הַר עֵשָו v:18, v:9, v:19, v:21.

title: עָשַק
content:
[Str6229] † [עָשַק] vb. Hithp. contend (perh. orig. cling to (in strife), cf. Ar. عَشِقَ cling with love (LagBN 143); Syr. ܥܣܰܩ, Ethpa. be difficult (i.e. indignant, hostile); NH עָסַק, Targum עֲסַק, busy oneself, NH עֵסֶק business, occupation);—Pf. 3 pl. הִתְעַשְּקוּ עִמּוֺ Gn 26:20 they contended with him.

[Str6230,6242] † עֵ֫שֶק n.pr.font. in SW. Pal. Gn 26:20 (expl. as contention);—locality unknown, LXX Ἀδικία.

title: עשר
content:
עשר (√ of foll.; appar. gather, unite, cf. Ar. عَشِيرٌ kinsman, عَشِيرَةٌ tribe, مَعْشَرٌ assembly; hence ten = collection, union).

[Str6235,6242] עֶשֶר, עֲשָרָה:176 n.m. and f. ten (NH = BH; perh. MI33 עשרַ; Ph. עשר, עסר, עשרת, etc.; Ar. عَشْرٌ, عَشَرَةٌ; Sab. עשר Sab DenkmNo. 11 b, l. 5, 6, עשרת and cpds. HomChrest. 48; Eth. ዐሥሩ፡ ዐሸርቱ፡; As. esûertu; Targum עֲסַר, עַסְרָא; עֲשַר, עַשְרָא; Syr. ܥܣܪ, ; Nab. עשר, all = ten;; Palm. עשרתא the Ten (rulers));—m. (c. n.f.) עֶ֫שֶר 2 S 15:16 + 53 t. (abs. and cstr. usu. indistinguishable); עָשֶׁר 1 K 7:43, 1 Ch 6:46; f. (c. n.m.): abs. עֲשָרָה Gn 24:10 + 69 t.; cstr. (prob.) עֲשֶ֫רֶת 1 S 17:18 + 46 t.; f.pl. עֲשָרֹת Ex 18:21 + 2 t.;—on pl. עֶשְרִים, 20, v. infr.;—† 1. a ten, only f.pl. tens in phr. ´שָרֵי ע captains of tens Ex 18:21, 18:25 (E), Dt 1:15. 2. ten, enumerating Pers. or things, usually without other num.: a. עֶ֫שֶר bef. n.f.pl., Gn 45:23 + 43 t. after n. † 1 K 7:27, 7:43 + late passages Jos 15:57, 21:5, 21:26 (all P), 1 Ch 6:46, 2 Ch 4:7; bef. בָּאַמָּה = ten cubits † 1 K 6:3, 6:25, 6:26, 7:23, 7:24. b. עֲשָרָה bef. n.m.pl., Gn 45:23 + 25 t. (incl. אֲלָפִים ´ע = 10,000 2 S 18:3, 2 K 24:14 Kt, עֲשֶרֶת Qr); bef. n.coll. בָּקָר 1 K 5:3, רֶכֶב 2 K 13:7; also לֶחֶם הַוֶּה ´ע 1 S 17:17 these ten loaves, cf. 1 K 14:3; אֶלֶף ´ע Ez 45:1 rd. ´עֶשְרִיס א LXX Hi Co Berthol Toy; after n.m.pl. † Gn 32:16, 32:16, 43:3 (all E), Jos 17:5 (JE), Nu 29:23 (P), 1 K 7:43, 2 Ch 4:6, 4:8, Dn 1:12, 1:14, 1:15 †; after n.coll. צאֹן 2 Ch 30:24; n. om., sc. men, † Gn 18:32 (J) Am 5:3, Ezr 8:4; sc. shekels (weight) Gn 24:22 (J) Nu 7:14 + 13 t. Nu 7 (זָהָב ´ע); כֶסֶף ´ע (sc. shekels, value) 2 S 18:11; sc. measures (of grain) Hg 2:16; c. art. the ten Gn 18:23 (J; sc.men), Ne 11:1 (id. = every ten); as pred. Ex 27:12, 27:12 = 38:12, 38:12 (all P) †. c. עֲשֶ֫רֶת bef. n.m.pl. Ex 34:28 + 18 t., + כַּעֲשֶרֶת הַיָּמִים 1 S 25:38 (on art. cf. Weir in Dr, but dub.; prob. om., so LXX We Bu), + אֲלָפִים ´ע = 10,000 Ju 1:4 + 26 t.; n. om. כֶּסֶף ´ע (sc. shekels) Ju 17:10. † 3. rarely + other num.: a. עֶשֶר after larger num., מֵאָה שָׁנִים ´וָע Gn 50:22, 50:26, Jos 24:29 (all E), Ju 2:8. b. ´ע before larger num. עֶשֶר שָׁנִים וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֺת שָׁנָה Gn 5:14 (P). c. עֲשָרָה after larger num., מֵאָה וַעֲשָרָה הַזְּכָרִים Ezr 8:12, cf. (n. preceding) 1:10. d. עֲשָרָה after smaller num., הַכָּסֶף שִׁבְעָה שְׁקָלִים וַעֲשָרָה Je 32:9 = seventeen shekels; before smaller num. + n. sg. עֲשָרָה וַחֲמִשָּׁה שֶׁקֶל Ez 45:12, but rd. חֲמִשִּׁים joining עֲשָרָה to preceding, LXXA Hi Co al.

[Str6240] עָשָר:203, עֶשְרֵה:144 n. ten, only after units to make num. 11–19, both cardinal and ordinal; עֶשְרֵה c. n.f., עָשָר c. n.m., thus: 1. eleven: a. אַחַד עָשָר (c. n.m.) Gn 32:23 + 2 t. b. אַחַת עֶשְרֵה (c. n.f.) 2 K 23:36 + 7 t.; also = eleventh 1 K 6:38, 2 K 9:29. c. עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָר (c. n.m.) Nu 29:20; ord. Dt. 1:3 + 7 t. d. עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְרֵה (c. n.f.) Ex 26:7 + 4 t.; ord. Je 1:3 + 4 t. 2. twelve: a. עָשָר (ם)שְׁנֵי (c. n.m.) Gn 35:22 + 80 t. ord. 1 K 19:19 + 12 t. b. עֶשְרֵה (ם)שְׁתֵּי (c. n.f.) Ex 24:4 + 31 t.; ord. 2 K 8:25 + 6 t. 3. thirteen: a. שְׁלשָׁה עָשָר (c. n.m.) Nu 29:14 + 2 t.; ord. Est 3:12 + 7 t. b. שְׁלשׁ עֶשְרֵה (c. n.f.) 1 K 7:1 + 9 t.; ord. Gn 14:4 + 2 t. 4. fourteen: a. אַרְכָּעָה עָשָר Gn 46:22 + 13 t.; ord. Ex 12:6 + 17 t. b. אַרְבַּע עֶשְרֵה Gn 31:41 + 5 t.; ord. 2 K 18:13 + 3 t. 5. fifteen: a. חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָר Ho 3:2 + 3 t.; ord. Ex 16:1 + 14 t. † b. חֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָר Ju 8:10, 2 S 19:18. c. חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְרֵה 2 K 14:17 + 9 t.; ord. † 2 K 14:23, 2 Ch 15:10.—Vid. also עֶשֶר 2 d. 6. sixteen: a. שִׁשָּׁה עָשָר Ex 26:25 + 6 t.; ord. 1 Ch 24:14 + 2 t. b. שֵׁשׁ עֶשְרֵה Gn 46:18 + 13 t. 7. seventeen: a. שִׁבְעָה עָשָר 1 Ch 7:11 + 2 t.; ord. Gn 7:11 + 3 t. b. שְׁבַע עֶשְרֵה Gn 37:2 + 4 t.; ord. 1 K 22:52, 2 K 16:1.—Vid. also עֶשֶר 3 d. 8. eighteen: a. עָשָר (שְמֹנַת)שְׁמֹנָה Gn 14:4 + 10 t.; ord. † 1 Ch 24:15, 25:25. b. שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְרֵה Ju 3:14 + 6 t.; ord. 1 K 15:1 + 8 t. † 9. nineteen: a. תִּשְׁעָה עָשָר 2 S 2:30; ord. 1 Ch 24:16, 25:26. b. תְּשַׁע עֶשְרֵה Gn 11:25, Jos 19:38; ord. 2 K 25:8 = Je 52:12. These num. usually take sg. of the nouns most often used, שָׁנָה, יוֺם, חֹדֶשׁ, cf. (sts.) אִישׁ, אַמָּךְ, etc.; otherwise pl.; rarely (late usage) they follow noun, which is then usu. pl., e.g. Nu 29:30, Jos 15:51 (P), Ezr 8:35, 8:35, Est 3:13, 8:5, etc. (even שָׁנִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְרֵה Na 5:14), but שָׁנָה precedes ordinal 1 K 6:38, שְׁנַת 15:1 + 8 t., so יוֺם (c. ord.) 2 Ch 29:17 + 5 t. Est 9; also יוֺם and שָׁנָה (שְׁנַת) both precede and foll. ordinal Nu 7:72, 7:78, 2 K 8:25, 9:29, 14:23, 16:1, Je 32:1, 2 K 25:8 = Je 52:12.—Vid. also Köii. 1. 211 ff. DaSynt. § 37 a, also R. 1, 2. Ges§§ 92 d, e, 134, and esp. HernerSynt. d. Zahlwörter im AT (1893); on form in ה—ֵ (prob for י—ַ), Ol:§ 110 Köii. 1, 427 WSG 138.

[Str6237] † [עָשַר] vb. denom. take the tenth of, tithe;—Qal Impf. 3 ms. יַעְשר 1 S 8:15, 8:17 (c. acc. of thing tithed). Pi. Impf. + Inf. abs. give a tenth of, c. acc. rei: 2 ms. עַשֵּר תְּעַשֵּר Dt 14:22; 1 S עַשֵּר אֲעַשְּרֶנּוּ לָח Gn 28:22 (P); Pt. taking the tenth, הַמְעַשְּרִים Ne 10:38. Hiph. (so usu. expl.) Inf. לַעְשֵר Dt 26:12 c. acc. cogn. i.e. taking, reckoning, tithe, but Inf. cstr. with —ֵ improb., < rd. לְעַשֵּר Pi.; בַּעְשֵר Ne 10:39 abs., i.e. receiving tithes, but read prob. בַּעְשר Qal (on anom. points, see Ges§ 53 k DrDt 26, 12).

[Str6218] † עָשוֺר, and (Ex 12:3) עָשר n.[m.] a ten, decade;—1. usu. of days: a. a period of ten days Gn 24:55 (J). b. in phr., לַחֹדֶשׁ (עָשר)בֶּעָשוֺר on the tenth of the month Lv 25:9 (H), Ez 20:1, 24:1, 40:1, Ex 12:3, Lv 16:29, 23:27, Nu 29:7, Jos 4:19 (all P), 2 K 25:1 = Je 52:4, Je 52:12 (seventh day in ‖ 2 K 25:8). 2. of strings of instr.: ´נֵבֶל ע harp, a ten (-stringed one) Psalm 33:2, 144:9; ´ע alone Psalm 92:4 upon a ten (-stringed instrument).

[Str6242,6235] עֶשְרִים:315 n.pl.indecl. (a) twenty (ancient pl. of עֶשֶר PräBAS i. 376; NH = BH; Ar. عِشْرُونَ; As. ešrâ; Sab. עשרי HomChrest. 48; Eth. ዕስርኣ፡ Aram. עשרין, ܥܶܣܪܝܺܢ; Nab. עשרין);—I. as cardinal: 1. without other num.: a. usu. sq. n.s. (esp. שָׁנָה, אִישׁ, אַמָּה, etc.) Gn 31:38, 1 S 14:14, Ex 38:18 + 64 t., + עֶשְרִים אֶלֶף 20,000 1 Ch 18:4 + 7 t. + Ez 45:1 (rdg. עֶשְרִים אָלֶף, v. עֶשֶר 2 b). b. sq. n.pl. 2 S 3:20, Ex 36:23, 36:24, 36:25 + 4 t. † c. sq. n.s. coll. 1 K 5:3. d. n.pl. precedes Gn 32:15, 32:15, 32:16, 2 Ch 3:3 + 6 t. e. n. om. Gn 18:31, 18:31 (´הָע), 1 K 6:2 + 6 t., as pred. Ex 27:10, 27:10, 27:11, 27:11 + 4 t. † f. + בָּאַמָּה Zc 5:12. 2. + other num.: a. c. units, usu. 20 + (c. וְ) unit + n.s. Ju 10:2, 10:3, 1 K 14:20 + 58 t. (incl. 20 + 1 * 1000, etc., 27 t.); n. om. Jos 15:32 + 2 t. pred.; less oft. unit + 20 + n.s. Gn 11:24, Ex 38:24, Nu 8:24 (all P) + 27 t.; unit + 20 + בָּאַמָּה Ez 40:21, Ex 26:2, 36:9 (both P). b. 20 + unit + n.pl. Nu 7:8, 7:8 (P), 1 Ch 2:22 + 3 t. Chr. † c. n.pl. + 20 + unit Jos 19:30, 19:30, 1 Ch 12:29 (van d. H. v28). d. c. hundreds, 20 usu. foll.; sq. n.s. 1 K 9:14, Gn 6:3, Dt 31:2 + 7 t.; n. om. 2 Ch 3:4, Ezr 2:32 = Ne 7:35; 20 + 100 (n. om.) Nu 7:86. e. n.pl. + 100 + 20 1 Ch 15:5, 15:6;—cf. further מֵאָה. II. as ordinal: 1. 20 alone, ´בִּשְׁנַת ע in the twentieth year 1 K 15:9 + 4 t.; n. om. Nu 10:11 + 3 t. 2. a. 20 + unit + ns. Ez 29:17, 40:1. b. ns. + 20 + unit Hg 1:15, 2 Ch 7:10 +; ns. + unit + 20 Ex 12:8; בִּשְׁנַת + 20 + unit 1 K 16:10, etc.—Vid. reff. sub עֶשֶר.

[Str6224] עֲשִירִי:20 m., עֲשִירִיָּה, and עֲשִירִית:8 f. adj. num. ord. tenth;—1. דּוֺר עֲשִירִי Dt 23:3, 23:4; ´בַּיּוֺם הָע Nu 7:66 (P); ´הַחֹדֶשׁ הָע Gn 8:5 (P) Ez 24:1 + 5 t.; בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִרִי Je 39:1; ´ח om. הָעֲשִירִי Gn 8:5 (P), בָּעֲשִרִי Ez 29:1, 33:21; other nouns om. הָעֲשִירִי 1 Ch 12:13, 25:17, 27:13, הָעֲשִרִי 24:11; בַּשָּׁנָה הָעֲשִרִית Ez 29:1, הָעֲשִרִית ´בַּשּׁ Je 32:1. 2. as subst. a tenth part: f. abs. עֲשִרִיָּה Is 6:13 ; f. cstr. עֲשִירִית הָאֵיפָה Nu 28:5, עֲשִרִית Ex 16:36, עֲשִירִת Lv 5:11, 6:13, Nu 5:15; עֲשִירִת הַחֹמֶר Ez 45:11; m. abs. הָעֲשִירִי Lv 27:32 the tithe (i.e. of cattle, etc.).

[Str6241] עִשָּרוֺן:33 n.m.:Lv 14:10 tenth part (of ephah; cf. LXX δέκατον τοῦ οἰφί Nu 15:4, and עֲשִירִית הָאֵיפָה 28:5; i.e = עֹמֶר, v. further BenzArch. 182 NowArch. i. 203);—abs;—´ע Lv 14:21 +, עִשָּרֹן Ex 29:40, Nu 28:13; pl. עֶשְרֹנִים Nu 28:9 +;—only P (H), as measure of סֹלֶת used in meal-offering Ex 29:40, Lv 14:10 + 3 t. Lv (H only 23:17); Nu 15:4 + 26 t. Nu, incl. distributive ן עִשָּרוֺן (וֺ)עִשָּר 28:13 + 4 t.

[Str4643] † מַעֲשֵר n.m.:Nu 18:28 tenth part, tithe;—abs. ´מ Nu 18:26 +; cstr. מַעְשַר Lv 27:30 +, מַעֲשַר Ne 10:39 (bef. הַמַּעֲשֵר); sf. מַעַשְרוֺ Lv 27:31; pl. abs. מַעַשְרוֺת Ne 12:44; sf. מַעְשְרֹתֵידֶם Am 4:4 + 3 t.;—1. tenth part of ḥomer Ez 45:11, of bath v:14. 2. tithe, payment of tenth part: c. מִן rei Gn 14:20, Nu 18:26; usu. cstr. bef. n. rei Dt 12:17, 14:23, 14:28, 26:12, Lv 27:30, 27:32, 2 Ch 31:5, 31:6, 31:6, Ne 10:38, 10:39, 13:5, 13:12; abs. Nu 18:21, 18:26, 18:26, Mal 3:8, 3:10, 2 Ch 31:12, Ne 10:39, 12:44; ´שְׁנַת הַמּ Dt 26:12 the year of the tithe (i.e. of tithing); c. genit. Pers. paying tithe Am 4:4, Dt 12:6, 12:11, Lv 27:31, Nu 18:24, 18:28.—Cf. RS Sem.i. 228 ff.; 2nd ed. 245 ff.; Proph. Lect. ii. N. NowArch. i. 313; ii. 257 f. BenzArch. 309, 460 f. DrDt. 168 ff.

[Str5906] I. עָשׁ Jb 9:9 prob. error for עישׁ, v. עַ֫יִשׁ p. 747.

[Str6211] II. עָשׁ v. עשׁשׁ.

[Str6220] † עַשְָׁ+ות n.pr.m. in Asher 1 Ch 7:33, Ασειθ, Ασουαθ.

title: עשׁן
content:
עשׁן (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. عَثَنَ ascend, LagBN 51 (plausibly); v. عُثَانٌ, عَثَنٌ smoke; also Syr. ܬܶܢܳܢܳܐ (Nö§ 116), ܬܢܳܢܳܐ, from √ * ܥܬܢ acc. to HoffmLCB 1882, 320; vb. denom. in Ar. NH).

[Str6227] † I. עָשָׁן n.m.:Ex 19:16 smoke;—abs. ´ע Ju 20:38 +, cstr. עֲשַׁן Jos 8:20, 8:21, עֶ֫שֶׁן Ex 19:18; sf. עֲשָׁנוֺ Ex 19:18, עֲשָׁנָהּ Is 34:10; —1. a. of burning city Jos 8:20, 8:21, Ju 20:38, 20:40, cf. Na 2:14; heralding a foe Is 14:31. b. in fig. of destruction of Isr. Is 9:17, Edom 34:10. c. sim. of dust-cloud Ct 3:6; of transitoriness Ho 13:3, Is 51:6, Psalm 37:20 (rdg. ´כֶּע, as LXX SyrVer Vulgate), 68:3, 102:4; sim. of the unpleasant, Pr 10:26. d. breath of crocodile Jb 41:12. 2. a. attending theoph., ´תַּנּוּר ע Gn 15:17; of mt. Ex 19:18, cf. sim. הַכִּבְשָׁן ´כְּע v:18; Is 6:4, also 4:5, Jo 3:3. b. of God's anger, בְּאַפּוֺ ´ע 2 S 22:9 = Psalm 18:9; so prob. also Is 65:5.

[Str6225] † עָשַׁן vb. denom. smoke, be wroth;—Qal 1. a. smoke, Pf. 3 ms. ´ע of mt. Ex 19:18, so Impf. 3 mpl. יֶעֱשָׁנוּ (at touch of ´י) Psalm 104:32 144:5. b. fig., 3 ms. ´יֶעְשַׁן אַף־י, c. ב against, Dt 20:19, Psalm 74:1. Hence 2. subj. Pers., fume, i.e.be wroth, Pf. 2 ms. ´עָשַׁנְתָּ בּ Psalm 80:5.

[Str6226] † עָשֵׁן adj. smoking ;—´ע of mt. Ex 20:18 (Gi v15); pl. הָאוּדִים הָעֲשֵׁנִים Is 7:4 the smoking firebrands (dying out; in fig.).

[Str6228] † II. עָשָׁן n.pr.loc. in Shephelah of Judah Jos 15:42, in Simeon acc. to 19:7, 1 Ch 4:32, Levit. city 6:44; Ασαν, etc.; = בּוֺר עָשָׁן, q. v. p. 92 supr.

title: עָשַׁק
content:
[Str6231] † עָשַׁק vb. oppress, wrong extort (Targum עֲשַׁק = BH, so OAram. עשק; Syr. ܥܫܰܩ accuse, slander; As. adj. esûḳu, strong; Ar. عَسَقٌ roughness, injustice);—Qal Pf. ´ע Lv 5:21, Ez 18:18; 2 ms. sf. עֲשַׁקְתָּ֫נוּ 1 S 12:4, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. sf. יַעַשׁקֻנִי Psalm 119:122; 2 ms. תַּעֲשֹׁק Lv 19:13 +, etc.; Inf. cstr. עֲשֹׁק Ho 12:8, sf. עָשְׁקָם 1 Ch 16:21, Psalm 105:14; Pt. act. עשֵׁק Pr 14:31 +, fpl. הָעשְׁקוֺת Am 4:1, etc.; pass. עָשׁוּק Dt 28:29 +, etc.;—1. oppress, wrong (oft. by extortion, ‖גָּזַל), c. acc. Pers. 1 S 12:3, 12:4, Mi 2:2, Lv 5:21, 19:13; esp. the poor and helpless Am 4:1, Dt 24:14, Je 7:6, Ez 22:29, Zc 7:10, Pr 14:31, 22:16, 28:3, Ec 4:1; also c. acc. cogn. גָזַל גָּזֵל(וְ)עשֶׁק ´ע Ez 18:18 practise extortion, 22:29, take by extortion Lv 5:23 and (c. acc. rei) Mal 3:5; abs. Ho 12:8 practise extortion; Jb 10:3 deal tyrannically (of God); pt. oppressor, extortioner Je 21:12, Psalm 72:4, Ec 4:1; pt. pass. as subst. the oppressed Psalm 103:6, 146:7. 2. oppress a nation Is 52:4, cf. Psalm 105:14 = 1 Ch 16:21, Psalm 119:122, pt. act. oppressor v:121, pt. pass. oppressed Je 50:33, in predict. וְגָזוּל ´ע Dt 28:29, וְרָצּוּץ ´ע v:23, Ho 5:11. 3. dub. are: יַעְשֹׁק נָהָר Jb 40:23 a river oppresses him, i.e. rushes violently upon him (sc. the hippopot.; Du יָשֹׁק, fr. שׁוּק; > Gunk Bu יִשְׁקַע falls, sinks); עָשֻׁק בְּדַם נֶפֶשׁ Pr 28:17 oppressed (? burdened) with the blood of a person. Pu. Pt. f. הַמְּעֻשָּׁקָה Is 23:12 crushed (of conquered Sidon under fig. of woman).

[Str6233] † ע֫שֶׁק n.m. Ec 7:7 oppression, extortion;—´ע abs. Je 6:6 +, cstr. Psalm 119:134, Ec 5:7; —1. Je 6:6, 22:17, Ez 22:7, 22:12, Psalm 73:8; c. genit. subj. 119:134, obj. Ec 5:7; as acc. cogn. c. עָשַׁק (q. v.) Ez 18:18, 22:29. 2. national oppression, Is 54:14. 3. concr., gain of extortion. Psalm 62:11, so perh. Ec 7:7; as acc. cogn. Lv 5:23 (‖גָּזֵל).—Is 30:12, 59:13 rd. עִקֵּשׁ Lag Gr al.

[Str6232] † עֵ֫שֶׁק n.pr.m. Benjamite 1 Ch 8:39, Ασηλ, Ασεκ.

[Str6234] † עָשְׁקָה n.f. oppression, distress;—עָֽשְׁקָ־ה לִי Is 38:14 [cf. Ges§ § 9v, 48 i) oppression to me ! = I am oppressed, distressed.

[Str6216,6233] † עָשׁוֺק n.[m.] oppressor, extortioner;—Je 22:3 (= עשֵׁק 21:12).

[Str6217] † עֲשׁוּקִים n.pl.abstr. oppression, extortion ;—´ע Am 3:9, Jb 35:9, עֲשֻׁקִים Ec 4:1.

[Str4642] † [מַעֲשַׁקָּה] n.f. extortionate act;—pl. abs. רַב מַעֲשַׁקּוֺת Pr 28:16 great in extortions; ´בֶּצַע מ Is 33:15 gain of extortions.

title: עָשַׁר
content:
[Str6238,6239] † [עָשַׁר] vb. be or become rich (NH in der. spec., and deriv.; Aram. עֲתַר, ܥܬܰܪ; cf. Ar. غَثَرَ abound with herbage, غَثْرَةٌ abundance, of herbage, goods, etc.);—Qal Pf. 1 s. עָשַׁרְתִּי Ho 12:9 I have become rich; Impf. 3 ms. יֶעְשַׁר Jb 15:29 he shall not be rich.—1 K 22:49 rd. עָשָה Hiph. 1. make rich, c. acc. Pers.: Pf. 1 s. הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי Gn 14:23; 2 fs. הֶעֱשַׁרְתְּ Ez 27:33 (of personif. Tyre; + בְּרֹב הוֺנַיִח) ; Impf. 3 ms. sf. יַעְשְׁרֶנּוּ (Ges § 61 g),+ acc. cogn. עשֶׁר; 2 ms. sf. רַבַּת תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּהּ Psalm 65:10 thou dost greatly enrich it (the land); obj. om. 3 fs. תַּעֲשִׁיר Pr 10:22, so Pt. מַעֲשִׁיר 1 S 2:7 ´י maketh rich (opp. מוֺרִישׁ). 2. gain riches, abs.: Impf. 3 ms. יַעֲשִׁר Psalm 49:17, יַעֲשִׁיר Pr 21:7, Dn 11:2 (+ acc. cogn. עשֶׁר) ; 3 fs. תַּעֲשִׁיר Pr 10:4; 1 s. וָאַעֲשִׁר Zc 11:5(Gi Kt ; van d. H. Baer וַאעֲשִׁר); 3 mpl. וַיַּעֲשִׁירוּ Je 5:27; Inf. cstr. לְהַעֲשִׁיר Pr 23:4, 28:20. Hithp. Pt. מִתְעַשֵּׁר Pr 13:7 one enriching himself.

[Str6239] ע֫שֶׁר:37 n.m.:1 S 17:25 riches;—´ע abs. Gn 31:6 + 27 t. cstr. Est 1:4; sf. עָשְׁרוֺ Je 9:22 + 5 t., עָשְׁרָם Psalm 49:7, Pr 14:24; + (or ‖) כָּבוֺד 1 K 3:13, Pr 3:16 + 9 t.; ´עָשָה ע Je 17:11, cf. Eng. ‘ make money. ’

[Str6223] עָשִׁיר:23 adj. et n. rich;—abs. ´ע Ex 30:15 + 19 t.; pl. abs. עֲשִׁירִים Ec 10:6; cstr. עֲשִׁירֵי Psalm 45:13; sf. עֲשִׁירֶיהָ Mi 6:12; —adj. m. 2 S 12:1, 12:4 (opp. רָאשׁ), Ru 3:10 (opp. רַּל); usu. n.m. the rich, opp. רַּל, Pr 10:15 + 3 t.; opp. רָשׁ 2 S 12:2, Pr 14:20 + 4 t.; opp. אֶבְיוֺן Psalm 49:3; alone Je 9:22, Mi 6:12 + 5 t., + עֲשִׁירֵי עָם Psalm 45:13; ´ע Is 53:9 is prob. crpt., cf. ‖רְשָׁעִים; Bö Ry Di-Kit עשֵֹׁי רַע; Krochm Gr CheHpt conj. רְשָׁעִים for ´ע and פּשְׁעִים for ´ר.

title: עָשֵׁשׁ
content:
[Str6244] † [עָשֵׁשׁ] vb. waste away (cf. As. ašašu, moth; Ar. عُثٌّ moth(-worm), عَثَّ eat (of moth ; ? denom.); acc. to De:Psalm 6:8 al. עָשֵׁשׁ is denom. from עָשׁ, prop. be moth-eaten, but improb.) ;—Qal Pf. 3 fs. עָֽשְׁשָׁה מִכַּעַם עֵינִי Psalm 6:8 my eye is wasted from grief, = 31:10 (בְּכַעַס; + נַפְשִׁי, בִּטְנִי; 3 pl. עֲצָמַי עָשֵׁ֫שׁוּ v:11.

799:b. [עָשֵׁשׁ]: acc. to JacobZMG 1901, 141; ZAW 1902, 107 be dark, cf. עשׁשׁא darkness, in Chr-Pal.

[Str6211] † II. עָשׁ n.m. Is 50:9 moth (as waster, consumer);—´ע abs., Ho 5:12 (‖רָקָכ), Is 50:9, 51:8; in sim. Psalm 39:12; כְּבֶגֶד אֲכָלוֺ עָשׁ Jb 13:28; symbol of fragility Jb 4:19.—27:10 read prob. עַכָּבִישׁ q. v.

title: I עָשַׁת
content:
[Str6245] † I. [עָשַׁת] vb. smooth or shiny (?), si vera 1. (cf. עֶשֶׁת);—only Qal Pf. 3 pl. שָֽׁמְנוּ עָֽשְׁתוּ Je 5:28 (fig.) they have grown fat, they are smooth (or shine, from fat); doubtful word, Thes conj. עָֽשְׁרוּ have grown rich (cf. LXX SyrVer Targum), so Gie (but וַיַּעֲשִׁירוּ precedes, v:27).

[Str6247] † עֶ֫שֶׁת n.[m.] plate (as smooth, shiny ? NH id., lump or bar of metal);—cstr. שֵׁן ´ע Ct 5:14 a plate of ivory (Löw in BuhlLex Bu).
